tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 bod kyi ban ser mo ba

tei:div.tei:p: d+ngha bai sku — paṃsna cho sduduci cho ji ji / ritsho ge/ / ci 5 k+ta ṣ+ka rjo r+sha k+ṣi snyo‘ ḍā cin ci — tsho horngo5 /ci༈cho spre k+ṣ-i : tshochi 0ko ci zu rtso kru ca ྅ rta lha sgyu tsā che 8rtserjo: tho cartse rdo ṭ+wāṃ ri rī hūṃ / rdo k+ṣe ’ ṅgha chichi pha 44 ci — snyo tre — — rdzosnye ༈ ci 0sgyutsho miribyu4 thub bstan grags pas brtsams rdze ge zhe spe 6 smi rī bhe cho dzi— dzha carispre risbilam̐ ske— — sto chi 〉 lbo dzācho cajiji / cirtsi — sgo ci4cha—dzi——— 7ci — 9rte — ————ha2gyirnyesbyitshomo/rdzu ṇa3 tshe tsho ram̐/ci — tsho lha ṣidz+wa— rī 8—༷tshibyibyerdosh+laurdzo ridzo snye pi sna ——— cho —ci byu ske ripaci tshorkesnye tsho stothi ’khe snyerdo ruca rtse/ nesgyuye — thu ‘dzi ser thar nga ba so cu sa sa

bodakyiseramob/ — tsho klog mkhan la phul ba'i sdokyi mchid/ nga ne 'o/ rgyus smra mkhan zhig min la/ chos lugs kyi lta bhe sgrog mkhan zhig kyang gang na thin/ nga ni rig gnas kyi rdu1na chad 'an pa zhig dang / blo rig gi rtsasde ‘zhan trī zhig yin/ 'on kyang 'dir bshad pa'i bod kyi ser mo/ ba'i riṭa kyi dpyad rtso ma 'ga' zhig yod trī ni 'di'i skor la nyams myong cung zad yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas tecisnying stsobs cher skyed kyis bris nga yin/ nyams myong zar ba yang mthong thos myong gsum la bshad kyang gco che ba ni rang gis 'tsho ba dngos kyi skyid sdug gi bro ba myong tshar ba la bya degos pas/ nga rang gis 'brog pa'i ru nang du sdod pa'i ban de grong chog pa tsho'i las dbang dngos su myong ba dang / grwa sa na slob gnyer byed bzhin pa'i grwa rkyang gi las dbang de dngos su myong zin/ nga rang nyid bod kyi 'khral 'khrul gyi chos lugs 'du shes shig gis bskyed bsring byas pa'i grwa min grong min gyi 'khyams po zhig yin pa ma zad/ grong nang du rnam g.yeng gi ngang du sdo da pa'i skya min ser min gyi las dbang yang dngos

lo ma dmar po/su myong dang myong bzhin pa yin pas/ rdzus chas bsres pa'i ban rgan ngas 'di dag so so la rang rang gi lta tshul re dang rang rang la kha phyogs mi gcig sa re yod pa dngos su shes zin/de dag gis bsgrub pa'i slob gnyer gyi bya ba dang rnam g.yeng gi bya ba/ kha zhe gnyis med kyi gzhan phan bsam blo dang ma byas thabs med kyi tshong gi byed las/ grong chog dang slong mo 'i bya gzhag tshang ma'i 'byung rkyen dang 'phel rim mngug 'bras bcas re re bzhin dngos su byas tshar ba ni/ ngas rtsom yig/ 8bhedi 'dra zhig 'bri thub nga/'i rtsa bhe'i cha rkyen yin la/rtsom yig 'diri'adra zhig spel thub pa'i spobasarmo nga 'i skul ma yang 'i na/ paṃ gcig gis bya ba sna gcig la rgyus lon byed pa ni de 'draskya dkari mo zhig min yang / rtsom yig 'di 'dra zhig 'bri rgyur phyogs mang por cha rgyus yod dgos te/ sngon gyi srol rgyun la cha rgyus dgos la/ deng gi slob gso la cha rgyus dgos/ chos pa'i ya rabs kyi spyod bzang la cha rgyus yod dgos la 'jig rten pa'i ma rabs spyod ngan la yang cha rgyus dgos pas/ 'di dag tshang ma ni rtsom yig 'di ma bris gong gi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen red/ rtsom thig 'di 'dra zhig 'bri ba ni nam yang thob thang zhig

bod kyi ser mo ba/gi khri steng nas 'bab ma myong ba'i bla chen zhig gi spyod yul min la/ chos grwa dang rtag tu kha bral ma myong ba'i slob gnyer ba zhig gis kyang ha cang dka'/ ma zad gzhan gyis dus rgyun brtsi 'jog byed yul zhig las sger gyi las dbang la pham nyes byung myong med pa zhig gis kyang 'bri mi thub la/ rang sger gyi grol ba kho na don gnyer can kyi chos pa rnal ma zhig gis de bas kyadze dra /na/ nga rang gi snyeri sa dbang la phyorlo nyes du ma zhig kyang byung myong la/ bcortson snyere na du ma zhig kyang byed myong / bhehrū ba dang gnas yu snyel rul dkalnga khag du ma zhig kyang 'phrad myong bas nga'i mi tshe'i brgyud richa pre ni gnas bab 82di 'dra zhig gi 'og tu zad/ cha rkyen de dag la gzhigs nas 'di ltare 'bri na nges par du de la don 'bras cung zad zhig kyang yod dgos te/bod kyi ser mo bhe'i las dbang la sbed du bsam gzhig gtong mkhan zhig ha cang dkon pa'i gnas tshul 'di dang / gal te yod rgyu'i dbang du btang na yang skye ba mtho dman dang gdung rgyud bzang ngan gyi skor zhig lag ser mo ba spyi'i 'tsho ba dang dka' khag sogs ci yang mi brjod pa/ ma 'ongs ba'i 'tsho ba kheg theg byed rgyur 'char gzhi ci yang mi 'god pa'i tshulī 'di dag la bsam na dgos pa dang don 'bras kyang cung 3

lo ma dmar po/zad re yod rgyu red bsam/ gtso bo 'dir brdzod don ni bod kyi ser mo ba'i rigs la sngar med 'tsho ba gsar ba zhig 'thob par brtson len byed rgyu dang / bod kyi ser mo ba'i rigs la sngar med 'asto ba'i lta rtogs yag po zhig 'thob par brtson len byed rgyu/ sngar med bcos bsgyur gsar ba zhig ngathob par brtson len byed rgyu/ de dag gis bod kyi spyi tshogs la gzhogs 'degs yag po zhig byed thub rgyu dang bod ṅku chos lugs 'du shes la ngos zin gsar ba zhig yong budzo rgyu /bod kyi chos min srid min gyi bsam blo la 'gyur ldog gsar nga/ zhig yong thub pa sogs snye2 dmigs pa yin/ rmo de dag la /migs nas bod kyi ser mo ba'i rigs kyi sngon byung lo rgyus mdor bsdus shig dang / da lha'i 'tsho ba dang sems khams sogs brjod gzhir byas pa yin rung 'thus tshang dang cha ldan zhig da dung yong thub med pas rjes mar mu mthud nga tsho tshang mas cha je tshang du gtong bar 'bad dgos/ngas bsams na ser mo ba zhig yin phyin tshang ma gcig 'dra ga la yin te/ la la ni bhestan 'dzin gyi skyes bu zer ba dang sems can gyi 'gro don byed mkhan zar ba zhig yod pa de dngos gnas red la/ nang bstan shes rig gi rkang 'dzin pa dang / mi rigs la byas rjes 'jog mkhan

bod kyi ser mo ngakagyi dpa' bo yang red/ la la ni bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren dang mi rigasaci kyi bla btsong mkhan zhig tu gyur yod/ ser mo pa'i rigs la khyad zhan yod pa ni spyir btang gi gnas tshul cizhig los yin kyang nye ba'i lo 'di gar bltas na khyad zhan yod pa tsamu ma yin par bsam bla'i steng nas las rgyu 'bras khyad gsod la mi 'dzem par gang bsam ci 'dod kyis 3 nga ba rgya yan du gtong ba dang / bya spyod kyi steng nas g.yo spus mgo skoro khram nga 'i ‘phortsi ba zhig gi phyogs su brtson pa je mang nas je ra nga du ‘bhegro bzhin yod nga/ sus kyang shes gsalī ltar red/'di'i rgyu rkyen yang rgyal khab kyis 'di la do dam byed stangs dang mang tshogs kyi bsam bla'i 'khor rgya chung ba'i lan pa red la/ de'i nang nas kyang mang tshogs kyi go rtogs zhan pas lan pa ni 90tshiyan red/ ma zad nga tsho'i chos sdo/gas kyi khyab bsgrags lag cha du ma'i nang ‘‘dad pa dag snang ri’ dang ‘‘gang zag gi tshod gang zag gis mi zin’’ zar ba de gnyis gtso bo byed rgyu dang / yang mkhas pa gang rung zhig dang mdzad rjes can gang rung zhig la bsngags brjod byed tshe de la lo rgyus kyi mi sna 'gangs chen du ma'i skye 'phreng zhig bsgrigs rgyu gtso bo byed rgyu yod pa 'di dag gis kyang mang 5

lo ma dmar po/ stogs kyi bsamu blo je nyog tubyugatong gi yod/ des rkyen gyis sprul sku dang grub thob ni je mang du 'gro bhezhin yod la dpal 'byor 'gran rtsod byed pa'i gom stabs dang bstun da dung rje— mang du 'gro rgyu red/ sprul sku rang gis rang ngos 'dzin byas rung chog la rang gis rad la grub thob kyi mtshan snyan btags kyang chog ste/ 'jig rten mis 'i mthong ba'i lkog gyur gyi gsang ba ci zhig shes mdog bstan nas bshad kyadzā+o de yin min gyi gsal /ba sus 'obyed shes/thams cad snyer dag snang byas na bzang sa re yod mod nyo+ong /gang yin in la dad pa byas na mjug 'bras di nga tsho'i ser mo ba'i rigs kyi spyi'i do dam gyi 'gan khur rul gtoro brlag thebs pa de red/ khyad par grwa bcun yon tan pa'i rigs la ni mthong sben mi byed par phal ba las kyang phal bar brtsi/'di ni nga sto'i mi rabs 'di'i mgo rmong gi chos lugs 'du shes red/ kha phyogs dang lam phyogs ci yang nges gtan med pa'i chos lugs kyi bsam blo 'di ni nga tsho'i bstan par rmang nas gnod byed cig dang mi rigs kyi las dbang la rmang nas rma 'byin byed cig red/ de'i phyir yang dag pa'i stos lugs bsam blo gsar ba zhig tu skul ma gtong rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi bya ba zhig yin pas/ ngas 'di ltar 6

bod kyi ser mo ba/ bshad pa yin/nga tshor da lta bshad na gu ru pad ma'i rnam sprul yod pa ma zad/ rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul yang yod/nga tshor med pa ni nga rang shwakya thub pa'i sprul sku yin zar ba zhigaci da dung byung thub med pa de red/ da dung / sngags pa zhig yin na grub thob thang stong rgyal po dang / sgra bsgrur maro ba lo cwa/ btsun pa zhig yin na/ ma/ban chen zhi ba 'tsho dang kun ma/khyen klong chen pa/ bud mid cig yitsha/ na ra cig snyer ba kyi sgron ma dang ye shes grutsha rgyal gang rung zhig gi rnarlo sprurte du ngos bzung yod pa ma zad/ gling sgrung nang gi h+phu seng blon dang ma yum 'gag0bza'/ dga' bde tharo nag dang mi chung /ba bde sogs kyang gnas 'dir dngos su thon 'dug gangs ri'i /zod 'dir gangs ri'i /zod kyi sngon byon skyes chen tshos /bengs 'dug la rgya gar kyi sngon byon skyes chen tshos kyang khengs 'dug sngon byon lo rgyus kyi mi sna 'gangs chen du mas bar mtshams med par khengs shing mi sna re re rnam pa du mar sprul nas 'gro don byedartsoyul ni bod yul 'di las gzhan dkon/ 'on kyang skye 'phreng du ma brgyud nas da thengs 'dir thon dus skye sngon dang bsdur na he bag mang bos khyad zhan shar tshar/ de ni dus ngan snyigs ma'i dmu rgod skye bo tshor dag snang mid pas lan pa red/ 'di 'dra'i bsam blo zhig gis mang tshogs— mgo 'thom tu 7

lwo ma dmar po/ bcug na mang stogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyar yul gang yin ji ltar shes/ mi rigs gzhan gyis rang rang gi sngon byon mkhas pa tshor bsngags brjod byas te/ de'i rnam thar la slob sbyong byed dus/ nga stos sngon byon skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mtshan snyan gyi 'bag gyon te sgyu 'phrul gyi gar 'khrab pa 'di ya mtshan mi che'am/de'i rkyen gyis grwa ba rnam dag dang chos pa rnal ma sogs0chos phyogs kyi mi sna bzang bo gcig kyadzo bskyed bsring mi byed paro thams cad sngon sbyangaru/ kyi las—'phro sad pa rkyang rkyang du sgom nga red/ de'i phyiro nga tshos dgon pa do dam dang grwa ba dag ther gyi lwas ka 'di snyespu 'thus shar byung ste/ da lta 'i bar lus pas rang gi bstan0pa rang gis bsheg pa'i sbyor ba 'di 'dra ba zhig dngos shugs ci rigs su brtsamasmo so/de'i phyir nga tsho la grwa ba dang jo mo rnam dag dang /bshad grwa dang sgom grwartsotshad ldan re mkho gal che ba dang / da dung snang srid dbang du bsdu pa dang / srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i grub thob dang rig sngags mkhan/ nam mkhar 'phur ba dang / sa 'og tu 'dzul ba/ lus nas me 'bar ba dang chu 'khrug pa/ ri la mi thogs pa dang ra ba la mi thoṭa pa sogs lus kyi rdzu 'phrul sna dgu ston pa'i rigs kyang du ma zhig mkho gal che bas lo gzhon dus nas de dag la sgrig 'dzugs yag po re'i mthun rkyen sbyar rgyu dang de dag la r+pākhor yug yag po re dang 'tsho ba yag po re sbyar rgyu ni da lta 8

bshad na bya ba gang las kyang gal 'gangs che ste/ lha khang bzhengs rgyu las kyang gal 'gangs che la/ mchod rten brtsigs rgyu las kyang gal 'gangs che/ rdo 'bum brtsigs rgyu dang dar lcog 'dzugs rgyu soṭa las gal 'gangs che snyam mo/zhes 2004la'i zla 4tshes 29la rma/go brjod kyi chur du rtsom rnga/ pos bris dzā 'o/

bshad na bya ba gang las kyang gal 'gangs che ste/ lha khang bzhengs rgyu las kyang gal 'gangs che la/ mchod rten brtsigs rgyu las kyang gal 'gangs che/ rdo 'bum brtsigs rgyu dang dar lcog 'dzugs rgyu soṭa las gal 'gangs che snyam mo/zhes 2004la'i zla 4tshes 29la rma/go brjod kyi chur du rtsom rnga/ pos bris dzā 'o/
bod kyi ser mo ba'i sngan chad /

bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i byung ba/ bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i byung ba mdor bsdus shog 'god don thog ma ra ci zhig la ban ser mo ba zer snyam pa'i rang shugs kyis dri ba zhig thon yong na de la gsal cha phye dgos 'dug 'dir bshad pa'i ban se nga mo ba zhes nga/ de ni phal cher gzhung la lar chos byed dge 'dun pa zhes pa de dang don gcig ste/ de ni nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing bod kyi nang bstan shes rig de dga' gus tshad med kyi slo/ nas rīrang 'gul gyis rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel byed mkhan gyi las rigs sh-ig gi thob ming yin/ chos pa dang / 'jig rten pa/ bzo ba dang / dmag mi sogs kyang las rigs kyi sgo nas btags pa bzhin bod kyi ban ser mo ba zhes pa de yang de bzhin thun mong ma yin pa'i las rigs shig gi sgo nas de ltar bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi zur zhig tu ma bgos rang 'gul gyis lhang nger yod pa 'dir ched du gzhan las dmigs su bsal nas brjod par 'dod/ de le yang / bla ma dang grwa ba/ ban+de dang jo mo/ btsun pa dang sngags pa sogs pho mo dang nang gses las rigs kyis khyad par du ma ma/chis kyang gzhi rtsa'i steng nas bshad na/ bod kyi spyi tshogs su ‘‘ser sku

lo ma dmar po/gnyis ’ zhes mi skya pho mo dang ser mo ba ni las rigs dang thob thang mi 'dra ba'i so so gnyis su gar yod pa 'di bzhin de'i byung ba mdor bsdus brjod rgyu las de la ming de ltar 'dogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs ni re zhig brjod pa'i ngal ba ma byas/ 1 sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du byon pa'i nang bstan shes rig gi ma lag rgya che zhing dpang mthug pa'i sa steng gi mun bsal sgron ma 'gyed ma/khas skyes mchog dam pa rnams ni da lta'i bod kyi ser mo ba'i 'byung khungs yin nga sa de mdor bsdus shīg 'god na/ de yang / chos gzhung ltar bshad na/ rnam 'dren bzhi ba ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po de nyid sngon bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin kyang / zhing 'dir slar yang ‘‘dga' ldan gnas nas 'phos pa dang / lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang /’mi sogs kyi mdzad pa rgya cher bstan pa ni lhun grub 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa bskal ba ma stong bar du rgyun mi chad par lha mi 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams kyi dpal du shar ba yin pas/ de nyid gzhung gzhan du shes par bya'o/ 'on kyang dgos pa'i dbang gis nga tsho'i da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa khab mig tsam 'di'i shang tshad kyi steng nas thun mong snang tshul dngos gtso la rgyus smra ba'i 'gros ltar bshad na/ hin —dhu'i yul khams shig gi 'go bdag shākya'i rgyal po'i sras gzhon nu don grub kyis na rga 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mngon sum du gzigs 2

bod kyi ser slo ba/nas rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs shing rab tu byung nas lo ngo du ma'i ring dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas pa'i grub 'bras la sangs rgyal chos lugs de gsar gtod thub pa byung / de ni da lta'i dus 'dir bshad na 'dzam gling chos lugs chen po gsum gyi ya gyal du bgrangs la de la dga' gus byed mkhan dang ngos 'dzin gsal bo byung mkhan gyi mi grangs ches mang la/ rgyal khab dang yul khams so so na dar khyab ha cang che mod/ 'on kyang mi mang bo'i ngos 'dzin byed stangs kyi thad nas de la sangs rgyas chos lugs dang nang bstan chos lugs/ nang pa'i bstan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ nang bstan shes rig sogs ming 'dogs tshul sna tshogs yod la ming 'dogs don dang mi/nga de dag gi khyad par sogs zhib mo zhig gsal cha med mod/ mthar gtug na dam pa'i chos zhes pa dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes pa de dus de nas byung /khong yul wa ra ṇa sir byon nas 'khor lnga lde bzang po la chos 'khor dang po bskor bas dge 'dun gyi sde grub pa dang / slar yang yab sras mjal bar rgyal po'i khab tu byon skabs mgon med zas spyin gyis mthun rkyen sbyar nas ston pa'i bzhugs gnas su gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi brang khang brtsigs pas grong las dgar ba'i dgon pa thog mar grub/de nas 'od srung chen po dang / kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa sha nā'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyer sbas/ 'phags nga/ dhi ti ka dgra bcom pa 3

lo ma dmar po/nag po/ legs mthong chen po ste bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang / dgra bcom pa chos skyobs dang / dbyangs sgrogs/ dbyig gshes/ sangs rgyas lha ste chen po bzhir grags pa so sor slob ma 'bum phrag gi grangs longs pa rnams byon nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa dang /slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang de'i slob ma nā ga hā dang ār+ya de ba/ nā ga bo dhi dang klu'i byang chub sogs dang /ār+ya de ba'i slob ma dmangs rigs sgra gcan 'dzin dang / bzang po dang /snyeb dpon dpa' bo sogs dang / ston pa 'das nas lo dgu brgya na slob dpon thogs med sku mched dang / dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma rang las ma/khas pa bzhi ste/ tshad ma rang las mkhas nga slob dpon phyogs kyi glang bo / 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa slob dpon yon tan 'od/ mngon pa rang las mkhas pa slob dpon blo gros bstan pa/ phal phyin rang las mkhas pa 'phags pa rnam grol ste zhes grags pa dang / klu sgrub kyi slob ma dge srung las slob dpon legs ldan 'byed dang sangs rgyas bskyangs gnyis byon te thal rang gi shing rta'i srol phyes/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la bud+dha'i slob ma zla ba grags pas thal 'gyur gyi sgra phyogs bcur bsgrags/slobangadapon phyogs glang sogs kyi slob ma na len dra'i mkhan po chos skyong zhes bya ba'i slob ma slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha/ tsan+d+ra go mi dang 'di gnyis la rmad byung gi slob dpon gnyis zhes grags/ phyogs kyi glang bo'i 4

bod kyi ser mo ba/slob ma rgol ba dbang phyug sde las tshad ma dang slob dpon chos skyong las sde snad gsum gyi zil dngar bzhes pa dpal chos kyi grags pa ni phyogs kyi glang po gnyis par grags/ de ltar ston pa nyid kyis lung bstan pa ltar bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i slob ma zab mo lta ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed pa po/ sangs rgyas gnyi sa pa dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / rje btsun byams pa'i slob ma rgya chen spyod pa'i rang lugs/ kyis 'jam bu gling khyab par me dzad pa po/'phags pa thogs med/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung zhing /phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal pa'i dngos grub mnyes pa dngos stobs rigs pa'i srol 'byed/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po bcas la gzhung 'byed pa po gsum dang / klu sgrub kyi slob ma slob dpon ār+ya de ba dang / thogs med kyi gcung slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ phyogs kyi glang bo'i slob ma dbang phyug sde'i rjes su zhugs pa dpal chos kyi grags pa rnams la 'grel ba byed pa po gsum ste/ 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug ces yongs su grags/ da dung mkhan po rnam snang bzang bo las sher phyin gsan cing ma pham pa las dbugs dbyung ḍi+ob pa'i slob dpon seng ge bzang bo/ de'i slob ma sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs kyis phar phyin dang / yon tan 'od kyi slob ma shākya 'od dang dharma mi tā dang dgra bcom pa se ga'i lha 15

lo ma dmar po/ sogs kyis 'dul bstan spel/ spyir 'dul ba la bshes gnyen drug dang /phar phyin la bka' bab drug ces grags pa/ yang bi tra ma shrī lar nyi zla lta bu'i mkhas pa sgo drug ces grags pa ni slob dpon ran+ta a ka ra shārnyi dang / sher 'byung sbas dang / ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ paṇa chen na ro cipa/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ dz+nyā na shrī mi tra rnams byon/ de nas jo bo rje dī bam ka ra dang / rdo rje gdan du a bha ya ka ra/ ma hā parnyi ta shākya shrī sogs kyis bstan pa bzung /0 khyad par sngags kyi bstan pa la/ ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya tsam/ nas dpal sa ra ha dang / de'i slob ma grub pa'i dbang phyug lū i pa dang / ṭom+bi ba dang / lwa ba pa/ dwa ka ba/ dza lwan+ta ra/ nag po spyod pa/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i do rje / ku ku ri pa/ lha l+li pa dang dus zhabs chen po'i slob ma nā ro ba/ nā ro ba dang shā ba ri'i slob ma me tri pa sogs kyis bstan pa rgya cher skyel pa ni chos 'byung lo rgyus du mar yod pas 'dir phyogs tsam las bkod med/ de ltar ston mchog thugs rje can nas rgya gar gyi mkhas shing grub pa'i mnga' bdag skyes chen dam pa gnam gyi rgyu skar bzhin bar ma chad par byon pa de dag ni da lta'i nga tsho'i bod kyi ser rme+o ba'i mi rabs gong ma dang pha mes yang mes su ngos 'dzin byed dgos pas 'di ni de'i 'byung khungs yin zhes thog ma'i dbu khyud kyi tshul du bris pa yin no/ 2 bod kyi grwa ba'i thog ma ni bod kyi rgya' bo /khri srong lde'u btsan gyi /6

bod kyi ser mo ba sku ring la sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas dge 'dun gyi sde thog mar btsugs pa nas byung bar bshad kyang / de'i yan gyi srong btsan gyi skabs blon po thon mi sam bho ṭa soṭa chos don du gnyer mkhan dang chos dpe gzhung lugs mang po bod du sgyur mkhan gyi mkhas pa mang po byon pa rnams kyang bod kyi ban ser mo ba de thog mar byung ba'i mtshon rtags su grub/gang yin zhe na / (1)srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭas rgya gar du dka' ba spyad nas nang ba'i slob dpon du ma bsten cing thun mong gi rig gnas dang thun min nang ba'i chos gzhung du ma zhig kyang gsan phyir rang yul du 'byoru dus kyang rig gnas kyi thad bod yig gsar gtod byas pa sogs bka' drin gzhal du med pa dang chos phyogs nas kyang / 〈spang stong phyag rgya ba〉 dang 〈mdo sde za ma tog〉 sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos dpe sna kha nyi shu rtsa gcig bod skad du bsgyur ba sogs bstan pa la thog ma'i dbu drangs pa lta bu'i bya ba rgya cher spel ba ma zad sku mkhar ma rur sku mtshams la bsdad pa pa dang bod kyi rgyal bos snga mar snga mar bsten pa sogs dang / gzhan de dus ‘‘sad mi mi bdun rab tu ma byung phan chad nyang bran pa bong khar thugs rje chen po'i rnalari 'byor pa'i ral ba can brgya phrag tsam rgyud du byung bar bshad’’pa dang deng sang 〈ma ṇi bka' 'bum〉 zhes grags pa de yang dus der gsungs pa rnams phyogs 7

lo ma dmar po/ bka' 'ab3〉 8byas grags pa dpya da༈ dpyar gsangs pa rnams phyastugs gca.ag tu bsdoms pa'i rgyal po'i bka' chems kyi skor rnams gter du sbas pa de'i phyis grub chen dngos grub dang mnga' bdag nyang ston pa shākya 'od sogs kyis gter nas bton pa yin pas de ni bod chos kyi thog ma yin par bshad pa sogs la bltas na de dus nas bod kyi ban de yod par mngon/ ma zad 〈spang sto nga phyag rgya ba〉 dang 〈tsan+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs〉 〈mdo sde za ma tog〉 sogs bed kyi rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa lha tho tho ri'i dus su byung ba yang khyod kyi gdung rabs lnga ba na 'di'i don shes par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan thob nga/ bzhin bod sgo nga la de'i skabs de dag gi don shes pa dang / don nyams su len mkhan gyi ched las ma/khas can rab dang rimo pa zhig byung yod pa 'di dag mdor bsdus na de'i skabs kyi bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i rigs yin pa gzhi nas shes thub/(2) khri lde gtsug brtan gyi ring yang / blon po bran ka mu le ko ṣa dang /gnyag dz+nyā na ku ma gnyis hin dhur chos len du btang bas/ khong gnyis gangs ri ti ser slebs skabs/ derage sgom byas nas bzhugs pa'i rgya gar gyi pan+ti ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis dang mjal nas khong gnyis kyi thugs la yod pa'i 〈mdo sde las rnam par 'byed pa〉dang /〈gser 'od dam pa〉dang 〈rnam 'byor rgyud〉 〈bya rgyud〉bcas blo /8

bod kyi ser mo ba/ la bzung nas 'ongs ba rgyal trepor phul ba dang / yang ‘‘thang gi blon chen 'ba' de'u'i bu sang shi'i gtso'i mi bzhi gong ma thang zhon tsung gi sar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos dpe gsol ras zhu bar btang / thang zhon tsung gis kyang mthing shag la gser gyis byis pa'i chos dpe le on stong sprad/ hran zhi zhing chen gyi ri bo rtse lnga'i nye 'dabs su sdod pa'i hwa shang nyi ma la chos zhus shing / hwa shang des kyang 〈dge ba bcu'i mdo〉 dang 〈rdo rje gcod pa〉 〈sa lu ljang ba'i ma do/〉〉 bcas dpe gsum bskur bami’ pa dang /hwa shang gis bskur ba'i chos dpe khag gsum de rgya yi la tsā ba me māgo dang / sang shi/ bod kyi la tsā ba kha che a shan gsum gyis gsang ba'i sgos bod skad du bsgyur ba sogasakyi lo rgyus la bltas na sangs rgyas kyi chos gzhung la slo ba gnyer byed mkhan dang de dag la rang 'gul gyis rtsom sgyur gyi las ka sgrub mkhan kyi don gnyer ba de dag ni don ngo mas bod kyi ser mo ba yin pa las gzhan min/( 3) khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs dge 'dun gyi sde lags su btsugs nas bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas nges gtan zhig chags pa'i lo rgyus ni thog mar bod kyi mi la rab byung btub bam nyams sad pa'i phyir/ zhang blon dad pa can rba khri gawigs rab tu byung bar rgyal bos gsol bas/ bo dhi sa twas mkhan po dang / dwa na shī la dang dzi na mi tra gnyis kyis las slob dang gsang ston/ parnyi ta gzhan bcus kha skyong mjad 19

lo ma dmar po/nas rab tu byung ste bsnyen par dzo+ogasapa dngu / de nasarim bzhin rba gsal snang dang / pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ me rin chen mchog/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ la gsum rgyal ba'i byang chub bcas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa de la bod kyi sad mi mi bdun zhes bod kyi rab byung ba'i thog ma yin par bshad/ de nas rgyal bos bod la rab byung btub par dgongs nas zhing blon tra ma dang /'bangs blo gas la ba sum brgya tsam rab tu byung / de nas ‘‘ma/chan nyid speg pa'i bshad grwa dang / gsang sngags kyi sgom grwa mang bo btsugs/ rje 'bangs rnams kyi rab byung ba dbu'i mchod gnas su phyungs shing / dbu zlum/ ma/do dang / lcang la sngags pa ste dge 'dun gyi sde gnyis su bkas bcad nas/ phyag mchod bkur bsti bya ba'i chos kyi bka' khrims chen po bcas pa smi ’ de nas bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i dbu 'phangs mtho ru song ba dang de'i bya gzhag kyang rlabs che ru song ba'o/ 'on kyang de dag gi rmang gzhi ni srong btsan skabs nas chos la mkhas pa'i blon po dang chos byed dge 'dun pa'i rigs du ma zhig gis yun ring bor chos dang bka' bstan gyi glegs bam mang po dar rgyas su btang ba ma zad de'i shugs rkyen dang bag chags shugs chen po bod kyi yul la thebs su bcug pa'i rlabs chen gyi bya ba de dag yin par gdon mi za/ des na rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa lha tho tho ri yi dus chos dpe de tsho'i don go ba med par bshad pa don snyel nya(/

gnas na/ de dus bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i rigs tsam yang tshed pa de shes thub/ srong btsan skabs nas bod kyi ser mo ba de rim bzhin byung bar mngon/ de yang / dus rim gyi steng nas dgar na/ srong btsan skabs 7bod kyi ser mo ba'i myu gu gsar du 'bus pa'i dus rim dang / khri srong skabs bod kyi dge 'dun gyi sde dngos su btsugs pa des bod kyi ser mo ba'i rtsa ba tshugs pa'i dus rim dang mnga' bdag khri ral can gyi dus yang bskyar dge 'dun gyi sde la gzigs rtogs tshad med byas pa dang sangs rgyas chos dpe rtsom/ sgyur gyi pas —kar bkas bcad mjad nga/ sogs kyi rgyab skyor tshad med thob pa des bod kyi ser mo ba'i 'dab lag rgyas pa'i dus rim dang / bstan pa spyo dar gyi mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dus tshod dedus rabs bcu gcig pa nas bcu bdun pa'i bar ni bod kyi ser mo ba'i yal ga dang lo 'dab phyogs brgyar bres pa'i ches dar rgyas che ba'i dus rim zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed chog de dag tshang ma lo rgyus dngos yin pa las lha sgrung dang ngag rgyun tsam zhig gtan nas min pa shes dgos/ 2004 1 52/

byu bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i ma/ dzad rjes/ co de'i bla med kyi mdzad rjes ni/ nga tsho'i bod kyi ban ser mo ba'am bod kyi chos byed dge 'dun pa rnams kyis ni 'gro ba spyi dang de'i nang nas kyang 'dzam gling gi mi/'i rigs thun mong la bzhag nga 'i mdzad rjes ni nam yang bsub tu mi btub la/khyad par bod kyi spyi sdugs la bzhag ba'i mdzad rjes ni ngo mtshar zhing khyad du 'phags pa bla na med pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang de dag re re bzhin brjod dgos na thams cad brjod kyis ga la lang / khyad par rig gnas dang shes rgya zhan pa'i phran rang lta bu la mtshon na de ni brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ ci yin zhe na/ gong du bshad pa'i ban ser mo ba'i thog mar byung ba'i skas rim de nas bzung da lta'i bar la ngo stong ltag gi la rgyus ring mo'i brgyud rim khrod chos srid gnyis dang lag shes bzo las gso dpyad sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad bod mi rigs la zhabs 'degs mtha' yas pa zhig bsgrubs yod pa ma zad mi rigs nyen kha tshabs chen la thugs pa'i dus skabs gang zhig yin yang / bod kyi ser mo bas de la srung skyob dang slar gso/'i nus pa gang la de 'tsham gyi rtsa ba'i sgul shugs 22

chen po ma thon sa gcigacho kyang med pa lta bu red la/ bod kyi ser mo ba'i rigs kyis bod kyi shes ldan mi sna'i dpung dang sde khag gi gal che'i go gnas bzung yod pa ma zad mi'i rigs kyi shes yon pa tshad mtho'i gal che'i go gnas de yang nam yang bzung 'dug pas/ des ni 'jig rten 'di'i skye bo'i tshogs kyi shes rig gi bsame blo'i kha phyogs dang lam phyogs la mdzub ston dang sne khrid kyi nus 'gan gcig lcogs su bzhes yod pa zhig kyang yin nga smos ci dgos/ de yang che long tsam/ 'ig brjod pa'i dbang du btang na/1 bod kyi spyi chogs nyen kha'i gnas las bskyabs pa ni /(1) chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod la yi ge med pas phyi 'brel dang nang khul srid 'dzin do dam lam lugs lag len sogs la dka' khag ha cang chen po byung ba'i dus der slob dpon thon mis bod yig gsar bzo byas pas de'i skabs kyi chab dpal rig gsum la phan pa rgya cher byas pa ma zad dus da lta'i bar bod mi rigs kyi yod tshad dang yod tshad kyi gzhi rtsa dam par gyur ba dang /(2) bod kyi rgyal bo gtum po 'u dum btsan pos chos dang rig gnas gna' rdzas tha na brda sprod kyi gzhung la sogs pa bod kyi mtha' dag med par bzos rte bod btsan po rim byung gi mnga' thang stobs 'byor mtha' dag gi mjug bsdus te rgyal khab kha 'thor gyi gnas su gyar ba thugs 23

lo ma dmar po/kyis ma bzod par lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rang gi lus srog gi nyen khar ma 'dzems par mi rigs rig gnas dang bcas pa'i ches mjug mtha'i re thag de srung skyob ched dbang bsgyur ba ma rung gdug pa can der srog bsdos kyi rgyal pham brtsad pa dang /(3) yang sog po'i rgyal bo jing gir han gyis sog po'i 'go ba khag gcig gyur byas rjes rim bzhin e she ya gling dkyil ma dang nub ma yo rob gling shar rgyud bcas la rgya bskyed dmag 'khrug byas te thog mar phyi nas yong ba'i btsan 'dzul stobs shugs zil gyis ma nan mthar gzhi nas rgya nag gi yul khams so so dbang du bsdus te bod kyi yul lung la yang ham sems chen pos bod la dpung 'jug byas pas bod kyi ser skya mang tshogs khri stong mang po'i tshe srog la nyen khatshotshabs chen phog pa ma zad bod kyi chos dang rig gnas rdog brdzis byed pa'i grabs sham 'jigs snang bskul ba na/ yang sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sku ngal dang nyen kha gang la yad ma 'dzems par sog yul du byon nas bod yul lung bar gnas skabs kyi rang dbang tsam thob pa dang mi rigs med par 'gro ba'i nyen kha'i gnas las bskyabs pa dang / (4) de rjes yang 'gro mgon 'phags pa la sog po'i rgyal po hu yi li se chen han gyis gsang sngags kyi dbang dang po zhus pa'i yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum phul ba dang / dbang ṣ+pengs gnyis pa zhu dus yon du ri 24

bod chol kha gsum phul ba/ dbang thengs gsum pa zhu dus dbang yon du rgya yi mi yur chen po phul ba sogs kyi la rgyus la bltas na/ de'i skabs sog po'i rgyal po'i ham sems gdug rtsub kyi mnga' 'og tu bod la rgol lan slog pa'i nus pa med par dbang med mgo btags zhu dgos byung ba'i yid skyo ba'i mi rigs nyams nyes kyi gnas tshul dza drag byung ba de las skyob rme/khan ni ma/thar gtug na 'gro ma gon 'phags nga yin nga snyer sa ga'/na zhig byung thub re/da la/ 'gro mgon 'phags nga ni rgya'i mi se ra da'i /ra gsod/ byed pa'i ngan spyod khrel med kyi las ka pa ya nga sha tsha ba'i chos nga/ rna'i / dag cig yin pa sogs shes thub/ ma zad de rjes ya nga so ga ngedze/'i rgyal bo sde chen gyis bod yul du sa skya ba'i chos lu gas gcig pu las chos lugs gzhan dag tshang ma med par byed grabs byed dus 'pha gas/ pas zhu ba sna shisags bton nas chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra ba so sor gnod 'tshe thebs su ma bcug par nyen kha'i gnas las bskyabs pa red/de dang de 'dra'i dper mtshon gtso bo'i mi sna re 'ga' bkod pas kyang zur bltas leb mthong gi tshul kyis de'i bla med mdzad rjes dang 'khor med bka' drin gyi don dngos lo rgyus gsal rtogs thub na re re bzhin brjod pa'i tshig tshogs kyis ngal ba ma byas so/2 bsam blo gsar gtod kyi phyogs ni/mi dang dud 'gro'i khyad par gtso bo ni bya ba gang la yang shes 25

lo ma dmar po/rtogs kyis 'jug min dang / bya ba gang la yang rtogs dpyod kyi sngon 'gro'i cha skyen yod med kyi steng nas phye dgos na/ mis bya ba byed stangs ni bsam gzhig gi nus par brten nas 'gro la/ mi'i spyi tshogs kyis bya ba byed stangs ni srol rgyun gyi lta ba dang bsam blo gsar ba'i mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs kyi mdzub ston gyi sne khrid la brten nas 'gro ba las 'os me/da pa zhig yin pas/ mi rigs zhig la mtshon na mtshan snyed rigs pa'i gzhung lugs ngepre can zhig bsam/ blo'i kha phyogs kyi rten gzhir cis kyang dgos na/ nga tsho bod mi rigs la de'i cha rkyen phun sum tshogs par yod pa ni yang gzhan ma yin par gzhan las dmigs su bsal ba'i bod kyi shes rig pa'i sde khag ste dge 'dun pa'i rigs kyi bka' drin yin pa bsnyon du med/ de yang / 'brom ston patrī rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang / sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ phywa ba chos kyi seṅge/ rje tshong kha ba blo bzang grags pa/ rdzo nang ta ra na tha sogs kyis rang rang gi mtshan nyid rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la nang byan chud cing / brgal brtags rigs pa'i lhan sbyangs kyi nus pa yang rtser son nas thun min gyi lta ba khyad par ba re gsar gtod byas pa de ni u tshugs kyis gzhan la lad mo byas pa zhig dang / yang na ched du don med rnyog dra bzos pa zhig dang gtan mi 'dra bar/ rang rang gi bsam blo dang lag len zung 'brel gyi 26

bod kyi ser mo ba/ cisngar med gzhung lugs gsar 'dzugs byas pa yin pas/ des gangs ri'i ljongaso 'dir bsam blo'i dpal yon gyis rab tu phyug par mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni nam yang gzhal du med do/ bod kyi bsam blo ba de dag gang ji snyed cig gis dus 4rabs re re'i dkyog mtshams dang lo rgyus re re'i 'pho 'gyur gang la yang bsam blo'i mdzub ston dang gzhung lugs kyi sne khrid la nor 'khrul gyi gom kha 'dzol ba'i dpe ngan gcig kyang don dngos su med/ 3 lag rtsal dang gso rig gi skor ni/lag rtsal shes bya'i skor nas bshad na bod kyi lha ris ri mo'i sgyu rtsal ni 'dzam gling gi mdzes rtsal kun gyi ya gyal zhig tu kun gyis bsngags brjod byed bzhin yod pa 'di yang sman lugs dang sgab lugs gang yin kyang rang rang gi thun min gsar gtod kyi nying bcud bla na med pa mnga' bas de'i brgyud rim la phyir lta byas na de yang bod kyi ser mo ba'i mdzad rjes zhig las gzhan ci/ ma zad mgar dang rdzas sbyor gyi skor sogs la yang bod kyi ser mo bas lag rjes ma gzhag sa zhig med pa lta bu ni dper na/ 'ju mi phams kyi 〈bzo yig pa tra 〉 dang de'u dmar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi 〈rig pa bzo yi gnas kyi las tshogs/〉〉sogs su/ gser dngul btso btul dang dam sprad lugs gser dngul kyi shag bu bzo thabs/ gser dang dngul g.yu sogs kyi rtsi bzo thabs 27

lo ma dmar po/ dang / g.yu bzo thabs/ me shel dang chu shel sogs shel sna tshogs dang /dkar yol dang tshon sna tshogs/ ras dang phying ba shag bu dar gos sogs kyi ri mo'i lag shes lta bus mtshon gser 'gyur rtsi dang lcags la rtsi nag byugs pa gser dngul zangs tsholcags la bskos dkrol cidang 'bur dod ri mo phab stangs mu zi'i sbyor ba dang tshwa la sdebs stangs/ shag bu dang snag tsha'i lag shes dang spos sbyor kyi lag shes sogs tha na dngos rdzas kyi dri nag 'don stangs nas gser dngul zangs ñca gas kyi mgar gyi lag shes dang rdo dang shrīng gzhog gi lag shes sogs kyi bar 'tsho ba'i rgyun spyod gong yod kyi lag shes bzo las ma 'dus pa med pa lta bu red/ ya nga grub thab nga/ thang stang rgyal pa 'am lcags zam pa brtsan 'grus bzang pas lcags rigs kyi gter kha blangs ba dang chu bo dang gcong rong mang por lcags zab btsugs pa dus da lta'i bar du mthong rgyu yod pa lu'u ting lcags zam lta bu dang khong gis lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung brtsams pa dang zlos gar 'khrab ston gyi las la ma smad pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag pa lta bu ni mi gcig gi las ka yin pas 'di tsam yang dper rung ba ma yin nam/gso rig skor ni/ khyad par bod kyi bod lugs gso dpyad rig pa de ni ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar 'phel rgyas byung ba'i lo rgyus ji ltar rgyun 'dzin dang gsar gtod byas pa'i lo rgyus gang la bltas kyang /snga phyi bar gsum du pur rgyal gling dgu'i ljongs 'dir gso dpyad dar 28

bod kyi ser mo ba/bar mdzad pa'i sman pa dge ba'i gshes gnyen dpag tu med pa zhig byon na'ang thams cad la yongs su grags pa ni/ parnyi ta ltar mkhas pa gcig ces pa lo chen rin chen bzang po/ nam mkha' ltar khyab pa gcig ni skyes bu me lha phyag rdum/ de nas/ nyi zla ltar grags pa gnyis/ mnga' bdag gi sman pa gnang ba rjes gnang dgu sprul ba'i 'gro don mdzad pa bcu/sbyangs stobs yon tan gyi che ba drug rig gsum sprul pa'i skyes bu gsum / yongs grags sman lha bcu/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan pa'i sman lha gcig —rgyud dono lag tu len nga/ gnyis/ sngon sbyangos las 'phro sad pa dgu/ dbya/da mag sa sar than pa bcu/ grags pa gla bur du than pa drugagrags pa hor gyi ston pa lnga/ dpyad la nang byan tshud pa gnyis/ rgyal po ltar grags pa gcig srog shing lta bu dgu sogs kyis 'gro phan zla ba'i 'phel ba la 'gran pa mdzad/phyis su gso rig spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dka' gnad mdud pa bkrol te rig gnas rtse mo 'di'i bstan pa'i bdag po lta bu mkhas pa byang zur gnyis zhes grags che ba byung ba dang / g.yu thog pa gsar snying zhes pa'i mdzad rjes kho nas kyang dbang med yid kyi brtan pa mi 'phrog pa su zhig yod/ gso dpyad gzhung dang de'i lag len gang thad nas rjes sor rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis gshag bcos kyi lag rtsal dang de'i cha lag nyams pa sor chud ma thub pa de yid phangs pa zhig yin 29

lo ma dmar po/na yang da lta bshad na 'dzam gling gi rin bral nor bu lta bu'i mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo gsar ba'i nying bcud cig tu 'dug go/ 4 rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang bskyar gso'i nus pa gzhan la ngo mtshar ba ni/ rijibastan pa phyi dar zhes pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang khyad par 'dul bstan slar gso byas pa zhig la go ba blangs na sgra dog 'jug gi dbang du btang ba tsam las don ngo ma/ra bod kyi skad yig dang rtsom rig gi gtso'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi phyogs yongs rmang nas bsgyel char ba de slar yang kha tsha dgos gtugs kyis bskyar gso byas pa zhig red pas/ des bod kyi de'i skabs kyi mun nag dang rmong ba'i spyi chogs shig la thad kar rgol lan sprad pa'i rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha ngo ma zhig blangs pa mtshon la/ des kyang bod kyi shes ldan pa'i dpa' ngar dang snying stobs ngo ma zhig thog mtha' bar gsum du mtshon yod pa red/ de'i skabs kyi bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum dang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bcas ni bod kyi lo rgyus kyi mi sna 'gangs chen zhig tu brtsi don yang de'icho skabs kyi rig gnas bskyar gso'i mdzad rjes rlabs che ba dang mi rigs nyams nyen gyi gnas las bskyabs pe'i bka' drin che ba zhig gi ngos nas bshad pa min na ci zhig yi na/ de'i brgyud rim ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i dpe cha 'ga' drel la bkal nas bros byol du phyin pa nas gar log dang hor yul 30

khamasarnamasasu phebasapa dang / gnasadanatig shel gyi yang dgon ducarwakhigazhingakāldagasal/gzhan la rab byung dang bsnyen rjogs bsgrub dus dge slong lnga ma tshang bar rgya'i hwa shang mngags te/‘‘lngas tshan’’gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i bar gyi dus rim nges can zhig tu dka' ngal che ba'i la zla zhig brgyud myong la/ dbus kyi mkhas pa klu mes la slob ma ka ba bzhi dang / gdung ma brgyad/ phyam so gnyis/ dral ma stong rtsa sogs byung nas bstan pa nyams pa meng nas gsos pa'i bar gyi mdzad rjes thams cad dka' spyad kyi khur khyer pa las byung ba zhig yin pa las rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs khoru yug gis khyod la 'bad rtsol mi dgos par bton gnang mdzad pa zhig gang na yin/de'i bar rab tu byung ba med kyang khyim pa rnams kyis dkon mchog la gus par byas te lha sa bsam yas soyis su gtsug lag khang 0khyegs par bsrung bas ma zhig pa dang / ‘‘sngags pa gos dkar khyim pa'i rten can rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim dang dben pa'i ri sul rnams su bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i bshad sgrub kyi rgyun bzung bas snga 'gyur gsang sngags kyi rgyun gtan nas ma nub cing / bstan pa spyo la'ang gus pas sngar mes dbon mes dbon rnam gsum gyi dus su bsgyur ba'i bka' bstan gyi glegs bam rnams leṭa par bsrung ba'i bka' drin gyis snga 'gyur gyi mdo rgyud phal che ba dus da lta'i bar du langs spyod kyi yod pa 'di nyid byung ’’ ba sogs ni 3/

lo ma dmar po/ nye dus ‘‘rig gsar god chag ’’ gis bod kyi chos sridwa rig gnas rtsa brlag gi byed thabs spel skabs bod kyi ser skya mang tshogs kyis gsang ba'i sgos rig gnas dang rig gnas dngos rdzus srung skyob byas pa'i tshul dang gcig 'dra red/rjes su yang sngar thon mi sam bho ṭas sgra'i bstan bcos chen po brgyad ma dzad ces grags pa yang ci/ glang dar gyi dume su med par song ba yin na yang surme rtags gnyis zhes yig tshogs nyung zhing mdor sgril ba'i rtsa tshig 'di lta bu'i gzhi la brten nas/ pra ti dge bshes dang si tu paṇa chen/ gnam gling ba/ bstan dar lha ram pa sogs kyis sum rtags dag gsum gyi bod rang gi brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang gi srol btod pa de yang rigs gnas nyams pa bskyar gso'i zur zhig gis mi dman pa'i nus pa thon pa ma yin nam/ yang gcig bshad na/ bod la ngo lag zing 'khrug rtses pa'i rjes nas gnam sa bla 'og brjes pa lta bu'i 'pho 'gyur dang nyams nyes god chag gi dus ngan ya nga zhig byung ba ni/sus kyang la rgyus kyi yig char blta mi dgos par rang sems kyi me long ngos na wa ler 'char thub pa zhig red la/ de ni bod kyi rig gnas dang 'tsho ba/ bsam blo/ dngos rdzas/ mi sna sogs thams cad gad snyigs kyi phung po'i khrod gtsang phyag byed 'dod pa'i bya 'gul zhig yin pas/ yon tan pa dang byas rjes can la bkur bzos kyi ya rabs tshul ldan gyi lugs 32

bod kyi ser mo ba/ srol dang / pha ma dang bu phrug bar gyi brtse sems/ dge rgan dang slob ma'i bar gyi yid ches/ nye 'brel dang grwa rogs groṭa mched bar gyi zhe 'dang /tha na khyim mi dang bza' tshang bar gyi 'brel ba sogs kyang med par bzos te mdor na rgan bkur grogs mthun gyi ya rabs spyod bzang zer ba zhig mig gis kyang mthong mi thub par chos dang rig gnas/ skad yig dang lugs srol thams cad yug gcig tu sa snyepa lan gcig brdabs pa ni bod lo rgyus steng nas rgyal po khri ral can gyi ma gul gcus nas bkrongs pa dang / dpe cha mer bsregs pa/ lha sku gtor brdung byas pa/ dpe cha ba dang grwa btsun yen tan nga 'i rigs med par byas pa'i glang dar skabs kyi god chag gnyis pa zhig slar yang byung ba red༈'on kyang / lo ngo bcu lhag gi rjes nas yang bskyar bod kyi rig gnas zer ba zhig dang bod kyi dpe rnying zer ba zhig bod kyi chos lugs zer ba/ la rgyus zer ba/ bsam blo zer ba/ yul srol goms gshis zer ba/ brda sprod dang rtsom rig zer ba/ zlos gar dang 'khrab gzhung zer ba sogs kyang gcig rjes gnyis mthud nas rim bzhin byung zhing / 'dzam gling gi mi rigs so so'i mig lam du bstar chog pa zhig byung ba de la phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen gang mang zhig brtsi rgyu yod kyang / gco bo ni bod kyi shes ldan pa ste deng rabs bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang bo dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las dang tshe tan zhabs drung / dmu dge bsam gtan/3 3

lo ma dmar po/mkhyen rab 'od gsal/ rdo rje rgyal po/ bsam 'grub rgya maḥrto sogs kyis dka' spyad gang mang zhig gis mthun rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas byung ba yin la/ de yang thog mar dgon pa nas gso skyong byas la dgon pa nas mthar phyin pa'i dge 'dun(pa'i dpung khag cig gis shugs gang yod bton pa'i lag rjes su grub pa yin la/ rig gnas kyi khyab khongs yang thog mar dgon khag so so bskyar 'dzugs byas pa la brten nas sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur ba red//de lta ra mdor bsdu sa shrīg las 'dir bris me de kyang / tshig gcig gis brjod na bod kyi ser mo ba'i spyi tshogs re rer bzhag pa'i mjad rjes ni rgya che zhing grangs mang ba zhig red la/ dus chorabs re rer bzhag pa'i mdzad rjes ni phul du byung zhing bla na med pa zhig red/ khong rname sa kyi gshegs shul re re na la rgyus kyi dpang rtags re re dang khong rnams kyi rjes shul re re na mi'i rigs la bzhag pa'i brtse sems re re/ de dang de ni nga tsho gangs can bod mi'i la rgya red la de dang de ni nga tsho bod kyi ser mo ba'i 'das song gi lo rgyus kyi gzi byin red/mi 2004 1 1534

bod kyi ser mo ba/〈bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa 〉〉 la nodabye zhib byed pa/'dir krod kyitsho se/ra cho/ ba'i skor gyi dpyad rtsom/ nyung ngu zhig rgya che'i gzigs 4 /khan rnam nga/'i spyan sngar 'bul don phran gyis bod kyi chos byed dge 'dun pa'i snyago grags dang theb thang 'che ba spyi chogs kyi 'brelnga ba bcas phyogs yongs nas rang 'gul gyis zhib 'jug dang dpyad pa cung zad re rgyag khul byas pa'i go rims khrod 〈bod kyi chos srid zung rī'abrel skor bshad pa〉 zhes pa'i dpe deb 'di la lan mang lta dgos byung /ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni gtso bo da skabs mi gang mang zhig gis bod kyi ser mo ba'i la rgyus dang thob thang la bsam gzhigs byed skabs dpe deb 'di'i lta tshul gtsor bzung nas so so'i bsam tshul k+ṣeng gi yod pa dang / khyad par da lta 'ga' zhig gis chos srid gnyis me chu ltar lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi dngos 'gal du 'dod pa dang / yang bod kyi chos byed dge 'dun pa rnam/sa ni bod kyi 'phel rgyas dang yar thon la bkag 'gog byed pa'i nyes can du smra mkhan yod pa de dag gi 'dod blo ni mthar gtuṭa 35

95ོ 34 da34zung po/na dpe deb 'di'i nang don bshākyad bsgrags byed bsams zhig las ma 'das bar mngon/ de'i rkyen gyis nyan shul mkhyen rab 'od gsal gyis/‘‘chos ldan rgya'/ khab 'dzam gling kun tu yod// chos srid zung 'brel bod kyi yul du dar// chos lda na cam gyis rgyal khab mi nub kyang // zung du sbrel bas gnyis ka'i nurme pa shar// ’’ zhes sogs kyi bsam blo de dpyad ga'ir bzung dhe dpe deb 'di'i chig don gnyis ka'i cha la dbye zhib byed rgyur spro ba brtas se/ gcig spyi'i cha nas bltas na// brdzod bya gco pe/ ‘‘chos srid zung 'brel ’ zhes pa de chos bdag rgyal bo gnyis ka mi gcig gis byed pa la zer ba dang/ baṃd kyi chos srid zung 'brel de sa skya ba nas rma/go bzung ba dang (‘dmangs gco bcos sgyur ’’ dang ‘‘ngo log zing 'khrug ’tsho’ nas mjug rdzogs pa/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel byung rkyen ni nge da la sangs rgyas chos sdo/gas dar ba dang gnas pa 'phel rgyas bcas byung ba'i lo rgyus de yin pa/ bod la chos srid zung 'brel byung ba'i mjug ribras ni gcig nas bod rang nang khul du 'khrug rtsod rgyun ma chad par byung pa dang des mi dmangs kyi 'cho ba nyin rer rje sdug tu btang ba/ gnyis nas yon rgyal rabs nas bod dang sog kre / rgya nag bcas khyim chang chen kro gcig tu gyur nas phan chun 'bral thabs med na yang / phyi'i bcan 3(

( bod kyi ser mo ba/rgyal ring lugs kyi ngan jus la brten pa dang / nang du chos lugs kyi dar cha la brten nas bod kyi log spyod pa mang bos mes rgyal la rgyab gtod thengs 'gar byas pa de red/ ma zad sangs rgyas chos lugs de bod kyi btsan po srong btsan skabs nang 'dren byas pa de yang de'i skabs dbang bsgyur ba'i chab srid dgos mkhor brten nas byung ba zhig yin pa ni sangs rgyas chos lugs rang ngos nas de'i skabs kyi dbang bsgyur ba ste bran g.yog lam lugs dang bkas bked rgyud 'jin lam lugs kyi dbang bsgyur byed thabs kyi ngo bo yongs su tshang bas rkyen yin pa/phyis su ya nga sangs rgyas chos sum̐gs ni dbang bsgyur ba kho nas dbang bsgyur lag cha zhig tu bed spyad nas mi rabs nas mi rabs bod yul lung bar mang tshogs la gnya' gnon bshu gzhog byas la/ khyad par bod la chos srid zung 'brel gyi 'a ma lugs dar ba nas chos byed dge 'dun pa kho nas dbang bsgyur gyi lag cha ngo ma zhig tu gyur nas bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum med par btang song bas/ bod kyi chos byed dge 'dun pa'am bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i rigs ni dbang bsgyur ba'i che shas dang mi dmangs la mgo skor gtong mkhan gyi g.yo sgyu ba dang bshu gzhog byed mkhan zhig yin na yang dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byas rjes bod yongs gzhi nas bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel zhing bran lam lugs kyi khur bo'i 'og nas bcings grol thob pa red ces bstan /37

lo ma dmar po/2 go rim sgrig stangs ni/ go rim gyi steng nas brjod na/ rtsom pa po khong nyid kyis gsungs pa ltar/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de gang 'dra byas nas byung ba dang / de'i 'phel rgyas kyi go rim/ mthar ji ltar byas nas rtsa med du song ba bcas kyi brgyud rim la brten nas brjod yod la/ de yang / dang po botshod kyi chos sri da zung 'brel de gang 'dra byas nas byung ba brjod skabs/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs 4 byung gong gi chos srid tha dad du gnas pa'i dus skabs kyi gnas tshul dang / chos lugs phan chun bar gyi 'thab rtsod skor bshad la/ de'i brjod don gartsa bo ni chos srid tha dad du gnas pa'i dus te srong bcan yan gyi bon chos dus kyi spyi tshogs gnas chul dang / srong btsan rjes kyi ban bon gnyis 'gal skabs kyi spyi tshogs gnas tshul/ ban bon bar gyi 'thab rtsod la ṣ+pengs bzhi phyes te bshad pa/ bod la sangs rgyas mos lugs dar spel thub pa ni skabs de'i bod kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'brel ba mthun po yod pa'i rkyen yin pa/ glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs thub pa lka yang mang tshogs kyis bsam blo'i rgyab skyor yod pas rkyen yin pa bcas so/ gnyis pa/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi 'phel rgyas kyi go rim bshad skabs/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs dngos su mugo tshugs pa dang / chos lugs grub ma tha' khag gi mtho rim mi snas chos lugs 38

bod kyi ser mo ba/bed spyad nas phan tshun srid dbang 'phrog res byas pa'i 'thab rtsod skor bshad la/ de'i nang don gtso bo ni/ sa skya ba nas bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel dngos su mgo tshugs pa dang/ des ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi/ sna rnams dpal 'byor thog gi zhing bdag gral rim zhig yin pa nas chab srid thog gi dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi go gnas su slebs pa de ma/chon la/ chos lugs phan tshun bar gyi srid dbang phrog res ni /(1) sa skya ba dang 'bri gung ba gnyis bar dang / (2) phag pre gru ba'i nang khul/ (3) rin spungs pa dang dge lugs nga/'i bar/ (4 ) gcang ba sde sri da dang dge lugs nga 'i bar/ (5) gu shri han dang gtsang ba sde srid bar/((tsho) rnying ma ba dang dge lugs ba'i bar bcas kyi dam ga 'khrug bslangs nas bod kyi spyi tshogs nyams nyen du btang ba brjod yed/gsum pa/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel de ji ltar med par song ba brjod skabs/ bod kyi dbang bsgyur ba'i gras dag gis nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res kyi don rkyen bzos pa ma zad mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byas rung / tang krung dbyang dang ma'o tse tung gi thugs khur 'og mthar bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de'i ngo bo dmar rjen byas te rang shugs kyi rtsa med gyur song ba'i skor bshad la/ de'i nang don yang /bod sa gnas kyi chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po tā la'i bla ma dang bka' shag gi mi sna sogs ching srid gzhung gi bkod 'dom 'og yin pa dang / tā 39

lo ma dmar po/la'i bcu gsum pa'i u ru si dang dbyin ji sogs phyi'i btsan rgyal ba'i bslu brid la ngan 'brel byas pa dang / tā la'i bcu bzhi ba'i skabs su yang log spyod pa tshos chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha bzung ste mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byas zhes bkod yod/ 3 lo rgyus kyi mi sna bdam bkod byas te de'i gtso bo'i byas rjes/(1) shākya mu ne/des ni d+nghaskabs de'i hin dhu'i spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor 'brel bas rang gi dgongs par chul snang byung ba zhig gis/ sangs rgyas chos lugs gsar gtod byas pa de la/ rgyal rigs dang rje rigs bcas mi la rigs bzhi phyes te rus rgyud lam lugs dang rus rgyud dbang cha gsal bo dang /dka' ngal bzod thub dang bud med kyis rang gi khyo bor bkur dgos par bshad pas bran g.yog spyi tshogs dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i mtshon rtags gsal bo yod pa/ (2) srong btsan sgam po/des ni chos lugs kyi bsam blor brten nas rang gi dbang bsgyur srung skyob byed ched sangs rgyas chos lugs bod yul du dar ba byas/(3) ma zhang grom pa skyes/ des ni bon chos kyi phyogs zhen gyis lha sa'i jo khang bshas ra byas pa dang chos la dga' ba'i blon po gnyis srog thog tu btang ba sogs 40 ci

'gal ba sna ཿdzags bslangs/ (4) blon po 'gos khri bzang /des ni chos lugs kyi phyogs zhen byas te ma zhang grom pa g.yo thabs kyis gson dur sbas pa sogs byas/(5) khri srong lde'u btsan/ des ni mkhan slob gnyis gdan 'dren zhus te dge 'dun gyi sde bcugs te bsnyen bkur chad med byas/ (6) khri ral can/ de+os ni grwa ba la dmigs bsal gyi khe dbang sprad pa dang / sangs rgyas chas lugs sngar bas rgya khyab tu btang /(7) rbas brag sna/des ni bon gyi phyo+ogs bzung nas rgyal po khri ral bkrongs pa dang glang dar ma rgyal sar btan/ (8) glang dar ma/ des lha sa'i jo bo sogs chos lugs kyi yo byad tshang ma gtor ba dang grwa ba rnams la rdung rdeg tshad med byas te grwa chas gyon pa'i grwa ba mig gis mthong mi thub pa byas/(9) klu mes/ sba/ rag 'bring bcas/de dag gis nang 'khrugs byas nas bsame yas kyi gtsug lag khang 4/

lo ma dmar po/ gi 'khor sa'i lha khang mang po ser bsregs pa sogs byas/ (10) lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ des ni/ rgya gar gyi a ti sha bod du gdan 'dren zhus te mnga' ris/ lha sa/ rtse thang brag yer ba/ 'phan po bcas su chos dar bar byas/(1 1) 'brom ston pa dang 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ mkhas grubagyi khyung po rnal 'byor/ dwags po lha rje bcas/de dag gis/ rim pa ba|na/ bka' gdams pa dang / sa skya ba shangs pa bka' brgyud/ dwangs po bka' brgyud bcas kyi bstan pa spel/(12 ) 'gro ma/gon 'phags pa/ des ni yon krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bkod 'doms 'og bod sa gnas kyi chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po byas te bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel lam 'u/gas kyi mgo tshugs par byas/ (1 3)'bri gung sgosku pa kun rdor rin chen/ sa skya'i dpon chen ang len /des ni rim bzhin stod hor gyi dmag khri dgu tsam sa skya ba'i steng du drangs ba dang / se chen han gyi bu thi mu bho khas kyi dmag dpung bod khrid du yong nas gtsang dmag dang mnyam du 'bri gung par brgyab/ 'bri gung ba'i mchod gzhis mang po 'phrog (14) phag gru'i khri dpon las 'dzin pa tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan/des 'bri gung ba gtor/ g.ya' bzang ba dang / tshal ba tshar 42

bcad sa skya ba'i srid dbang 'phrog(15) 'bri gung sgom pa kun dga' rin chen/ des ni kong bo dang zhi li'i dmag dpung bskul nas dga' ldan dgon pa'i mchod gzhis rnams 'phrog pas dge lugs pa dang 'thab/dge lugs pa'i dgon pa mang po'i chos lugs dang zhwa stabs sogs bsgyur/(16) gtsang ba sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/des ni 'phan pe dang gzhis ka sne 'u sogs dmag gis blangs te bed yo ngas la dbang bsgyur byas pa dang / se 'bras nga/ga' gsum darme/ga gis gtor ba sogs byas/ (17) dge lugs pa'i sbyin bdag skyid shod sde ba bsod nam/sa rnam rgyal/ des ni sog dmag dang mnyam 'brel byas te gtsang ba rgyal por phar rgol dang dge lugs par rgyab skyor byas/(18) hal ha dpon po chog thu/ des ni/ mtsho sngon gyi sde ba yongs rdzogs blangs nas der yod dge lugs pa'i bla chen dang grwa ba mang po srog thog btang /(19) khams khul be ri rgyal po don yod/des ni khams khul gyi sa skya ba dang / dge lugs pa/ rnying ma ba gsum/ gyi dgon nga/ mang po gtor zhing bla ma mang po btson du bcug43

4 lomadamarapo /(20) gu shri han/ des ni gtsang ba kame brtan skyong dbang po chu la dor ba dang / bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang yongs rdzogs tā la'i lnga bar phul/(21) tā la'i lnga ba/ des ni bod yongs la chos srid gnyis thad nas dbang bsgyur ba dang chos sngigs dang dgon pa so so dar rgyas su btang la khyad par dge lugs par rgyab skyor byas/ dge lugs pa'i chos lugs mi snas chos srid zung 'brel kyi go gnas bzung /(22) sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/des ni se 'bras dge gsum la mchod gzhis mi ser mang po sprad pa sogs dpal 'byor steng nas dge lugs par rgyab skyor byas/(2 3) lha bzang han / des ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bkrongs ba dang / la ngo bcu gsum ring bod kyi srid dbang bzung nas tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho gnas dbyung byas/ (24) jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan/ des ni lha bzang han bsad pa dang / lo gsum ring bod la dbang bsgyu+or byas te rnying ma ba'i dgon pa mang po gtor ba dang bla chen mang po bkrangs/ ri

(25) nga lam sbyar gsum dang pho lha 'i'i ji/ da'i ching pa dur bcas/de dag gis nga lam sbyar gsum gyis da'i ching pa dur bsad pa dang / pho lha thi'i ji'i gtsang dmag khrid nas nga lam sbyar gsum pham par byas/(26) pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal 'gyur med rnam rgyal/ des ni lha sdod sku tshab am ban sogs kyis khong g.yo 'og tu dmar gosod btang mthar khong gi shag khas sku tshab am/ ban sogs rgya mi ma/nga pa dmar gsad btang / (27) lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje/ des ni khong gis gong ma la re zhu ltar tā 'a 'i bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshor bod kyi srid dbang gtad/(28) tā la'i bcu gsum pa/ des ni bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung nas hra hong gong ma dang dbyin ji sogs dang ngan 'brel byas te bod rang btsan yong ba'i re ba bcangs/gong gsal mi sna de dag dang byas rjes de dag gis rim bzhin bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi grub char rtsa ba 'i sgul shugs bton pa bstan/ rme 45

lo ma dmar po/gnyis/ bye brag gi nang gses cung zadar+ṣa dpyad na/1 don gnad che sa'i tshig 'gros 'ganya la zur dpyad ni/dung dkar ba ni bod kyi rtsom pa po dang dge rgan chen mo ba/ lha ram pa bcas yin pas don chung chung re'i steng nor ba chen po re 'byung mi srid pa lta bu zhig yin rung / khong rang nyid kyis kyang ‘‘skyon cha gang yod la dgongs 'chade dang ’ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ deb 'di la zhib lta byas na dpyad pa rgyag rgyu yang gang mang zhig yod pas de dag rags tsam dgos dbang gis 'god par byed pa la/(1) ‘ (kyesangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang don khag gcig ni bran g.yog lam lugs spyi chongags kyi dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i rnam pa mtshon pa dang / 'ga' zhig ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor 'an+d+ral ba'i bsam blo mtshon pa zhig yin/ ’’ la de yang ‘‘(nyedaper na sangs rgyas chos lugs nang rigs mtho shas dang bzang shas ni’’ soṭa rus rgyud dbang cha dang khyo bo'i dbang cha sogs gsal bor martsoton tshul du ma zhig bshad pa ni don la mi gnas te/ sangs rgyas kyis ‘‘rus mi gtso/rigs mi gtso/ bslab pa gtso/ ’’ zhes pa des de'i skabs kyi hin dhu'i (1)81 ‘3 (kye918 rī46

rigs bzhir dbye ba'i lam lugs dang pho mo 'dra mnyam min pa'i lam lugs la rgol ba byas pa zhig yin pa ni krung go rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur slob grwa'i bslab deb du gtan khelu byas pa'i 〈'dzam gling la rgyus〉 soṭa su'ang bkod yod pas/ sangs rgyas kyis rigs mtho dman gyi khyad par —byas te gang nas rigs dman pa tsho la skal ba chad du bcug lud par/srong btsan skabs sangs rgyas chos lugs dar mgo tshugs pa ni ‘‘(kyedabang sgyur gral rim gyi chab srid lam lugs thad snyepa chos lugs kyi bsam blo gas ra ba'i dgos mkho byung ’ ba'i dbang gis yimyo par bshad pa dang /‘‘de'i skabs gzhi rtsa'i steng bran g.yog larme lugs kyi spyi tshogs yin pa la’’ zhes pa gnyis ni ha cang 'brel mi chags pa 'i/ga red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis bran g.yog lam lugs dang bkas bkod rgyud 'jin lam lugs la thog mtha' bar gsum ngo rgol byed pa'i phyir ro/(2) khri srong lde btsan skabs/ grwa ba dang chos bdag bsdoms pa'i mi grangs sum brgya tsam yod pa kho tshos la gcig la rgyal po'i mdzod nas blangs pa'i 'bru rigs de zhing ba mi grangs lnga brgya lhag gi lo gcig gi za 'bru'i 'bor grangs dang mnyam la/ chos bdag dang sgom chen slob grwa'i dge rgan bcas mi sum cu sa dgu bcas kyi lo gcig gi mar phogs de zhing ba mi grangs brgya dang brgyad cu'i za mar dang mnyam par bshad la/()/)13 47

mas ma dmar po/‘‘duganas tshul de'i steng nas skabs der grwa ba'i mi grangs ha cang nyung nyung zhig las med kyang / tshang ma bran g.yog gi bdag po sha stag yin pa dang sku/ kho tsho ni khral dang 'u lag rgyugs mi degos pa'i dmigs bsal dbang cha chen po yod pa'i rim gras shig tu gyur zin par ra 'phrod gsal bo byung ’’zhes dang /‘‘()mkhan po bo dhi sa twa sku gshegs yan chad bod kyi rab byung rnams rgyal po'i mdzod nas phogs blangs ba tsam ma gtogs gtan khel byas pa'i 'tsho ba'i rten sa gang yang med pa'i phogs zan nga/ sha stag red/ ’’ ces grwa ba la phogs brgyab pa ni ches mi rigs pa'i las shig tu gtan khel byas la/ phogs yod pa'i mi tshad zhing ba dkyus ma zhig gi yong sgo las kyang mang bas de dag bran g.yog bdag po zhig tu ngos 'dzin byas pa ni ches mi 'thad de/rgyal khab kyis 'gan srung bya ba'i las khungs dang / shes rig slob sa'i slob grwa'i dbu 'dzin dang / dge rgan/ched sbyong bashrī —sogs la zla phogs gnang ba ni lugs dang mi mthun pa zhig min pa ma zad ya rabs tshul ldan gyi chab srid byed stangs shig tu'ang grub/ ma zad/ de dag gi zla phogs yong sgo de mi ser dkyus ma zhig gi yong sgo las gal te mang ba bden na yang de tsam gyis bran g.yog bdag po zhig tu 'gyur don rtsa ba nas mi 'dug ste/ dper na/ dung dkar ba khyod kyang rgyal khab kyi dge rgan (kyet+ta36 (kye93248

bod kyi ser mo ba/chen mo ba'i thob thang yod la/ zla phogs dang dmigs bsal gyi khe dbang yang de mtshungs shig yod nges na yang / bran g.yog bdag po zhig tu sus kyang ngos bzung med pa dang / de'i skabs kyi lam luṭa ni de bas kyang bran g.yog lam lugs yin pa sus kyang khas len mi phod pa bzhin no/'bangs mi khyim sprad ces pa ni grwa bar lta skyong gnang mkhan dang :na bdag tu bzhag pa zhig las bran g.yog tu ngos 'dzin ga la rung / (3) ‘‘(nyekho tshor sger la dbang ba'i sa zhing dang 'brog thang sems can bcas med na thon skyed rgyu chas sger la dbang ba'i dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi med pa yin stabs/ dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi de srung skyob ched srid dbang bzung rgyur btson len byed pa'i dmigs yul de yong mi srid/dmigs yul de med na bod la chos lugs grub mtha' khag gi mtho rim mi snas srid dbang lag tu bzung ba'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs yong mi thub pa bcas redami’ ces/ bam lta tsam byas na ci 'dra'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi thog mtha'i rten byung 'brel gyi rim pa 'dra chags po zhig bkod 'dug snyam pa 'dra yang / zhib par bltas na bod kyi grwa ba tsho bran g.yog bdag po zhig dang zhing bdag gral rim zhig tu gyur ba ni la rgyus kyi don dngos dang gtan mi mthun la/ khyad par grwa ba tshor rang nyid sger la dbang ba'i dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi de srung ched srid dbang bzung rgyur (bye/)65 49

lo ma dmar po/brtson pa ni gnas ma yin pa zhig cite/ khyod rang nyid kyi bkod pa'i la rgyus mi sna dag las rgyal ba shāka thub nas twa la'i bcu gsum pa'i bar su zhig de 'dra'i bya spyod yod pa'i chos byed dge 'dun pa red/ tā la'i lnga ba dang bcu gsum me 'gro mgon 'phags pa sogs kyi srid dbang cung zad re 'dzin dgos byung bar bshad kyang de ni bod la gcig gyur gyi rgyal po med stabs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mi rigs nyen kha tshabs chen la thug dus /skabs rer skyob ched tsam yin pa ma/ gtogs kho rang cho'i dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i rmang gzhi sru nga ched yun ring brtson len byas pa zhig gang na yin/ gal te kho rang tsho bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal bo lta bu zhig yin zer na rgyal srid de khong tsho'i bu rabs tsha rgyud la ma sprad pa'i lan ci yin/ khyod kyis de ltar go ba mi len par chos lugs grub mtha' khag gis mtho rim mi sna tshang mas chab srid dang dpal 'byor brtson len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod kho na byas par 'dod na rje tsong kha ba dang kun mkhyen klong chen pa lta bu'i gsar rnying chos lugs grub mtha'i 'go bdag tshos mdzad pa ci 'dra yin par khyed kyi bshad e nus/ yang na sdom —chig cig bkod na ‘‘grwa bas tshor ba mi rtsod 'du shes rtsod// grong bas 'du shes mi rtso+od tshor ba rtsod/’’ zer ba 'dis kyang 'di /la bden kha med pa gsal bo rtags thub/2 rtsom pa po'i dgongs bzhed dngos dang dngos min skor/5(/

bod kyi ser mo ba/gong du bkod pa ltar bam klog thengs gcig byas pas khong gi dgongs pa gang yin mi nges pa sa 'dir cung zhib mos rtsom pa po'i lta tshul dngos de gang yin btsal bar bya'o/ (1) ‘‘()gong du bshad pa ltar so so'i dpal 'byor khe phan dang srid dbang 'phrog pa'i ched chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha bed spyod byas pa gcig mtshungs red’’ ces chos lugs de dang de'i dmag 'khrug gi mi nga 'dogs don yang de'i skabs kyi dbang bsgyur ba 'gas chos lugs kyi dar cha bed spyod byas pa tsam yin pa ni khong gi dgongs bzhed yin pa las chos 'u/gas rang ngos nas bkas bkod shākyad 'dzin lta bu'i dbang bsgyur ba'i 'dod blo skong byed kho na cig yin par 'dod pa ni khong gi dgongs pa dngos min/ (2)‘‘(kyebla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i shong bya spyi lo 1345lo nas lo gsum ring srid dbang bzung / 'di la gong ma thug the'i mur gyis gdan 'dren snga rjes thengs bzhi tsam btang yang ma phebs’’ par bshade pa dang rje tsong kha pa yang rgya nag gis gdan zhus la ma drongs pa sogs kyis bod kyi mtho rim bla sprul yod tshad rgyu nor dang thob thang la rngam pa rkyang rkyang yin par brjod pa ni khong gi bsam blo min yang / ‘‘rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams kyis bla—ma dpon po zhes zhe sa'i tshig (kye980 (kye/)81 —51

lo ma dmar po/gis 'bod pa de ni dngos su che brjod yod mod shugs la zur za yod pa'i go don rgyu mtshan gting zab ldan pa zhig red/’’ ces bla sprul mtho rim pa'i khag cig ni mang tshogs la sha mi tsha ba'i bshu gzhog pa zhig yin pa ni khong gi dgongs pa dngos red/ ci gyu (3) ‘‘(nyechos lugs grub mtha' khag bar gyi nyurtegs zhen dang mthun sgril med pa des bod mi rigs nang khul la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs kyi yod pa ma zad/ dbang bsgyur gral rim gyis de bed spyod byas nas kho pa tsho'i srid dbang 'phrog res kyi 'thab rtsod la zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang dmag 'khrug slong gi yod pa/’’ni khong gi dgongs bzhed dngos yin yang / nam rgyun grwa snab tsho phan tshun dmag 'tshogag byed bzhin yod snyam na de ni ma/ shes pa zhig red/ (4) ‘‘()thog mar rgyakha po'i mdzod nas lo re zla rer phogs blangs pa'i lam lugs der legs bcos btang nas grwa ba'i 'tsho ba srid gzhung nas 'gan len byas pa de ni/ chos byed grwa ba'i 'tsho ba'i chu tshad brtan por gnas thub pa'i bya thabs shig yin pa ma zad/ sangs rgyas ཿchos luṭa kyi chos khrims ltar khrims bsrung yang dag par byas na grwa ba rnams thon skyed byas te rang kha rang gsos kyi 'tsho ba skyel thub thabs medapa der srid gzhung nas brtsi 'jog dang srung skyob byas pa zhig red’’ ces pa 'di ni rgyu (3)ṣ+ṭa121 (wa)913752 — —

mtshan yang dag ldan pa'i khong gi dgongs pa dngos de yin pa las/ grwa ba yod tshad gzhan rten bshu gzhog gi srin 'bu lta bur mthong na de ni khong gi lta ba dang rgyab 'gal red/(5) gong du bkod tshopa'i lo rgyus kyi mi sna de tsho phal cher rgyal po dang dpon rigs kyi 'jig rten pa rkyang rkyang zhig las chos bsgrub pa'i dge 'dun nga dmigs bsal can re zung ma gtogs bkod med pa de'i steng nas bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs zer ba de ming don ma/tshungs pa zhig red zer na rtsom pa po khong gi dgongs pa dngos min par/ de ltar brjod dgos don ni 'jar man sogs nub phyogs kyi ye shu'i chos chogs lta bur dpe blangs te zhwa dpe lham 'gebs kyis dgos dbang du smras pa zhig red zer na khong gi dgongs pa dang mthun snyam/(6) gong du lo rgyus kyi mi snar drangs pa de tshos bya spyod kyi steng nas rmobaltas na chos la mi dga' ba dang chos lugs rdog brdzis byed pa'i mi dag gi bya ngan spyod ngan du ma zhig mtshon dper bkod pa zhig las/ chos pas chab srid nyams dmas su btang ba'i bya ba gcig kyang bkod med par gzhigs na/ rgyal bo glang dar sogs ni la rgyus kyi nyes can du bzhag pa ni khong gi dgongs pa yin pa las/ ri rgyal ba dang paṇa chen rim byon lo rgyus kyi nyes can du brngod par 'dod pa ni khong gi dgos pa min snyam/(7) bod yul la chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen che phyir/ bod kyi mi ser 53

lo ma dmar po/tshos thob ming yod pa'i bla sprul tsho'i bka' brtsi bsrung byed pa sus kyang shes tshar bas dbang bsgyur ba gzhan dang gzhan tshos nam yang bod kyi bla sprul dag bed spyod byed bzhin yod pa'i g.yo thabs de shes dgos zhes bstan pa ni khong gi dgongs pa ma 'khrul yin la/ de ltar go ba len mi shes par bod kyi skyes chen dam pa bla sprul yod tshad dgra ru 'dzin dgos pa'i bslab bya zhig bstan yod zer na gar yang bstan mid/(8) ‘‘ri(3mi mang po'i bsam blo'i thog gi dad pa'i don gnad der chab srid dang khrims lugs thu+og nas bcan shed bka' babs te chos lugs ba snubs pa der grub 'bras ni de las ldog pa zhig byung ’’ bar bshad pas/ chos lugs btsan shed kyis bsnubs pa ni mi rigs pa'i las shig tu 'dod pa ni khong gi lta ba yin pa las/ chos lugs mo ngas dad du brtsis nas 'dor dgos par bstan pa ni khong gi dgongs bzhed min/ sna (9)phyogs gcig nas ‘‘(byegrwa ba mang che ba rnams mtho rim mi sna de snanga'i gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog myong mkhan gyi dbul phongs shig tu gyur’’ zhes dang ‘‘()dngos 'brel chos la dad pa byed mkhan gyi chos byed dge 'dun pa rnams kyang chos srid mnyam 'brel dang chos min srid min gyi lam lugs 'og nas bcings grol thob/ ’’ ces dge 'dun pa (kye/)43 (kyesnga140 (kyeṣ+ṭa14254

rnams bshu gzhog myong mkhan zhig tu ngos bzung yod la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas‘‘()chos byed dge 'dun pa rnams gzhan rten bshu gzhog gi 'tsho ba dang kha bral thab sa med pa'i rul su ngas kyi rang bzhin ’ zhes khyad par dang dbye ba gang yang ma5phyes tshopar thams cad bshu gzhog byed mkhan zhig tu bgrangs ba gnyis la bltas na rtsom pa pos zhib cha ma thon pa'i skyon lta ra 'dug kyang / gong ma de lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang mthun che bas khong gi dgongs pa yin/ la/ 'og ma de zhib cha rma phyes pa tsam las /spong gi 'dod chu'/ min pa gas/la bo red/(1()) ma/dor na dpe debo 'di'i tsha go ma jug bar gsum du+o bltas na/bstan pa rnam dag dgas pa dang / grwa ba yang dag dgas pa/ grub mtha'i bar mthun sgril dgos pa/ gna' rdzas srung skyob dgos pa/ rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dgos pa bcas ni drang phyogs kyi go ba len tshul te nam yang yid nas mi 'dor bar bskul ba dang / gzhan la yid ches mi rung ba dang / rmongs pa mgo 'thom mi rung ba/ don med g.yam rgyug mi rung bas/ chab srid chos la brdzu ba dang / rang don gzhan don du+o tshobardzu ba/ dbang bsgyur rags skyar du brdzu ba/ bshu gzhag 'bangs dan du brdzu ba bcas ni ldog phyogs kyi go ba len tshul te 'go ba'i nad bzhin (kyeṣa55 rme55 —

lo ma dmar po/ rang du spangs par gdams pa nyid do/ (1 1) khong gi ngo rgol byed yul gtso bo ni/chos min srid min gyi lam lugs dang / bshu gzhog gral rim gyi bag chags gting zab— yod pa'i sprul sku'i ming can/ khyad par ‘‘(byesrid dbang 'phrog res kyi 'thab rtsod rno ngar che ba'i 'gal zla yod pa de nam yin yang phyi nas yong ba'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pa tshos bed spyad nas mi/ rigs gcig gi nang khul kha bral che ru btang ste rang nyid kyi stobs shugs bod sa gnas su sim 'dzul byed thabs byung gi yod pa ’’de'i skor red/ rgyab skyor byed yul ni de bzhin chos pa rnam dag dang mi rigs gcig gyur/ dmangs gtso dang / rigs kyi dbye ba mi 'byed pa grub mtha' khag tshang ma yar rgyas dang / grwa ba'i khe dbad / chos khrims do dam lam lugs 'thus tshang dang / chos dad rang dbang dang / sger gyi khe phan bcas red/ gsum/ rtsom deb la bltas pa'i bsam blo thad kar ba/ de ltar spyi'i cha nas bltas pa dang bye brag nang gses kyis dpyad pa brgyab pa gnyis ni cung mi 'dra bar mngon sum du grub pa bzhin/mkhas pas brtsams pa'i gzhung lugs 'di la la rgyus kyi rin thang dang rig gnas shes bya'i rang bzhin bslab bya go ston gyi nus pa sogs (kye/)141 56

bod kyi ser mo ba/ phyogs yongs nas blta bar bya ba ni gal che ste/ lo rgyus ni kha gsal zhing go bde ba zur mchan deng lung khungs 'bri ba sogs gal chen du bzung yod pas de dag yid la nges na phan pa nges can re yang yod pa shes thub/la rgyus de dag dang de'i nang du rig gnas shes bya rab dang rim pa zhig bkod yod pa ma zad gnas lugs mang po zhig kyang gsal bshad byas 'dug pa chang ma nges par byas rjes de'i zhor du nga tshor go ston dang bslab bya du ma/ zhig kyang bstan yod nges na/ de dag so sor zhib mos blo yis brtags par bya ba gnad du che/mkhas pa sus yin yang gzhung lugs gal chen re rtsom pa la brjod don thad kar ston pa ni rang dbang ba zhig yi na mi/ thub pa dang / dge rgan chen mo ba 'dis kyang gong 'og bar gsum kyi 'dod blo skor gcig la bstun dgos byung yod pa yid tshod kyis shes nus pa sogs ni rtsom yig la ma bltas gong dang bltas tshar rgyab gang zhig yin yang sems nas brjed mi nyan/ rtsom yig 'di'i 'bri ba'i la rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs la gzhigs na/gral rim 'tha' rtsod kyi 'gal zla'i rno ngar yang rtser son pa'i dus shig dang bla ma dang dpon po la lha 'dre gdon bgegs ces ming ngana'adogs pa'i dus shog chos lugs pa dang seri/ mo ba'i rigs shig mthong dze+e chog

lo ma dmar po/ —pa'i dus shig gom srol dang lugs gshis 'dzin mkhan yang med la gal nyute yod kyang rang nyid ma ṇi'i rdo 'bum brtsigs pa'i khri steng du pus btsugs thal sbyar byed du 'jug pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur nges pa'i dus shig dang /dus de dang bar khyad cung ma phyes pa'i skabs shig yin pas/ gral rim gyi dbye ba 'byed pa dang / bla ma dang dpon por rgol ba/ chos lugs dang ser mo/ ba'i rigs la dma' 'berib byed pa'i chul zhig mngon pa ni de'i ska bas kyi shugs rkyen dang dri mas cung zad 'ges pa red zer na mi chog pa ci yod/la las bshad rgyur/ dam pa'i chos la rgol ba dang de 'dzin gyi dge 'dun pa'i rigs la snyad 'dogs pa de la bod kyi bsam blo gsar ba zer/ bsam/ blo de thog mar gleng ba bo ni rje 'di nyid yin la de'i rjes 'jug ni blo mthun don 'grub rgyal sogs red ces dang / la las bshad rgyur lha med smra ba dang chos med smra ba de la rgyus kyis bskul ba'i deng dus bod kyi las 'gan nyag gcig yin la de ni rje 'di yi dgongs bzhed dri ma med pa red ces dang / la las bsam bar dung dkar ba blo 'phrin ni mi rigs la sha mi tsha ba dang rig gnas la zhen mi che ba zhig chos lugs la blo sems gting nas log pa zhig yin snyam/ 'di dag tshang ma bsam blo ma btang ba dang dpyad pa ma byas pa'i bab col hor rgyug tsam zhig red/'di dag tshang mas rje 'di yi brtsams chos la rgyus lan ma byung ba'am/58

bod kyi ser mo ba yang na brtsams chos gcig kyang mthong yang ma myong bar gang byung du bshad pa nang bzhin red/ de'i phyir 'di la zhib mo'i blo yis lan brgyar dpyad kyang rgya je che dang gting je zab tu 'gro rgyu las/ se'u bcu ba'i ngag ltar rgyu mtshan med par smras pa zhig ga la yin/ rgyu mtshan de dag la dmi/gas nas 'dir cung zad cam zhig dpyad khul byas pa ni phran 'a rnam/ dpyod dang blo gros phra bas/ dang/da gzhi'i dogs sru+ong cam/ dang dpad nga/ 'di ltar nā bas sa babs ces dbyi tsho tsho dag mo / da nga/ tsam/ las rin thang ci yang med par bzod par zhu/ 2004 2 ‘ 3me 59
bod skye ṅgekhro rme+o—ོ skreskre wa —rnye/

bod kyi ser mo ba/ heng hus baha sh+lau sher lko ba'o 'tsho ba( bod kyi ser mo ba'i 'tsho ba spyod stangs ni gtso bo gzhan gyi mchod 'bul la brten nas 'tsho dgos pa zhig red/ de yang / spyir grwa ba'i 'tsho ba ga/zhan rten yin pa ni deng dus tsam ma yin par/ bod kyi grwa ba'i thog mar grags pa sad mi bdun gyi ska bas grwa ba'i 'tsho ba gzhan rten yin nga/ ni 〈chos srid zung 'brel〉 las/ ‘‘de nas rgyal bos blon po dang bcun mo 'bangs bcas kyi nang nas chos byed 'dod yod pa rnams grwa ba byed dgos zer ba'i bka' phab skabs kho tshos bshad don/ grwa ba byas na phyogs gcig nas 'tsho ba'i rten sa med pa dang / gnyis nas rgyal bo'i khral dang dmag khral rgyugs ma thub na khrims dang 'gal bas grwa ba byed mi thub zer ba la/ rgyal bos mi sus grwa ba byas na khral rgyugs mi dgos pa'i thog tshang ma'i 'tsho ba rgyal bo'i mdzod nas— blangs chog pa'i dbang cha sprod rgyu yin zhes bshad pa red/’’ ces dang / ‘‘skad cha de'i thog nas gnas tshul gnyis mthong thub pa ste gcig ni chos la zhugs nas grwa ba byed mkhan tshang mas 'tsho ba gzhan rten ma byas na rang kha rang gso mi thub 61

lo ma dmar po/pa'i ngo bo gsal bshad byas yod pa dang / gzhan gcig ni skabs der rgyal bos grwa ba phud pa'i 'bangs mi ser gyi sa nas khral bsdu gi yod pa de mthong thub kyi red/’’ zhes sogs gsungs yod pa 'di'i steng nas shes thub pa zhig red/'on kyang / da skaskres bshad na de la yang gzhan rten kho na dang gzhan rmorten mi thub pa dang mi 'dod mkhan gnyis yod/ de la yang rigs 'dra mi/na du ma zhig yod kyang 'dir bshad bde ba'i ched gsum du dgar te bshad par bya'o/ gzhan rten yin min ni dad zas dang mchod 'bul la brten mi / brten gyis khyad par phye ba yin/ gcig bla drag gi rgyas spros ḍa'achen ba/dang po/ bla ma dang sprul sku ni bod kyi gna' snga mo zhig nas da bar rgyun chags su byung ba'i goms ga3|sa dang bag chags su/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul dang / yang na lha zhig bsam bzhin mi'i rnam par byon pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed la/ de ni mi rang ga ba zhig dang gtan mi 'dra bar 'dod/ ‘‘bla sprul’’ gyi phyi'i kun spyod ci 'dra yin yang de la do snang byed dgos mi 'dug ste/ de ni nges par du nang rtogs kyi yon tan dang skye 62

bod kyi ser mo ba/ ba mtho dman kyi steng nas khya da par ba zhig yin pas de la mgo bo'i thod bzhin bkur bzos byed dgos la/ mchod 'bul yang dus rgyun byed dgos/gal te de ltar ma nus na mi de ni sdig lhung can zhig dang dmyal bar 'gro nges pa'i mi zhig kyang red/ ma zad mi de 'dra ni bsod nams med pa dang log lta slakhan zhig kyang yin bsam/ /de'i dbang gis ‘‘bla sprul’’ dag ni gna' nas da bar bod kyi mtho rim mi sna'i gras kyi dbang bsgyur ba che shas de yin pas/ de'i 'cho ba yang de bzhin gra rgyas shing phun sum tshogs pa zhig red/ bod kyi ‘‘bla sprul’’ ni go sa dang thob thang nges canazhig gi bdag po yin la/ go sa dang thob thang de bed spyad nas rang nyid kyi mi tshe hril bor rgyas spros kyi 'tsho bar longs spyod pa dang kho'i bu rabs tsha rgyud la yang de lta bu'i go ming thob thang de 'dzin du 'jug ched kho'i chos lugs kyi bya 'gul sna tshogs spel ba dang / dbang skur ba dang / smon lam dang chos 'tshogs bsdu ba/ rten bzhengs byed pa dang / yul gyi rgyal po dang sde dpon sogs dang 'brel ba 'dzugs pa sogs kyis rang gi mtshan snyan rgyas su 'jug pa red/de'i phyir kho rang gis ngal rtsol gyi las ka gang yang mi dgos par mi dmangs kyi kho la mchod 'bul rtag tu byed la rgyal khab kyis kyang de la ‘‘bla sprul’’ gyi thob ming gnang ba dang zla phogs kyi yong sgo chad med byed pa sogs yod pas/ kho ni dus rgyun tsho ljid bzang la sku sha rgyag pa zhig 63

lo ma dmar po/ red/ ma zad kho'i bu dang tsha bo sogs la yang rgyal sras dang dbon po zhes dmigs bsal gyi khe dbang mang po rang shugs su thob kyi yod pa dang /‘‘bla sprul’’ la bza' zla yod na de yang phal cher mkha' 'gro ma dang la rgyus kyi mi sna ste/ bod kyi rgyal bos gu ru pad mar phul ba'i yum ye shes mtsho rgyal yin pa rang shugs kyis khas len thub pa red/ ma zad pha bzang po zhig la bu bzang bo zhig dang pha skye mthon zhig la bu skye mthon zhig yod pas/ gdung rgyud bzang ngan ma shes na de ni chos lugs ma shes pa'i skyon du lta ba red/de yang 'di ltar tshigs bcad du sdeb na// sku sha rgyag pa bla mar yod la sku lus brdzid po bla mar yod//phyi yi rgyu zog bla mar yod la nang gi nom pa bla mar yod//khang ba khang brtsegs bla mar yod la khyim na sgrig chas bla mar yod//rta nor lug gsum bla mar yod la zhing dang skyed tshal bla mar yod//lha khang chos khang bla mar yod la rten dang mchod cha bla mar yod//rlangs nyakhor gong chen blo mar yod la sgor mo mang po bla mar yod// mar dang chu ra blarme mar yad la sha dang pags pa bla mar yad//riṭa ma mdzes ma bla mar yod la riṭa mar lus bcas bla mar yod//sras dang sras mo bla mar yod la g.yog po g.yog mo bla mar yod//ja ma gnyer ba bla mer yod la yul sde shag kha bla mar yod//64

bod kyi ser mo ba/'bangs dang mi ser bla mar yod la ser sde grwa tshang bla mar yod//ma zad/ gang zhig bla ma zhig gi sprul sku la ngos 'dzin byung ba dang mnyam du khyod kyi rig gnas yon tan dang mi gzhi 'jon thang gang la yang mi lta bar khyod ni yul sde mi ser grwa tshang yongs kyi bdag po la mnga' gsol ba red/ dus de nas bzung kho ni skyes bu dam pa dang kho ni 'jig rten 'dren pa'i pho nya sangs rgyar+sā byang sems kyi rnam sprul dang dus gsum rjen char du gzigs nga/'i ma nga' bdag red/ kho ni 'jig rten mis mi mthong sa nas lha yul zhing khams la 'gro thub cing / dpag tshad mang po'i sa 'og dmya' ba'i yul khams yang nyul thub/ ya nga ya gi'i lha khang gi rgya mthong na lha dang lha mos gar stabs byed pa de khos mthong thub la/ ma gi rgan mo yug sa ma'i rjes na 'dre 'brang ba yang gzigs thub/ da dung khos rku byas kyang rkun mar mi brtsi la/ rdzun dang g.yo sgyu phra ma gyod dang kha mchu rgyag res 'khon 'dzing ji ltar byas kyang thams cad sems can gyi 'gro don dang dgos dbang khyad par ba re yin par 'dod/ de ltar ‘‘bla sprul ’’la mang tshogs yongs kyis dus rgyun mchod 'bul dang gus bkur dgos pa de ni thog mar lugs srol zhig tu chags pa nas rim bzhin ‘‘bla sprul ’’ gyis gzhan la 'phya smod dang brnyas bcos/ rdung rdeg dang ma nyes kha g.yog byas kyang tshang mas dang len byed dgos pa las yin min gyi gnas lugs tsam yang bshad dbang med pa'i goms gshis shig kyang chags song 65

lo ma dmar po/ ba ma zad ‘‘bla sprul’’ gcig la yi rang gong bkur mi zhu mkhan zhig byung na de ni dam nyams dang log lta ba'i gras su bor nas spyi tshogs 'di las phyir 'bud gtong rgyu red/ yang / ‘‘bla ma bcom na rgyu red// tshe thar bshas na dril red//’’zer ba'i kha srol yod pa ltar/‘‘bla sprul’’yod tshad phal cher phyug po dang rgyu nor mang ba sha stag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni gtso bo mang che bas gzhan gyi rgyu nor len thabs kyi g.yo sgyu'i rdzu na bzo sna tshogs la mi rigs kyi 'khral 'khrul rang bzhin can gyi chos lugs 'jin stangs de'i rgyab rten dang dpung shugs yo da pa de'i rkyen red/ de yang / dus rabs nyi shu ba'i la ra bas brgyad cu ba nas chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus lag bstar byas pa dang / de yan gyi lo ngo bcu lhag gi ring bod khul sogs su chos lugs la bkag rgya tshad med thebs pa de mi rnams kyi blo ngor mi 'bab pa'i btsan shed cig yin pa ded+ku'i mthus/ mang tshogs rnams skom pa chu 'dod ltar rang gi chos lugs la dungs ba dang / rang gi yul srol goms gshos la yun ring bral ba'i ma bu 'phrad pa ltar gyi dga' zhen bla lhag gis mngon pa ni bod kyi ‘‘bla sprul’’ tshor mtshon na/ rang nyid kyi snyan grags longs spyod dang thob thang mnga' thang sogs la dmigs te rgyu nor thabs kyis bslu ba'i 'phrog rtsod rang bzhin can gyi bya 'gul gsar ba zhig yang bskyar sprel thub pa'i go skabs bzang po zhig tu gyur yod/ de ni dper na/ blo mthun don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈sprul 66

sku〉 zhes pa'i nang gi dpe mtshon mi sna ltar mgo lag sogs mang phyogs 'brog khul gyi cha rkyen cung bzang sar song ste 'tsho ba bsgrub pa lta bu red/de nas la rabs dgu bcu ba nas da lta'i bar bod yul gyi ‘‘bla sprul’’ mang che bas rgyu nor 'bul sdud byed sa rni rgya nag gi yul so so red/ de yang 'dir dpe mtshon tsam zhig 'god pa la 〈bla ma thub bstan rdo rje〉 'a/ bltas na pha la cher shes thub/ gang ltar dpa' 'byor phrogyi yong sgo bzang ngamyo/ dang 4 /nga tshogs kyi bsam blo'i 'khor phyogs la blta sa nas sa gnas brjes pa cam las byed stangs kyi cha nas bltas na/ de dag chang mas lung bstan bshad pa dang skye ba riphyi mu / yar 'dren gyi kheg theg len pa/ yang na rten bzhengs dang dge bskul gang rung zhig la kha g.yar nas ma nga tshogs de dag gi lag nas rgyu nor g.yo 'phrog byed pa gcig ma/chungs red/ ‘‘bla sprul’’ zhes pas khyab che ba'i dbang du btang ba yin pas/mkha' 'gro ma zer ba de yang de dang 'dra yang zhor du shes rgyu las dngos su bkod med ces dang / sprul sku'i ming can 'ga' re ni chung dus nas yongs 'dzin la gtad de slob sbyong dang mi gzhi gang thad nas skyed bsrings bzang po byed pa yod pas de dag gis nar son dus kyang bstan 'gror bya ba bzang po byed nges pas de dag dmigs bsal can zhig tu brtsi mthong byas kyang las chog 'on kyang de dag re 'ga' tsam gyis bod kyi bla sprul yongs kyi tshab byed mi thub pa ni/ 'dir khyab che chung gi dbang 67
