lo ma dmar po/gis byas pa yin pas de lugs klog mkhan tshos yid 'jags 'tshal zhes ched du brjod pa'o/ rang nyid mthon po'i khri las mi 'bab par//tshe 'di'i langs spyod gzhan la dman par sgrogs//'bangs dang mi ser bslu ba'i lce rtse nas//'tsho ba'i dwangs ma/ gzhibs mkhas bla sprul las //gnyis/ grwa bcun yon tan pa'i 'cho ba/grwa ba zhes pa'i mi/nga 'di thog ma ra chos grwa na slob gnyer byed nga/'i bcun pa tsho'i ming yin yang / phyis su rim gyis ban de dkyus ma tsho'i spyi ming dang yang na btsun pa'i spyi ming zhig tu gyur/ de yang / slob grwa na slob sbyong byed bzhin pa'i slob ma tshor slob grwa ba zer ba bzhin/ grwa sa na slob gnyer byed bzhin pa'i slob ma rnams la grwa sa ba'am grwa ba zer/ de nas rim bzhin grwa sa ba tshang ma btsun pa rab byung rkyang rkyang yin pas/ ming de ni rab byung btsun pa'i spyi ming du gyur/ yi na yang / skabs 'gar grwa dpon g.yog zhes bla ma'i zhabs phyi ba la yang grwa ba zer srol yod/ gang ltar 'dir grwa sa'i grwa ba yon tan pa'i rigs rnams gtso bor bzung nas 68

grwa sa na yod pa'i grwa ba'i 'tsho ba ni/ cung phun sum tshogs la/ sgrig lam yang cung cha tshang red/ de ni 'gyed gtong sgo dang mang ja skol ba/ dus mchod la ched du sbyin bdag 'bud pa/ gzhan 'don bya len pa'i yong sgo/da dung rgyu nor che ba'i phyug po 'gas ma dngul cung zad re 'jog nga se gas kyis mchon/ dad lda na ma nga tshogs kyis rgyab skyor la brten nas 'che ba skyel ba red/ grwa sa'i grwa ba tshang rme/ rab byung sha stag yin la khong choge gzan sham so/ ma/ re dang / zla gam/ dang zhwa rngo/ so gas rang rang gi dgon par 'grig chas gang dgos cha tshang cung spu sa dag re yod/ za ma yang dus rgyun tshogs kyi zhag thebs dang mang ja yo da na des chog la/ med dus rang nyid kyi sgor phud nas khyim du stabs bde'i zas re g.yo skol byed pa'am/ yang na skabs 'gar srang la song nas zas khang du za ma stabs bde re za ba red/ gzhan khyim tshang la las a mchod du bos na de'i nyin gyi za ma ni ches bzang shas de red/ de min khyim na 'khor g.yog khyim mi sgrig chas sogs dang / rgyan cha'i rigs dang / nang nom dang dngul sgor gsog pa sogs ci yang yod kyang med la/ dgos kyang dgos pa ma red/ khong tsho'i khyim na dpe cha dang dpe sgrom sogs rig gnas mkho chas stabs bde re bsgrigs yod pa las rgyas spros kyi bkod pa ci yang med/ khong tshos re snyegs byed yul ni skye ba phyi ma dal 'byor gyi mi lus rim gyis brgyud nas 69

lo ma dmar po/mthar thug bla med byang chub chen po'i go 'phang 'thob pa de red/ ma zad da dung tshe 'dir yang zas gos gnyis thad nas dka' ngal med pa tsam dang 'tsho tshis kyi ched dka' las mang po myong mi dgos par stabs bde bag phebs kyi 'tsho ba nyams dga' ba zhig longs su spyod thub pa de yang khong tsho'i 'tsho ba'i dmigs 'dun red/ de'i phyir lto mi bkres pa dang rgyab mi grang ba zhig yong tshe gzhan gyi rgyu nor la 'gram/ lu mi/ sdang zhing / phyug po'i go sa la yid smon ci yang chi byed/bya ba'i ste nga gi sa bshad na/ dzhadagon pa dang chos grwa'i sgrig lam nan tan gyis bsrung la gzhung gi rgyugs dang chos grwa'i rtsod pa/ dpe khrid zhu ba/blo 'dzin byed pa sogs mdor na mi tshe hril bor slob gnyer 'ba' zhig la gzhol ba dang / de'i khar nangs dgong sogs bya ba'i bar mtshams kyi dus tshod bed spyad nas bsod nams gsog pa dang / sgrib pa sbyang ba'i bya ba gzhan yang zhor du 'khru/ba pa byed/ mdor na/ klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo/ spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor la/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ste/'khor lo gsum gyis dus 'da' bar byed/ de yang rje tsong kha chen pos/rab tu byung nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar//mkhan slu+ob spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs bzhin//bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i /nyes pas nam yang gos par ma gyur cig /70

tshangs spyod rten la theg pa chen po yi// zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams ji snyed pa//ma rnams don du dka' ba du ma yis//bskal ba dpag tu med par sgrub par shag /lung rtogs yon tan du mas rgyud gtams shing //dbang bo zhi zhing rab du' snying brtser bcas//gzhanadon skyo med sgru ba pa'i snying stobs can//bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin par shag /rtag tu ngu yis chos 'phags bsten pa lta ra//lus srog longs spyod kun gyis g.yo med par //bshes gnyen dam pa legs par mnyes byas nas/mi mnyes skad cig tsam yang mi byed shog / zab zhi spros dang bral ba'i sher phyin don//log rtog dri ma'i chu yis ma bslad par//ji ltar rtag tu ngu la bsnyad pa ltar// de ltar bdag la rtag tu 'doms par shag /thub pa'i dgongs pa'i don las phyir phyogs pa'i//rtag chad lta ba ston par byed pa po// mi dge'i bshes gnyin sdig pa'i grogs rnams kyi// ca71

lo ma dmar po/dbang du nam yang 'gro bar ma gyur cig / lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i dar chen phyar//brtson 'grus lhod pa med pa'i rlung gis bskyod//thos bsam/ sgom/ pa'i gru gzings legs bsdams nas//lus can 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shag /ji tsam mang du thos dang lhag pa gtong //rnam dag tshul khrims rnam dpyod shes rab kyis//bdag rgyud lhag par gyur pa de tsam du//phyi phyir khengs nga/ kun dang bral bar shag /rnam dag rigs pa'i stobs kyis gsung rab don//ji bzhin 'byed la gzhan drang mi 'jog pa'i//mkhas pa'i gam du mtha' yas gsung rab la//ngom pa med padzi thos pa byed par shag /ji ltar thos pa'i don la rigs pa bzhis//nyin dang mtshan du tshul bzhin rab brtags nas// bsam bya'i gnas la bsam las byung ba yi//rnam dpyod blo yis the tshom chod par shag /gang tshe shin tu zab pa'i chos tshul la//bsam byung blo yis nges shos rnyed pa'i tshe//72

lo ma dmar po/dbang du nam yang 'gro bar ma gyur cig / lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i dar chen phyar//brtson 'grus lhod pa med pa'i rlung gis bskyod//thos bsam/ sgom/ pa'i gru gzings legs bsdams nas//lus can 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shag /ji tsam mang du thos dang lhag pa gtong //rnam dag tshul khrims rnam dpyod shes rab kyis//bdag rgyud lhag par gyur pa de tsam du//phyi phyir khengs nga/ kun dang bral bar shag /rnam dag rigs pa'i stobs kyis gsung rab don//ji bzhin 'byed la gzhan drang mi 'jog pa'i//mkhas pa'i gam du mtha' yas gsung rab la//ngom pa med padzi thos pa byed par shag /ji ltar thos pa'i don la rigs pa bzhis//nyin dang mtshan du tshul bzhin rab brtags nas// bsam bya'i gnas la bsam las byung ba yi//rnam dpyod blo yis the tshom chod par shag /gang tshe shin tu zab pa'i chos tshul la//bsam byung blo yis nges shos rnyed pa'i tshe//72

tshe 'di'i 'khri ba chod pa'i brtson 'grus kyis//dben pa bsten nas tshul bzhin sgrub par shag /de ltar thos bsam sgom pas rgyal ba yi//dgongs pa'i gnad rnams rgyud la bskrun pa'i tshe//srid la brkam pa'i tshe 'di'i snang ba dang //rang bde 'dod pa'i blo rnams mi 'byung shag /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gyi don ji bzhin nyams su bstar ba ni khong tsho'i las 'gan yin la/ khong tsho'i dmigs yul yang yin/dmigs yul de mngon gyur byung tshe yod tshad kyi re ba yang 'grub pa yin pas gzhan 'jig rten pa'i 'tsho ba gang la yang yid smon dang re ba ci yang mi byed/gzhan da dung / ‘‘dge bshes’’ kyi thob ming len pa'i bka' rab 'byams pa dang / rda bcal rab 'byams pa / da dung sngags rams pa sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa thugs la mnga' ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po zhig tu gyur ba nas bzung de dag gis— gzhan skal ldan gyi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs shes la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba rgya cher spel ba red/ de ni/ khong rnam pas sbyangs ba'i yon tan gyi cha yongs su dzo gas te blong dor gyi gnas lugs gzhan la 'doms tshe khong rnam pa ni spyir btang gi mi gzhan phal ba zhig dang gtan mi 'dra 73

'tho ma dmar po/bar phyi'i spyod pa ni chos 'dul ba'i gzhung du ji ltar gsungs pa ltar bcas mtshams phra mo tsam gyis kyang mi gos la/ gzhan sus bltas kyang yid du 'ong la nyams dga' ba/ khams dwangs shing rig pa gsal ba/gzhung drang la gtsang sbra che ba/ le lo sgyid lug gi rnam pa dang nga rgyal khengs dregs dang yang na gnyom chung nus med dang bag zha nywa 'khum gyi tshul sogs phri+ongs su mi mnga' ba'i spyod lam zhib cing gtsang ba des gzhan gyi yid la dang ba 'dren/ nang nyams rtogs kyi yon tan ches cher brtas te sari dang lam gyi bgrod pa rim/ par rdzogs nas gzhan phan byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyud kun nas brlan te ris med 'gro ba yongs la byam sa ba'i snying rje'i mnga' bdag cig tu gyur 'dug de'i tshe de dag ni theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur ba red de/ 〈mdo sde rgyan〉las/ ‘‘bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba// yon tan lhag par brtson bcas lung gis phyug/ de nyid rab tu —rtogs la smra mkhas ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spang la bsten//’’zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag gis rgyu dang 'byor ba mi bsam la/ snyan dang grags pa yang mi 'tshol bar gzhan phan gyi bya ba rlabs chen khur du 'khyer ba ni/ slob ma gcig gi rgyud la yon tan phran tsam re yang e 'byor ched/ nyin mtshan la mi ltos par dka' ngal gyi las gang la yang mi 'dzem par 'bad brtson lhod med byed 74

ci bod kyi ser mo ba/ pa red/ 'bad brtson lhod med byas te slob ma brgya phrag mang po dang yang na stong phrag mang po rjes su bzung ste spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sgos su gangs can bod kyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas/ ma zad 'dzam gling du rin bral nor bu lta bu'i mtshan nyin rig pa'i gzhung ji snyed cig rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel byas pa'i mdzad rjes ni/ bskal ba'i bar du brjod par mi nus na yang de la nga rgyal dang khengs dregs mi byed par ma zad/ de la thob thang dang go sa/ ci yang dmi/gas pa mi da 'a / 'dod don dang re ba ci yang bco' ba med/ tha na slob gnyer ba chos dung tshe rdog gcig gi zong rtsa phul yang bzhes pa'i srol ni nam yang med/ khyad par de lta bu'i yon chad— rdzogs pa dag gis lo dang zla ba'i 'khor 'gros ji snyed cig tu gzhungu 'chad parī dang gzhung rtsom pa ma rtogs pa dang lag par rtog pa'i gzhung gzhan la rtsod pa'i rigs lam gyi sgo nas dag bcos yo bsring byed pa sogs spyi tshogs la zhabs phyi rab dang rim pa zhig bsgrubs pa dang shes ldan pa bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig gso skyong gnang ba byas kyang / de la mang tshogs dang rgyal khab kyi dmigs bsal lta rtogs spu rtse tsam yang med bzhin dus kun gzhan don 'ba' zhig la brtson pa'i rlabs chen bsam blo de lta bu ni gzhan su zhig la mnga' sa ngas rgyas bstan la lus sems gcig sgyil gyis// zhugs te tshe gcig 'bad pa'i 'bras bu la//75

lo ma dmar po/ phyi nang yon tan ma lus yongs dzo+ogs nas //don gnyis 'grub pa grwa btsun dkyus ma'i las//gsum/ ngeso med rang gso'i 'tsho ba gong du brjod pa'i ‘‘bla sprul’’ gyi 'tsho ba ltar rgyas spros phun sum/ tshogs nga/'i phyi'i skyid chas kyi longs spyod nyams su myong mi thub la/ grwa btsun dkyus ma'i lugs ltar blo bde gu yangs kyi nang gi skyid nyams de yang ma thob/ kho tsho'i 'tsho ba skyel tshul la mtha' gcig tu nges pa ma mchis te la la ni grwa sa dang ri khrod dgon gnas gang rung zhig tu song nas lo ngo 'ga' la bsdad kyang lto dang 'tsho ba rang gis sbyar dgos pas mthar sdod mi tshugs par rang gar 'dod kyi sar phyin te 'tsho ba gzhan rol ba red/ 'ga' re ni 'brog khul dang lung kyog re las sa gzhan du mi 'gro bar rang gi thabs shes sna tshogs kyis 'tsho ba skyel ba red/ yin yang / tshang ma thog mar rab tu byung nas dge tshul slong gi sdom pa mi len mkhan zhig phal cher med pa 'dra bas de dag tshang mas dge tshul slong gi bcas mtshams kyi skor sogs dang yang na dbang dang gdams ngag sogs ci 76

bod kyi ser mo ba/rang gi dge rgan gyi mdun du chos sna re sna gnyis mi zhu mkhan zhig ni gcig kyang med pa lta bu red/ gang ltar tshang ma rang rang gi khyim gyi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bzang ngan dang dgon pa so so'i yong sgo che chung gi dbang gis sogs phyi rkyen dang nang rkyen du ma zhig gis la la ni la mang tsam dang 'ga' zhog ni lo nyung shas las mi 'dug par tshe gcig lus gcig la dgon gnas dang ri khrod gang rung zhig tu sgrub pa snying bor byas te bzhuṭa thub pa ni shaṃn tu nas kyang dkon po red/ ma zad dgon pa la las dus ma chod re 'tshogs dus ma gtogs rgyun 'dug grwa ba mi dgos pa yod la/bla ser dgon nang du res mos byas te sdo da pa sogs mang che ba grong chog dang khyim gyi don du gang sar rgyugs pa red/ grong chog la song nas 'don gla len pa la la ni khyim mi bza' tshang pha ma dang bcas bzhag nas yul phyogs gzhan du 'gro ba yod la/ la la ni rang nyid gar sdod kyi sa gnas de ru grong chog nyul ba yang yod/ grong chog gi nyin gcig gi yong sgo ni mi dmangs shag sgor 10nas20bar yin pas/la las bsam par de bas ཿdzang brgyab na dga' snyam/ la las bsam par grong chog gi 'don gla len pa ni dkor nag tha la 'gam 'gam zer ba de yin pas de bas nyes pa che ba dang sdig lci ba zhig med pas zhing 'brog phyogs kyi las rigs ngal rtsol gzhan la zhugs na dga' snyam/de ni/ (bye ca lag nyo tshong byed pa'i tshong ba/ 6) phyugs 'tsho ba'i 77

lo ma dmar po/'brog pa/ du zhing 'debs pa'i so nam pa/ dhi ri mo dang thang ga 'bri ba'i lha bzo/ () rlangs 'khor skor ba'i kha lo ba/ () rgyal khab la bya ba sgrub pa'i las byed pa/ (bye rlangs 'khor dang sbag sbag sogs zhig gso byed pa'i gla ba/ () gyon gos tshem grub byed pa'i bzo ba so+ogs kyis grub cing / da du+ong dbyar rtswa dguno 'bu dang pes mo sogs sa 'ag sman rtswa rka ba dang / phyags gzhan tu sang nas bla rdzun 'khrab pa/skabs rer slong mo byed la/ skabs rer rku byed pa/ tha na skabs rer jag rgyag pa sogs kyi snang tshul yi da skyo bo de dag byung gi yod/ ma zad la la ni bza' zla bu phrug med pa'i rab byung 'dra yang / phu bo'i bza' tshang don du khyim gyi bya bas dus rgyun brel/ la la ni lus la gzan sham cha tshang gyon pa'i rab byung zhig dang 'dra yang bu dang chung ma'i don du khyim gyi bya bas dus rgyun brel ba sogs/ mdor na/ khyim gyi bya bas dus rgyun brel ba ni grong khyim pa zhig dang phal cher 'dra/ ma zad de dag ni grong ba'i khyim dang mnyam du 'grogs shing grong ba'i khyim dang dus rgyun 'brel bas sems rgyud dang gshis ka ni mi skya tsho dang khyad par chen po med/ 'on kyang / cha lugs bod kyi ban de'i lad mo byed pa ni cha lugs de la brten nas darnga/la 'byor gyi khe phan gnyer ba yin pas/ skya chas byed rgyur ngo gnong byed pa red/ da dung bshas lug sogs gsod rgyur ngo tsha ba'am skrag snang skye ba/ ma zad la la pho mo'i bar gyi 'bre pa bar ngo cha ba'am skrag snang skye 78

bod kyi ser mo ba ba bcas ni mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i mthun rkyen 'og gi 'di dag la ldan pa'i thun min goms gshis dang la rgya re+od/ 'di dag ni dgon pa dang grwa sa la zhugs ma thub pa'am zhugs ma phad pa dang / skya sa la yang 'bab ma thub pa'am 'bab ma phod par thams cad kyi rjes su lus te skya min ser min gyi gnas su gyar ba zhig rded/ de lta bus bod kyi yul lung so sor khyab cing khyad par mgo log phyogs dang khams khul sogs su goms srol de rgyun 'jags su song bas/ des bod kyi ser mo/ ba spyi'i mtshan snyan la gnod pa skyel bzhin yod/ ga'i rtsa'i steng nas bshad na/'di dag ni chos pa'i lad mo dang chos pa'i gzugs brnyan/ chos pa'i 'dra rnam tsam dang / ser mo ba'i rjes shul dang / ser mo ba'i lhag 'phro/ser mo ba'i btsags shul gyi snyigs ro tsam zhig red/ yin yang / de dag gi khrod na byams sems gzhan las khyad 'phags dang / sems rgyud gzhan las zhi dul/ mi gzhi gzhan las gzhung drang / skye ba gzhan las mtho ba yod ces bshad na de ni don gzhan zhig ste 'dir mi 'god do/ la rgyus la bltas na yang / bod kyi gtam dper/ ‘‘skya min ser min ban de sdug/go min gnas min bu mo sdug/’’ ces pa'i gtam dpe yod pas/ snga mo zhig nas sa 'dir de 'dra'i gnas rgol yod pa shes thub/ de'i stong nas gnas tshul des bod kyi gnas bab thabs sdug yin pa'i mtshon rtags shig dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgud pa'i mchon rtags/ mi rang rang gi 79

lo ma dmar po/ mi tshe'i brgyud rim skyo bo yin pa'i mtshon rtags bcas bstan yod/mtshams 'dir grong rdar gyi 'du tshogs shig la bltas na/ grong rdar gyi srang lam na skye pho mo mang po phar tshur 'gro 'ong gi 'du tshogs ches cher r+ṣa 'khrigs shing / de'i nang ban de dang jo mo yang phal cher mi tshogs kyi phyed ka tsam gyi mang nyung yod la khyad par jo ser dag gi gyon gos mdog dmar shugs che ba dang lus po'i phan chad na ras kyi kha zhing gis rgya bskyed pa’des gzhan la bltas na thad zhing che ba dang gzhan la ba ltas na mngon lhang lhang zhig red/ de'i phyir jo ser dag gis bya ba ci zhig byed pa yang ma bgos rang 'gul gyis gzhan gyi lta rtogs byed yul zhig tu gyur yod/ na tshod dar ba'i gzhon nu ma jo mo 'gas snum mdangs ldan pa'i gzan sham so ma dag gyon nas gnyis re dang gsum re byas te mnyam gshib kyis dpung rdang bsgrigs te ldem 'gros kyis gom stabs sgyur bzhin yod pa ni ci 'dra'i dga' 'os pa zhig yin na'ang / gzhan pa'i grwa rgan gzhon du ma zhig gi cha byad ya ma zung tu gyur yod pa ni 'di ltar/la las mnab gzan phrag la gzar zhing la las phu rung mchan du len//la las wa zhwa zur gyon byed cing la las sne rags bsnar mdud byed//la las sham thabs nyes lteb byed cing la las gri chung glo 'doṭa byed//la las sham thabs shur mo phab ste sa yi rdul tshogs phyag nas 'gro//80

bod kyi ser mo ba/la las khog smad dam por dkris te gom pa'i spo mtshams thung ngur len// gong kha mi gcig nang lu so sor glo khug 'dra min sna tshogs re// ring thung mi gcig ske dkris so sor mdud tshul mi gcig so so re//rgyu rtsa mi gcig rkang lham so sor gom stabs mi gcig kha kha re//smad na sham thabs med kyang chog la stod na mnab gzan yod kyang cho ga/la las dbyar kha'i nyi tshan nang du tsha ru'i 'gag ring khur nas 'gro//la las dgun kha'i tsag ngar nang du mgo dang dpung sha rjen par phud//la las dor ma'i kha mdog legs po sham thabs bar nas phyir la ngom//la las gnag snum ral ba'i lcang la phrag pa'i rgyan du rlung gis skyod//la las ba so'i phreng ba gon zhing la las gzi dang byu ru 'dogs//la las khog stod gcer bur 'gro zhing khog smad gon pa dgu brtsegs byed//la las khog smad grang bas bcum zhing stod gos khur bo mang du byed//da dung bya ba dang spyod pa ya zung sna tshogs shig yod pa ni 'di ltar/pags pa dang ni tsha ru ko ba wa lpags g.yi lpags pags pa'i rigs //g.yu dang byu ru ba so la sogs gser dngul rgyan cha'i rigs sna tshogs//tha na 'gyig go'i yo byad 'dra min tshong rdzas bzung ba'i tshong ba dang //ja khang chang khang du ma'i neng na stong lab sgrogs pa'i 'ur sgra can// lcags rta dang ni sbag sbag zhon nas don med 'dur rgyug brel ba can// —8/

lo ma dmar po/ zas khang sgo na sprang phor bzung nas mthe bong bsgrengs ba'i slong mo ba//bzhi mdo'i srang lam bar ma'i dkyil na 'don dbyangs gyer ba'i slong mo ba//'drud 'then 'khor lo'i kha lo byas te rdo dang bye ma'i gla len pa//sbag sbag 'khor la zhig gso byed pa'i lag rtsal can gyi gla len pa//cha thur bzung nas rdo ris 'ded pa'i gang 'dod rtsed mor g.yeng ba sogs//las rigs 'dra min du ma'i nang na gang 'dod bags kyis rgyu bzhin yod//de dag gis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan par zhugs nas mi tshe phyed ka'am/ phyed ka yan gyi dus yun la grong ba'i spyod pa dang phyed mnyam bsre dang phyed mnyam bsre ma yin pa'i skya min ser min gyi las ka 'di la mi skya phal ba dang khyad par yod pa'i phan 'bras nges can zhig ston rgyu dgos kyang de ltar ci yang med par thams cad kha gso rgyab 'gebs kho na'i ched du gyur na kho'i dka' sdug gi khur bo de rang gzhan gnyis ka mgo g.yog byed cig tu gyur ba ma yin nam/ 'on kyang / kho'i bya ba la bstod pa zhig bgyis na yang bgyi rin yod de kho'i bya ba tshang ma rang kha rang gso'i bya ba zhig tu gyur yod pa ni kho la bza' mi bu phrug ci zhig yod kyang khos lag shes dang ngal rtsol la brten nas 'tsho ba bsgrub pa ni ser mo ba tshad ldan zhig las kyang bzang bar gyur 'dug la/ bla ma tshad ldan zhig las kyang bzang bar gyur yod do/khyim nas byung yang khyim du yang yang 'khor// 82
grwa sar bsdad kyang grwa ba'i dkyil nas bud//grong na gnas kyang grong bar mi mtshungs ba'i// 'tsho ba skyel tshul nges med lugs su brjod// 2003 12 13

grwa rkyang zhig gi rig gnas dang sems khams skor gleng ba/ 'dir 〈zungs khrag gi rlabs sgra〉 zhes pa'i snyan rtsom deb chung zhig lag son byung bar mgo nas mjug bar bam klog thengs gcig byas pa na yang bskyar zhib lta thengs gcig byed dgos byung / yang bskyar zhib lta thengs gcig byas pa na yang nas yang du tshan pa re re bzhin klog 'dod skyes/ tshan pa re re bzhin bklag pas thun mong ma yin pa'i bro ba zhim/ po zhig nyams su myong yong / bro ba de myang nas brjod bya'i don gyi nying bcud la rol 'dod skyes/ brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan ngag gi rtsom thung re re yis nga'i yid la spro snang gsar ba zhig sbyin la/ des de la dga' ba'i dung sems kyi 'dun pa bla lhag gcig kyang bsnan byung bas/ rtsom pa po 'di yi rig gnas dang sems khams la rgyus lon rags tsam byed pa'i mos pa zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes byung / de'i zhor du grwa rkyang bye brag pa 'di mtshon byed kyi mig dper drangs te deng dus dang gna' dus kyi grwa rkyang spyi'i sems khams dang yon tan la yang bsam gzhigs byed pa'i spobs pa la sngar bas 84

bod kyi ser mo ba/ mtho rlabs gsarari ba zhig 'phyur byung / de yang 'di ltar/ 2003lor par du bsgrigs pa'i snyan rtsom deb chung 'di ni rnga ba rdzong sgo mang dgon gyi la na bcu dgur son pa'i grwa btsun sbra rigs spyin pa rgya mtsho zhes pas bris pa yin la/ 'dir rtsom pa po'i ngo sprod mdor bsdus shig kyang bris 'dugaphran gyis bod kyi ser mo ba'i las dbang la bsam gzhig dang rgyus lon byed skabs 'di lta bu'i grwa btsun la chung zhig gis snyan ngag gi shugs 'byung nyams 'gyur gyi gar stabs dang 'tsho ba rgyus lan gyi rig gnas dpang tshad sogs la bsams pa na gzhan grong nang gi byis pa tsho'i rig gnas chad gzhi las rnam par brgal zhing khyad 'phags rtser rme+on gyi rtsom rig gsur rtsom gyi byang tshad 'dang nges yod pa ni ches dga' 'os pa zhig red la/ grwa btsun yon tan pa'i gzhan la sa khyad du 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar gzi byin gyi sne zur zhig kyang red ces bshad chog snyam/ gang yin zer na/ deng dus yang bod yig gi rtsom 'bri mkhan mi nyung ba zhig yod la/ lo na rgan gzhon bar ma'i skye bo dang pho mo gang yin gyi nang rtsom yig la mos pa che ba'i bod mi gang mang zhig kyang yod pa ni don bzang zhig los yin kyang / mang che ba la skad cha'i byang tshad dang rig gnas gzhan gyi rmang gzhi zhan pa/ lta rgya dang thos rgya nyung bas rtsom yig 'gri thub pa'i cha rkyen gyis zhan khar da dung gzhan gyi rtsom yig legasari gras kyi rtsom rtsal dang shin sbyang gi nus pa sogs la ji mi snyam par rang 85

lo ma dmar po/nyid yin mdog gime nga rgyal byed mkhan gang mang zhig gis ni brjod bya gzhan la lad mo kho na dang yang na spyi tshogs rgyus lon dang rig gzhung lta ba gang la yang mnyam ma bzhag par don med nyog gtam spel ba/ rjod byed tshig sbyor ni bod kyi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal zhes pa phar zad tha na go brda tsam yang 'phrod dka' ba'i rdo chags btsan bsgrigs lta bu'i tshig sbyor 'bri ba dang gzhan gyi rtsom yig las brku 'bri byed pa sogs yod pas de dag ni nga tsho'i bod kyi rtsom pa po zer ba'i gras su brtsi na ngo tsha dgos pa zhig red/ spra rigs sbyin pa rgya mtsho zer ba phran gyis mig gis kyang mthong ma myong na ya nga / khong gi sku par dang rtsom yig blo rgyugs su phul ba'i 〈drang nges legs bshad snying bo 〉dang 〈'grel ba don gsal〉sogs kyi gzhung de dag gi mtshan tsam mthong bas kyang de ni nga tsho bod kyi ban ser mo ba'i la rgya zhig tu ngos 'dzin thub la grwa btsun yon tan pa'i rigs kyi thun min mig dpe zhig kyang red bsams/ de'i phyir khong gis spyi tshogs la 'dzin pa'i lhag bsam dang rang rigs la bcang ba'i brtse dung / thun min grwa sa ba'i sems khams dang rang gshis sogs la cha rgyus len ched khong gi rtsom gnyis kyang rim bzhin 'god pa yin pas dkyus gcig tu blta bar bya'/dang po/ bod rigs rnal ma zhig gis bod kyi byung ba brngod stangs yang mi rigs gzhan dang dbang bsgyur ba gzhan gyi 'dod blo gang gis 86

kyang g.yo ba ma byung bar drang mo'i ngag gis 'gri ba 'di'i steng nas kho'i mi rigs la bcings ba'i brtse sems de yeng de lta bu'i dwangs gtsang snyog ra bral zhig yin pa shes nus la/ deng sang bod kyi na gzhon rgya'i slob grwa na yod pa mang che bas ni bod la lo rgyus yod par mi 'dod la/ yod kyang don dngos dang mthun par nam yang brjod mi spobs/ 'di ni de dang mi 'dra bar lo chung rtsom/ rig pa 'di'i rang gi lo rgyus la rgyus ma/nga' song ba'i shes bya'i chu tshad kyi na /thong rgya ni gzhanal ngom sor 'khyer rung ba zhi/ga red snyam nas de bkod par bya'o/ hangs retswa r+bhang ba( dge la gcig tu gzhol ba'i sprel rgan zhig / mgon po brag gi phug na ting 'dzin skyong //'on kyang brag srin dga' ma'i g.yo thabs kyis// sne'u gdong ri la bod mi'i dbu khyud bris//mang— bkur rgyud las 'khrungs pa'i lha sras des// rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis dbang du bsdus//yum bu bla mkhar zhi bde'i dpal gyis khengs//gnam gyi khri bdun rmu thag dgung la 'then//87

da wa /khuzo snangatang( tang 46 //༅ṅko ༅ṭhaṭha khā+e ṣ+ṭhasto chaṣ+ṭha ṇa7ṭha bheto phriṣ+yo ༅cho//༅bheṣ+ṭha ḍā ḍaṣ+ṭha khuṣa ṇ+ḍa ḍaṭoṭha spristo d+dhaṣe ṣ+ṭha///zlakyi ༅ṭhaḍā ḍaca treṣ+ṭha k+ṣ-i phriṣ+ṭṛb sproḍi ḍaṇ+ḍaṃ skyucho//༅'u nga spro ṭharmi/ rmetsa ḍaṣ+yotram̐ṭha r+ṇastokha/ /sgruṣ+yo hā //ṭ+wākha ṭa k+ṣiṃ tāṣ+ṭha kā k+ṣu ༅cho r+ṇaṣ+ṭha dzā ///〉 ༅ hūṃ /khra sgumi ṇarla hā rko skyu rtesmukhrisgru lkuṣādzi tshe/ re gleḍā r+ṇak+ṣiṃ/〉// sgru rta zhe rko jirge /nga1/ sprolha r+ṣaḍa ṣ+ṭhaṭ+wā7jiṭha tādzo/ ṣa khra khurwotshokha// nga tso+oza ḍā zaṣ+ṭha pyo/ kā ṣā rmordokhyokā 6 ṇ+ḍaṭha ḍarkyu to〉/// ༅ dhā kā r+ṇaskyobhe sgru ṣ+yo ḍadī/ tāchami’ 6k+ṣe shā ( ྈ bye // ༅'u tāto+o 〉rdzokha ḍapeṭha ༅khakā khralha tre ༅rā tre/shā ngaḍa///chekhaṃ khato kha/ lnga tram̐/〉 r+ṇaza 6ṭī ḍaḍāṭha zarmi r+ṇa shā //ngacimi zla/ ky-i ḍan/ kha bheṣ+pe khrash+lau ༅cho phri/༅kha ḍaho /// 〉 rngeḍa bhekhu ṭhakhri khaṣ+yo dṛṭha khan+t+ra ༅khaṇ+ḍa snre//ngayiṭha ṭhashā ṇaskyoṭha chuky-i ༅khar+ṣa yā khaṣ+ṭa spri/ṣ+yo tū — //ngaṇ+ḍo khya khusko ṣ+ṭṛṭha sprakaḍa ṭhaṭha ḍaṣ+ṭhaṭha ༅bheṭhami ḍasmo//〉zaṣ+ṭha k+ṣiṃhūṃ miḍalha rkoṇ+ḍaṃ rā sh+yi spri/zaḍa ṭha baṭhalha//cha/ 〉ba cho za yaji tram̐ṣā ṣ+ṭṛ r+ṣat+naṭha ṭhaṇ+ḍa sgru/ṣ+ṭha hūṃ ///r+ṇaky-i ༅khami bhelngaḍa tre—rme+o/ mirta ṇaṭa khe khra/ khā+e+o r+ṇace // ༅niṭha ḍā zaṭhaḍa sto/ 〉 dzokha h+pha (/cho r+ṇaru ༅tākhasna tsho

'on kyang se chen btsan po'i dge sems kyis//bod khams 'gro mgon 'phagasta pa'i zhabs la phul//ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i thugs rje yis//bod la zhi bde'i nyi ma cung zad shar//bskal bzang rgya mtshos bla dpon sbrags ma byas//byams lda na mi de'i 'phrin las mkha' dang mnyam// rab dkar gangs kyi ra ba'i mu khyud kyis // yo ngas su bskor ba'i bho ṭa'i ljongs chen gyi//byung ba brjod pa snyan 'jebs dri za'i glu// rnga yul gser mo ljongs nas lhod kyis 'phangs//1999 5 13'di'i tshig don gnyis char nas bltas na/ bod chol kha gsum gyi byung ba brjod pa la brten nas rang gi bsam pa'i brtse dung de thad kar bod yul la bcings ba'i rnam pa zhig mtshon zhing // tshig bcad nyung nyung 'di lta bu zhig gi nang bod kyi byung ba gnad che sa dag ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa 'dus yod pa de yang rmad du byung ba'i rtsom rtsal zhig red/ bod kyi byung ba la yang bshad tshul mang dag cig yod la de'i nang nas kyang deng sang mi rigs gzhan kyis dbang bsgyur byed thabs la dmigs nas g.yo rgyus rdzun bzo sna tshogs yod pa phal cher la gting tshugs pa'i go ba rnyed 89

lo ma dmar po/'dug snyam pa'i blo spobs dang gdeng tshod yod pa'i sgo nas 'di ltar smra ba ni gzhon nu 'di'i sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan yang rtser son pa'i rtags mtshan du kho bos mthong / lo rgyus su byung ba 'di brjod pa'i sgo nas bod kyi dus skabs so so'i dar rgud mngon gsal du brjod thub pa dang / dar rgud de dag gi 'byung rkyen yang phal cher dngos shugs ci rigs su brjod thub pa ni kho'i blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa zhig las kyang red/gnyis pa/ bod kyi grwa rkyang dkyus ma zhig gis rang gi 'dod blo dang sems khams kyi rang bzhin de snyan ngag gi lam nas phyir mngon par byed cing / g.yo med nges gtan du song ba'i rang gi dmigs yul gang zhig thog mtha' bar gsum du thad kar rang la dbang bar byas yod pas/ de'i bsam pa'i brtse dung dang ches rang dbang du gyur ba'i nyams der gzhan grong khyim pa su zhig gis kyang bsgrun mi btub pa zhig yin pas de yang 'dir 'akod par byas te dkyus gcig tu nyams su myong bar byed/grwa rkyang gi 'char snang /thams cad rang gir 'dzin pa'i kun rtog de'i klong nas//bzang ngan dbye ba 'byed pa'i sems pa zhig skyes byung //de las ris su gcod pa'i sgo gsum gyi spyod pa// 9()

dug gsum dbang du ma gyur so skyes shig yod dam//lto skya gos hrul can gyi grwa rkyang tsho'i bzhin la//nam rgyun yal du med pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis khengs 'dug/rgyu 'byor 'khor g.yog 'dzoms pa'i dpon chen tsho'i ngo la//dbyid ka'i gnam ngo 'dra ba'i 'gyur ldog cig mang ba//lha na skyes spro dga'i khyab pa'i khang chung 'di'i nang na//bzhin ras dung zla 'dra ba'i ma/dza' mo zhig med mo/da//kun rtog gzugs su bskrun pa'i smyu gu dang deb chung //rang la 'tsham pa'i sems khong mdza' mo ru gyur song //kho mor 'phrod dam snyam pa'i sems khur zhig med la//yun ring mthun nam snyam pa'i sems khur yang med pa/ma 'ongs 'tsho ba'i thad kyi sems khur yang med pa//sems khur gsum dang bral ba'i grwa rkyang nga skyid pa//phyi na mi ngo 'tsho ba'i spyod pa de mi shes//nang na rnam rtog skyes nas phyogs zhen yang mi shes// phyi nang lhod du babs pa'i dgon grong gi grwa rkyang //ris bral btang snyoms ngo bor spro snang gis bzi 'dug/gong na sde dpon rtsod pa'i mngon gyur gyi chags sdang //'og na bza' dpon rtsod pa'i skog gyur gyi chags sdang //9/

byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra ba'i 'jig rten gyi do rwar// rang dbang rang giso bsgyur ba'i grwa rkyang nga skyid pa//bcu drug lang tshos sgeg pa'i na chung gi bu mo//da lta rgas lhang 'khogs pa'i rgan mo ru gyur 'dug/bdag gi smyug rtser 'khyud pa'i snyan ngag gi bu mor//mi la stong phrag 'das kyang rgas pa zhig yod dam//gzhan ngo dkar nag gcig gi 'gyur ldog la bltas te//mi tshe rlung la bskur ba'i bu mo khyod snying rje//mna' ma btsan po zhig gi bka' gsung la nyan nas/rgyun du khom pa med pa'i gzhon nu khyod snying rje//phyi tshul rdzas kyis bcos pa'i bu mo de mthong tshe//khyod rang 'jig rten snang bar yid smon zhig skyes byung //da lta bu phrug mang po'i pha lo ru gyur tshe//'gyod pa skyes kyang rang gi sdug bsngal las ma 'das//li khri'i rgya mtshor 'khyil 'dra'i grwa tshogs kyi dbus su//lung rigs rtsal gyis snyems pa'i rnam dpyod cig med mod//dri med sdom khrims gtsang ba'i rang lus la brtag na//rang gis rang la snying nas nges pa zhig rnyed yong //kun rtog skrug sprin 'thab pa'i lding khang na rtsen pa'i//92

'char snang dbyar skyes rnga gsang dal dal gyis dgod pa// richos grogs mdongs mtha'i sgra 'dzin bu ga ru son tshe//dga' spro'i mngal gyis lci ba'i snyan ngag cig 'bri rogs//1998 kye 7 snyan ngag 'di'i tshig sbyor ni/ bod kyi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal la byang chub cing / brda sprod gzhung gi thun min tha snyad spyo da sta ngas la rgyus che ba'i rang rtags rang shugs kyis phyir mngon pa zhig dang / rang gi gang brjod nga ra 'dod nga/'i don de ji bzhin ma/chon thub pa'i nus pa mi dman pa zhig ldan khar/ da dung tshig zor yang zhing rnar snyan pa/ ngag thog tu len bde ba bcas kyi khyad chos yod pa ma zad/ zlos skyo na dang tshig gong 'og 'brel mi chags pa'i skyon yang med/ nang don ni/ don dngos dang mthun zhing gnas lugs kyis khungs skyel thub pa/ brjod bya thad kar ba dang / rgyas bsdu sa ci rigs dang zab khyad sna tshogs su 'grel bshad rung ba/ khyad par grwa rkyang dkyus ma zhig gi ches rang dbang gi 'tsho ba dang / blo bde bag phebs kyi nyams snang de brjod don de dang 'tsham pa'i ches 'os ldang skabs su babs pa'i brjod bya bye brag pa du ma bdams gses ma nor bar bkod pas brjod bya 'bur thon la rang dbang gi nus pa thon yod/ brjod don dang kha gyes pa'i 'brel med don gzhan gcig kyang ma bkod pas rtsom gyi 93

lo ma dmar pu+o/sgyig gzhi tshags dam pa'i khyad chos yod pa bcas red/〈grwa rkyang gi 'char snang〉 des grwa rkyang ngo ma zhig gi 'char snang gzuṭa brnyan bzhin ston thub la/ grwa rkyang ngo ma zhig gi nang bsam blo'i 'du shes mtshon thub pa ma zad phyi'i spyod tshul yang ji bzhin ston thugaphyi'i kun spyod ni nang gi bsam blos bskul ba'i rnam 'gyur tsam zhig yin na/ nang gi 'char snang mngon gsal du bstan pas phyi'i spyod pa yang rang bzhin shugs kyis mig lam du 'char thub/ des na 'dir tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa'i snya na ngag nyung ngu 'dis/ nga tsho la grwa rkyang dkyus ma zhig gi blo bde bag phebs kyi spro dga'i nyams dang / kher rkyang dang rang dbang ba'i sems shugs/ rgyud drang ba dang blo gsal ba/ bden pa bden thub dang don med rnyog 'dzing gi las la ci mi snyam par btang snyoms su 'jog pa'i zhi dul bag yod kyi gshis bzang de ci 'dra yin pa mngon sum dbang bo'i spyod yul du ston thub/de yang chig don ltar 'grel na/ ‘‘lto skya gos hrul can gyi grwa rkyang tsho'i bzhin la// nam yang yal du med pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis khengs 'dug /’’ces pas/ grwa rkyang zhes pa ni phyi'i dngos po'i cha rkyen gyi steng nas mkhos chung zhig yin na yang / nang gi bsam pa'i langs spyod ni gzhan dag las kyang phyug pa zhig red/ de'i rkyen gyis/ ‘‘'dod chung chog shes’’ zhes pa yang phyi'i zas gos gnas mal sogs rang la gang dbang dang ci thob cig 94

las/ gzhan gyi longs spyod la ham sems dang phrag dog gis 'dod pa mi byed cing / nang gi shes bya rig pa'i gnas dang bsam blo dang sems shugs rgya bskyed byed par sgyid lug mi byed pa zhig la go dgos te/gna' bo'i gtam dper/ ‘‘chog shes yod na rtag tu spro’’ zhes pa yang la las ldog phyogs su go ba len pa yod na'ang / da skabs 'grel dus de ni slob sbyong byed bzhin pa'i slob ma tshos zas gos 'tsho ba'i steng nas mgu dka' ba sogs mi byed par chog shes dgos kyang / bya bzhag gi steng nas chog shes mi byed par/ slob sbyong la 'bad dgos zhes bshad pa nang bzhin red/ de'i ldog zla ste/‘‘rgyu 'byor 'khor g.yog 'dzoms pa'i dpon chen tsho'i ngo la// dpyid ka'i gnam/ ngo 'dra ba'i 'gyur ldog cig mang ba//’’ zhes pas/ nang gi rig gnas dang sems shugs ma rgyas na/ phyi'i langs spyod ci 'dra yod kyang mgu ba'i dus ni nam yang med pa'i gnas lugs de bstan rjes/ da lta'i mang che bas dngos po'i 'byor ba kho na gtso bo byas pas/ thob thang can dang go sa mtho ba'i mi ni phal cher rig gnas med pa'i mi yin la/ mi de 'dra ni gzhan phan dang dmangs sems lta ci tha na dga' sdug skyen cing blo khog dog pa bcas kyi mi gzhi ngan pa yin zhes spyi tshogs 'di la zur za byas 'dug grwa rkyang dang spyi tshogs thog gi mi ngan gnyis gshib bsdur byas pas/ de gnyis kyi rig gnas 'jon thang dang mi gzhi bsam pa bcas kyi khyad par shes thub la/ de 95

lo ma dmar po/ gnyis kyi spro snang gis khengs pa'i spobs sems la 'dzum dkar bzhad pa dang / skyo snang dang khong khros dus rgyun mnar ba'i mi sdug khro gnyer brtsegs pa'i rnam 'gyur gnyis lhag tu kha kha so so yin pa de mthong thub cing de ni da lta'i spyi tshogs kyis bskyed bsrings byas pa'i mi gzhi dang /dgon pa dang chos grwa'i bskyed bsrings byas pa'i mi gzhi gnyis kyi khyad par yin pa'ang shes nus/ de nas/ ‘‘lhan skyes spro dgas khyab pa'i khang chung 'di'i nang du/ ’’zhes grwa shag na smyu gu dang deb chung sogs rig gnas mkho chas yo byad ma gtogs rgyu nor mang bo med la/ lhag tu mja' mo sogs khyim mi nye 'brel bza' zla bu phrug sogs gang yang re/da pas grong ba'i khyim dang so so ru gyur bas de ni yid la spro snang ster ba'i 'khor yug med byung zhig yin par brjod/ spyir 'jig rten na rgyu rdzas yo byad dang khyim mi sogs gang yang med na khyim de ni nyams dga' ba zhig tu mi brtsi na yang / grwa btsun yon tan pa'i rig dang shes rig ba'i blo ngor bstun na de ni ches sgyid pa'i 'khor yug cig dang / de ni ches rang dbang ba'i 'khor yug cig yin pa ma zad gnas lugs dang rgyu mtshan brjod na don ngo ma de ni khyad par pa'i 'khor yug bzang bo zhig yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni 'og tu sems khur gsum dang bral tshul dang ‘‘phyi nang lhod du babs pa/’’‘‘rang dbang rang gis bsgyur ba'i grwa rkyang nga skyid pa ’’ bcas kyi sgo nas 96

bod kyi ser mo ba/ gnas lugs rim bzhin bstan yod la/ 'jig rten gyi mdza' mo dang khong gi mdza' mo gnyis gshib bsdur byas pa des khong ni 'du 'dzi la mi g.yeng bar yon tan dang chos don du gnyer mkhan gyi grwa ba rnal ma zhig yin pa bstan/ yang / ‘‘mi tshe rlung la skur ba'i bu mo’’dang ‘‘rgyun tu khom pa med pa'i gzhon nu ’’gnyis ni kho rang gis bltas na snying rje ba'i gnas shig yin pa dang / 'jig rten snang ba ni sems shar sa zhig yin pa dang /sems shar na rjes nas 'gyod pa skye nges pa/ 'gyod pa skyes dus 'phyi char sogs kyi gnas lugs rab dang rim pa zhig bkod par brten rang nyid kyis sdom khrims gtsang ma la yid mgu ba'i rnarma pa zhig bstan nas rang nyid grwa rkyang 'di lta bu'i las la nam ya nga spro sems che tshul brjod nas rang nyid la brtul zhugs de'i ngang tshul las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i yi dam brtan po yod pa de yang rtogs par byas yod/ gzhan yang / 〈slob dpon a nu'i bsngags brjod〉dang 〈mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje〉 sogan+da/ ni kho'i mig dpe dang brtson yul yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang ‘‘li byin ka ra'i mkhyen pa'i ti se las// 'ongs ba'i legs bshad gsar ba'i gang gā ma// khyod kyi rnam dpyod dza hu'i hub chen gyis//btung tshe snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs su 'phur//’’ zhes dang ‘‘bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i snying rus can// sras mkhar dgu thog bzhengs pa'i snying rus can// za tshod tsam la brten pa'i snying rus can//’’ zhes sogs 97

lo ma dmar po/kyis/ thon skema'i yon tan gyi snyan pa de yang slob dpon li byin ka ra soṭa lu bsten nas byung zhing / mi la'i rtsa rlung —dbang du bsdus pa dang / 'od gsal mngon du gyur ba sogs kyi yon tan de yang bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa dang / 'tsho ba la dka' spyad bzod pa'i snying rus las byung bar bshad pas/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi bsam blo yang dag rang rgyud na rang chas su yod pa zhig ste/ de ni deng dus rgya'i slob grwa tsho na yod pa'i ‘‘yon tan g.yo thabs kyis len pa'i// rngon pa'i bu chung ’’ lta bu dang ‘‘phyir la ma sgro de thogs pa'i// skya ka'i phrug gu’’ lta bu'i slob ma tsho dang gtan mi 'dra/ da dung / ‘‘lnga rig me tog bzhad pa'i slob gling na// dud chang mig mang sogs la mgo 'khor zhing // rang gi kha skad brjed pa'i slob ma tsho// gangs can bod mi'i khyad chos 'di 'dra min//’’ zhes dang /mtho sgang gi 'brog phrug tshos mtshon sne rang la skor ba dang / mtshar sdug gi bu mo btsan gyis gnas la sbyin pa/ slob grwa'i slob ma dbang med phyugs rdzer mngags pa/ chang khang nang du mi tshe don med du gzad pa'i gesar bu/ las byed tshos rang don rkyang rkyang la 'bad pa/ yon tan til tsam yang med kyang / 'dre skad bshad mkhan gyi dge rgan/ phag pa'i lto can gyi dpon po ཿrtos ltag sgo la skug pa/ grong chog dang mar bsod la dga' bas bla sprul sogs ni khos spyi tshogs rgyus lan gyi go rim khrod 〈gangs ri'i yul la 'phangs ba'i phyir mig〉 las mthong ba yin pas/ de dag ni kho'i 98

dmigs pa'i gtad yul yin pa gsal bo mthong thub/ spyi tshogs la zur za'i rgyud nas bslab bya gnang ba des/ bod kyi grwa btsun yon tan pa'i rigs shig yin na skyon cha de dag gcig gis kyang ma gos par sgrib bral dwangs gtsang zhig yin dgos pa mtshon/ mi200312 1/)

a ba phu thung /mtshams 'dir yang / mthong thos rgan po dang nged gnyis kyis sgrung zhig bshad/ 'gag ring gi gong ba mar lag cing 'dabs kha yar lag pa/ sham thabs kyi shur mo sa la bsnar zhing mnab gzan gyi sne mo thang du 'khyil ba'i ban rgan zhig gis khyim stong la thon dus ca lag cag tsig 'khyer zhing / su yin yin gyi khyim du rgod 'dzul rgyag pas/ su yin yin gyis dus rgyun 'phya smod byed/ ngas bsam par/ 'di la khag mi 'dugakhyim bza' tshang ni 'di la med la nye 'brel dang bzang sa yang med/gnas dang gtad so/ rgyab rtsa/ rogs ram mthun rkyen sgrub mkhan ci yang med pas/ 'tsho ba'i rten sa dang zas gos 'byung yul ni gang zhig nas 'tshol/ yin yang / snying rje dgos pa mi 'dra ste/ kho rang chos pa dang bya bral ba zhig yin na ci shes zhes bshad par/ mthong thos rgan po na re/‘‘sngan chad 'di 'dra gang na yin/ kho rang gis bsam bzhin 'di 'drar btang song / pha ma gnyis la 'di 'dra'i sems la sdug bsngal zhig btang song / a/ pha ma gnyis po sgying rje ba la/ shu re kho/’’ zhes dbang med ngag nas shar bar/ nga rang gis sngan chad 'di 'dra min na ji 'dra yi+on snyom nas sgrung bshad mkhan la 'a ja dkar yal gang drangs bar/ rgan pa mthang /00

thos kyis/ phangs sems skye ba zhig gi tshul gyis 'di ltar bshad/ ‘‘a khu dbang phyug tshang gi ske rgyan de do ba zhig med ya/ grag dmar sde ba'i nang du kho tshang gi ga'u de do ba zhig yod zer kyang nga yid mi ches/ sa g.yu lung sde ba'i skye pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mas dus rgyun gleng ba ni a khu dbang phyug tshang gi phyi'i rgyu zog dang nang gi nom pa gang thad nas sus kyang sdur dka' ba zhig gi dpe ru 'dren pa de red/ cig mi 'dra ya/ 'bri zhig yod na bzho rgyu dang g.yag zhig yod na tsho ljid kha kha yin ya/ du dung rta pho rlung gshag ’’ngas dris par‘‘a khu dbang phyug zer ba de su red/ de 'dra'i phyug po zhig yin na ci zhig red song /’’ sgrung bshad mkhan gyis zur 'dug cig byas te mu mthud bshad rgyur/ ‘‘kho'i rus sog ru red/ kho la sog ru da bang phyug zer/ sog ru dbang phyug gis stod zog smad la 'phangs/ smad kyi nom pa byang du bskyal/ byang gi bre ser 'brong mo bsad/nags kyi shwa ba pho chen bkrongs / da dung nor lug gi 'phel kha dar bar byas/ rta ra rta yis bkang / bang mdzod 'bru yis bkang / gser dngul rgyan cha dang / ther phrug gzi byur sogs kyis nang nom byas te rgyu nor thabs kyis bsags pa'i lo rgyus la su yine yang yid smon mi byed mkhan zhig med pa lta bu red/ 'on kyang kho la na rgas dus pha shul bu yis 'dzin mkhan zhig la a bo phu thung 'di las gzhan pa'i sems 'khri sa zhig med pa ni yid phangs 'os pa zhig red/ a bo phu thung 'di khong bza' zla gnyis 101

lo ma dmar po/kyi dpral ba'i mig ltar gces na yang / de ni don ngo mas ‘‘mi min nor tho ’’ zhig yin pas/ khong gnyis kyis yid rbes byed chog sa zhig min pa ni de las kyang yid phangs 'os pa zhig los yin/ dbang phyug bza' zla gnyis ni spyi tshogs rnying ba'i skabs kyi pha ma btsan po dag gi bu phrug yin pas/ na gzhon skabs gnyen sgrig rang datreng ma thob pas lo na bzhi bcur nye dus a bo phu thung 'di skyes pa las gzhan pa'i bu phrug skye ba'i go skabs ma thob pa red/ skabs der kho gnyis kyi yid mi ches zhor khyim gyi dbang cha tshang ma a bo phu thung gi lag tu mi 'jog dbang med red/ ‘‘pha shul bu yis ma zin rung // pha mtsher du ba lang lang //’’ zer ba ltar/ a bo phu thung la khyim gyi shul 'dzin du chung ma blangs te gzhi 'dzin tu 'jug pa pha rgan gyi 'char gzhi yin rung / a bo phu thung gis ‘ya gi sde ba'i bu mo tsho ci 'dra gzugs byad mi legs pa dang ma gi sde ba'i bu mo tsho rigs rus dang thob dang dman pa la/’ zhes thams cad la chung lta byed zhor du ‘'jig rten 'khor bar snying bo med pas khos gnyen mi bsgrig ’ zer nas dus yun rab cig 'gor song / yang pha dbang phyug gnyen slong du ga sa gang du song yang / la las ‘khyod kyi bu la chos byed 'dod yod pas re zhig sdod dang ’ zer/ la las ‘khyod kyi bu la mi gzhi bzang po med pa ma zad shes rig dang thabs bkod gang yang med ’ zer ba sogs gang ltar 'dod mos byed mkhan gcig kyang ma byung bar brten rgad po des kyang re /02

lo ma dmar po/kyi dpral ba'i mig ltar gces na yang / de ni don ngo mas ‘‘mi min nor tho ’’ zhig yin pas/ khong gnyis kyis yid rbes byed chog sa zhig min pa ni de las kyang yid phangs 'os pa zhig los yin/ dbang phyug bza' zla gnyis ni spyi tshogs rnying ba'i skabs kyi pha ma btsan po dag gi bu phrug yin pas/ na gzhon skabs gnyen sgrig rang datreng ma thob pas lo na bzhi bcur nye dus a bo phu thung 'di skyes pa las gzhan pa'i bu phrug skye ba'i go skabs ma thob pa red/ skabs der kho gnyis kyi yid mi ches zhor khyim gyi dbang cha tshang ma a bo phu thung gi lag tu mi 'jog dbang med red/ ‘‘pha shul bu yis ma zin rung // pha mtsher du ba lang lang //’’ zer ba ltar/ a bo phu thung la khyim gyi shul 'dzin du chung ma blangs te gzhi 'dzin tu 'jug pa pha rgan gyi 'char gzhi yin rung / a bo phu thung gis ‘ya gi sde ba'i bu mo tsho ci 'dra gzugs byad mi legs pa dang ma gi sde ba'i bu mo tsho rigs rus dang thob dang dman pa la/’ zhes thams cad la chung lta byed zhor du ‘'jig rten 'khor bar snying bo med pas khos gnyen mi bsgrig ’ zer nas dus yun rab cig 'gor song / yang pha dbang phyug gnyen slong du ga sa gang du song yang / la las ‘khyod kyi bu la chos byed 'dod yod pas re zhig sdod dang ’ zer/ la las ‘khyod kyi bu la mi gzhi bzang po med pa ma zad shes rig dang thabs bkod gang yang med ’ zer ba sogs gang ltar 'dod mos byed mkhan gcig kyang ma byung bar brten rgad po des kyang re /02

bod kyi ser mo ba/zhig ci bya med par 'jog dgos byung /’’mtshams 'dir sgrung bshad mkhan la 'o ja dkar yol gang drangs/‘‘a bo phu thung skyes gzugs ngan pa dang mi gzhi ngan na yang skabs shig la pha rgan gyis brag dmar sde ba'i bu mo mdzes ma zhig kho la bag mar bsu rgyu byas rung kho ngo tsha nas dang len byed ma phod par ‘kho la chos ma gtogs pa'i yid la byed pa gzhan gang yang med ’ zer bas pha rgan gyis bu mo de tshang la rta bshags shig shar song / de nas sde ba'i mi gang mang zhig gis ‘a bo phu thung chos la dga'’ zer bas kho rang yid gting nas dga' ste le la sgyid lug gi ngang du thon skyed kyi bya ba gang la yang zhugs 'dod med khar/ pha yis bsags pa'i rgyu nor mang po don med gzhan la sbyin pa btang / la las bshad rgyur/ ‘sde ba gong zhol bar gsum gyi kha ya na zla'i khrod na kho la mig zur gyis phyogs mkhan tsam yang med pa ni kho rang gzugs byad ngan pa'i skyon yin yang / de ni rkyen ngan dge ba'i skul ma zhes pa ltar a bo phu thung la mtshon na chos sgrub ba'i grogs su 'gyur shas che’ zer/ khos nam rgyun bshad rgyur/ storkun ma ni las ngan red des ci khyer rung blo 'gyod med/ sprang bo ni dpe bzang red sprang zas min par dkor zas min pa gcig kyang med/ phyug po ni dme bo red/ rgyu zog mang na ham pa yod srid/ bla ma la 'bul ba ma bra na tshe phyi mar yi dwags su skye nges/ rgyu nor la gces spras byed na de ni yi dwags gter /03

lo ma dmar po/srung las kyang thu’ zer nas pha rgan gyis rgyu bsags pa'i sngon song bya spyod gang yod la kha mngon lkog med par sdang zhing gshe/ de ltar a bo phu thung ma bsams sa nas pho lo dgu bzhi so drug la slobs kyang da dung kho la khyim gyi bya gzhag dang thon skyed ngal rtsol gyi 'gan khur gang yang med par kho ni khyim de'i 'dzad spyod kho na gnyer ba'i srin 'bu lta bu'i pha ma'i sha khrag gzhib mkhan zhig tu gyur/ a pho phu thung gis noh+phu la rtsis chung byed pa dang pha rgan gyis bsags pa'i rgyu nor dang khyim gzhis yod tshad phangs med gtor brlag byed pa'i bya spyod ngo ma de mthong bas gnyen nye du ma zhig kyang ma bos rang 'gul gyis nor la hab sha rgyag par khyim der gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis slebs yong / ‘nor la chags zhen med pa shin tu bzang / khyod tshang gi rgyu nor ngas bdag byed ’ ‘ngas kyang bdag byed rogs los byed ’ gnyen nye du ma zhig gis de ltar bshad/ de'i skabs la las/‘'khor ba la blo log pa shin tu bzang /’ dang / la las ‘gzhi ma zin na blo mi lag rang dbang med’ la las ‘skye mthon zhig yin nges ’sogs kyi kha khog mi gcig pa'i skad cha de dag pha rgan gyi rna bar ha cang gzan na yang / sun snang skye bzhin 'chale gtam de tshor nyan nas sdod pa las gzhan pa'i thabs bkod gang yang med par gyur/ ‘bla ma brag sna tshang la gzi mig dgu zhig phul bas khyod la rten 'brel shon tu bzang zer/104

gter ston rdo lung la gser sku zhig phul bas/ ma 'ongs pa na khyod la rigs sad pa'i dus shig yod/ khyad par rigs bzang ma'i mkha' 'gro zhig la phrad na 'gro don ngo ma zhig de dus yod rgyu red ces zer/’ sogs kyis stong lab rgyag zhor du khyim sgo kher nyug gis ru nyul du 'gro ba las a bo phu thung la dadung gzhan pa'i bya ba ci yang med/’’yang sgrung bshad mkhan la 'o ja dkar yol gad drangs/ khos mu mthud bshad shākyar/‘‘da lta a bo phu thung pho lo dgu lnga zhe lnga la son na yang da dung rigasasad ma thub/ khos khyim gzhi dang rgyu zog tshung ma sran phung ber gas gtor ba bzhin ci yang med par byas tshar bas/ kho rang sprang bo sprang nag 'khyams sdom pa zhig tu gyur nas ‘‘a bo phu thung ’’ zhes ming gis bos kyang byis pa tsho sngangs skrag 'chor ba zhig red/ ma zad la na brgyad cur son pa'i dbang phyug bza' zla gnyis ni bsags pa'i tha ma 'dzad jizer ba ltar nye 'brel bsam bzang re dang don med snying rje can res lto re glud na ma gtogs 'tsho ba'i rten sa gzhan ci yang med pas ngo ma ya nga ba zhig gi gnas su gyar 'dug ngo ma yid skyo ba'i gnas shig red ya/’’mtshams 'dir ngas ‘‘kho rang la chos byed 'dod yod pa ngo ma e bden ci shes/ gal te ngo ma bden na/ kho dgon pa'i nang du ma song ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin’’ zhes dris par/ rgan po mthong thos na re/ ‘‘a bo /05

lo ma dmar po/phu thung rang nyid kyis bshad don/ ‘dang thog grwa ba byed dus dgon pa zhig tu 'dug bsams rung sdod sa'i khang ba ma rnyed/ da lta mkhan po'i sgar na rgud skyob khang zhig yod pa de'i nang du chud na der 'gro rgyu r+yan/ de min na pad ma gtum po'i sgar na zas rang 'dod dang gos rang 'grub yin zer bas der 'gro rtsis yod ’ces bshad bzhin yod/ 'on kyang skad cha de dag ni kho'i lo ngo brgyad dgu tsam gyis ring bar ma chad par kha 'don ltar bgyangs ba zhig red/ don ngo ma de dag gcig la yang 'gro yang mi/ thub la 'gro sa yang mi rnyed kho thag red’’ ces bshad par / ngas bsam par 'o na kho rang gi pha ma gnyis ka/ yang mthong thos rgan pos glo lu zhig btang nas/ ‘‘pha ma rgan rgon gnyis ni khos snga mo zhig nas g.yugs tshar bas de'i nyes dmigs la bsams na drin lan log 'jal gyi rnam smin lci mo zhig kho'i mgor yong rgyu red/ 'on kyang da dung khos rang nyid sngan chad kyi gling tshang gi mi che ge mo'i skye ༷tha' yin tshul brjod la/ mkhan po tshul khri+oms 'od gsal zer ba zhig gi sprul sku yin tshul yang brjod bzhin yad/ gang ltar kho mi bsam med cig red/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ kho'i pha ma gnyis ka snga rjes su shi tshar ba red/ shi dus kyang bdag byed mkhan gcig kyang med par dgon mtha' nas shi song ba red/ na dus skom chu hub gang ldud mkhan med la/ shi dus snyes mgor bdag byed mkhan zhig kyang med rtso /06

lo ma dmar po/phu thung rang nyid kyis bshad don/ ‘dang thog grwa ba byed dus dgon pa zhig tu 'dug bsams rung sdod sa'i khang ba ma rnyed/ da lta mkhan po'i sgar na rgud skyob khang zhig yod pa de'i nang du chud na der 'gro rgyu r+yan/ de min na pad ma gtum po'i sgar na zas rang 'dod dang gos rang 'grub yin zer bas der 'gro rtsis yod ’ces bshad bzhin yod/ 'on kyang skad cha de dag ni kho'i lo ngo brgyad dgu tsam gyis ring bar ma chad par kha 'don ltar bgyangs ba zhig red/ don ngo ma de dag gcig la yang 'gro yang mi/ thub la 'gro sa yang mi rnyed kho thag red’’ ces bshad par / ngas bsam par 'o na kho rang gi pha ma gnyis ka/ yang mthong thos rgan pos glo lu zhig btang nas/ ‘‘pha ma rgan rgon gnyis ni khos snga mo zhig nas g.yugs tshar bas de'i nyes dmigs la bsams na drin lan log 'jal gyi rnam smin lci mo zhig kho'i mgor yong rgyu red/ 'on kyang da dung khos rang nyid sngan chad kyi gling tshang gi mi che ge mo'i skye ༷tha' yin tshul brjod la/ mkhan po tshul khri+oms 'od gsal zer ba zhig gi sprul sku yin tshul yang brjod bzhin yad/ gang ltar kho mi bsam med cig red/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ kho'i pha ma gnyis ka snga rjes su shi tshar ba red/ shi dus kyang bdag byed mkhan gcig kyang med par dgon mtha' nas shi song ba red/ na dus skom chu hub gang ldud mkhan med la/ shi dus snyes mgor bdag byed mkhan zhig kyang med rtso /06

bod kyi ser mo ba/pa/ rjes nas rjes chog dang dge rtsa rgyag mkhan zhig kyang med pa sogs ni/kho sog ru dbang phyug la bu ma skyes pa dang khyad par med song ba red/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ 'di dag tshang ma a bo phu thung chos pa dang skye ba mthon po yin pas lan nam/ yang na kho rang ‘‘mi min nor tho’’zhig yin pas lan/gang ltar 'di 'dra zhig tu khos bsam bzhin btang song /’’ —107

bla ma thub bstan rdo rje/ bla ma thub bstan rdo rje dang rus ming lis (sto)can gyi grwa rgan de gnyis gcig brten gcig drin gyi grogs po bzang po zhig tu gyur ba nas rang rango la dgos mkho re byung tshe phan tshun gcig gcig la kha par re btang bas chagaci gcigalis— si h+phos ni rgya'i grong khyer zhig gi nye 'dabs na gnas la/kho'i khyim du bod kyi bla sprul mang po'i 'dra par du ma zhig dang zangs rags kyi sku 'dra bod lugs ma du ma zhig dang / da dung mchod rten dang bum pa maṇ+ḍal sogs bshams bkod byas pa'i mdun du bdun tshar dang shel gyi me tog phud kong rags dril zangs sder sogs dngos po yo byad du ma zhig mchod pa'i tshul du go rim dang gtsang sbra sogs la mnyam 'joca/ med par gang dgar bkram te 'dug go kho'i 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen ni la 'di ka'i ring la zas gos gnyis thad nas dka' ngal med pa tsam dang /da dung bod kyi bla ser 'ga' dang mnyam du yul 'ga' zhig la gnas mjal dang yul skor la thengs 'gar thon pa de'o/ ma gzhi kho ni lo ngo 108

bod kyi mer mo ba bcu'i yar sngon du sa de ka'i rdo sol 'tshong ba'i kung si ga gi 'go ba yin pas kho'i de dus kyi 'tsho ba ni da lta dang bsdur na ldab brgya 'gyur gyis bzang ba red/ de dus kho rang rgyun du gzhung gi rlangs 'khor chung ba rkyang rkyang gi nang du yar mar— 'gro la/ bu dang chung ma rnams kyang rlangs 'khor chung ba rkyang rkyang gi nang nas phar skyel tshur skyel byed pa ma zad zas gos gang thad nas rgyas spros byed rgyur ha cang dga' ba zhig red/ yin yang kho ni rig gnas dang thabs bkod zhan pas kho'i las khungs rim gyis nyams rgud du rgyur nas las bzo ba rnams kyang thor song ba dang / kho rang yang las gnas las phyir 'bud byed dgos byung / de'i phyir da dung khos sngar gyi 'tsho ba la phyir dran byas te de la yid smon byed cing nam rgyun skad cha'i zhor du de'i skabs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul gleng bzhin yod la/ de'i skabs gzhung gi dbang cha dang gzhung gi rgyu nor gyis phan btags pa'i mi gang mang zhig gis da lta kho la drin lan log 'ardzal byed 'opa zhes yid chad 'khang ra byed pa yang kho'i skad cha'i lab phyogs shig tu gyur 'dug yin na yang kho rang las gnas las phab rjes skabs yag pa zhig la bod yul du lan 'ga' 'gro thub pa byung la/ song ba tsam ma zad bla ma dang sprul sku 'ga' zhig gi mdun du dbang dang byin rlabs mang po thob pa dang / sprul sku zhig gis kho la bla chas cha tshang zhig gnang ba ma zad dbang dang sdom pa sogs kyang gnang / dus de nas bzung kho rang 109

lo ma dmar po/ bod kyi bla sprul 'ga'i rgya'i yul de 4ka'i 'bul sdud kya 'brel ba byed sa ang dang po zhig tu gyur nas ming yang yis si h+phos (1/yo4lha)zhes thogs pa red/ nyin 'di dag la kho rang gis da lta'i 'tsho ba 'di la 'gyur ldog ci 'dra 'byung ci shes snyam nas yid sems blong blong bor gyur nas yod/khyad par kho la la phyed tsam gyi ring la bod khul gyi bla sprul sus kyang kha par dang 'brel ba ci yang ma byung bas khos bsam par / de ltar mu mthud 'brel ba med par gyur na bu dang mna' ma'i 'tsho ba ma lus kho rang gcig pur brten dgos pas ci 'dra byas na drag snyam/ kha par ni kho rang la mtshon na phyogs gang sar 'brel gtug byed skyed kyi lag cha med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa ma zad kho rang la kha par med na mig med kyi long ba zhig dang rna med kyi 'on pa zhig dang 'dra bas khos kha par mig zur gyis 'tsho la/ rna zur gyis nyan pa lob phyogs zhig tu gyur/gnyis/phyogs bzhir mi mngon dud spyin gyis spras la/ ston dgun mtshams kyi nam zla ni ci 'dra'i grang shum ldanapa zhig red/ kha char 'dres pas gnam sa sbrel la gzhung lam gyi steng du chu dang chab rom gyis g.yoṭa 0

bod kyi ser mo ba/pas 'khor lo can gyi rigs kyang 'gro stabs mi bde ba zhig tu gyur 'dugagrong khyer gyi phyogs cha zhig na yod pa'i rlangs 'khor sa chigs de ni 'du 'dzi che la 'khrug cha dod pa zhig yin sa dngos gnas mi rgyus med cig gis gar 'gro'i kha phyogs tsam yang mi rnyed pa lta bu zhig red/ zla ba 'ga' la rgya'i yul mang po nyul nas lag gi sgor mo tshang ma brlag tshar ba'i sha med rus zad lta bu'i bla grwa dpon g.yog gnyis la mtshon na tshur yong gi yong sgo zhig phar zad phar 'gro ba'i 'gra song shin tu che bas/de dus lha dang srung ma zhig gi mgon skyabs sgug pa las/ grogs po bzang po zhig gis mthun rkyen cung zad sbyar na phan pa lhag tu che ba smos ci dgos/ bla ma dpon g.yog gnyis ka rlangs 'khor 'bab tshigs su babs ma thag kha par ang grangs 'bri sa'i deb chung zhig slangs nas phyogs phyogs la kha par brgyab/ yin na yang da sngon gyi grogs po mi nyung ba zhig gis kha phyir bltas tshar bas bsam don mi 'grub pa gzhi nas shes te bla rgan gyis dbugs ring zhig 'aṣ+pen bzhin gos kyi 'dabs kha ring bo de la chu yi chab rom gyis brgyan te mgron khang zhig gi phyogs su gom kha bskyod/ mtshams der khong gnyis la lag khug rdog khres gsum citsam yod pa nam rgyun grwa bas khur nas song song bas da skabs kho yid sun te khur snying ma 'dod pas bla ma khong gis rdog khres gcig mi khur thabs med du gyur te sems la zhe sdang gi 'tshub ma 'khyug bzhin kha rtsod 111

mtho ma dmar po/ 'di 'dra zhig byas song / ‘‘khyod 'dra ba' grwa ba zhig ’’ ‘‘bla ma thabs bzang na grwa ba ci skyon ’’ ‘‘da skabs dus tshod kyi dbang gis red/’’ ‘‘dus tshod ci zhig ’’ ‘‘la gsar ba la thag nye bas ’’‘‘ —’’ slar yang kha par deb chung zhig blangs te blta bzhin 'dugaskabs der lis si h+phos tshang gi khyim du kho rang pha bu gnyis kyis skad cha bshad pa yang de 'dra snyan gyi mi 'dug ‘‘nga rang gi chung ma byis pa dang bcas grong khyer gzhan du bskyur nas zla gnyis 'gor/ zla sngon rī ma'i nang du thug 'phrad byed rgyu byas yod rung da bar lus/’’ ‘‘sgor mo med na‘ smyoji ltar ’ḍig 'phrad byed/ thug 'phrad byas kyang dgas pa mi 'dug’’mtshams der/ ‘‘tir tir ’’ mun rib la nye dus kha par zhig 'ong ba 'di thag ring nas mgron po zhig 'ong ba dang 'dra snyam nas lis si h+phos 'dur ma rgyug gis kha par blangs ‘‘we suyin gang na ’’ rgan po yis si h+phos kyi ngo la glo bur 'dzum zhig shar ba dang / bu li zha'o yis kyang ci yini mi shes mod sems la dga' spro'i snang ba zhig shar song / de ma thag lis si h+phos kyis rang dang 'brel ba yod sa'i grogs po yod tshad la kha par brgyab/ ‘‘sang nyin zhogs pa snga bar byos/ bla ma da thengs ma gtogs phebs thub pa dka'/ nyin gcig gnyis tsam las bzhugs khom med/ we a ce la bshad rogs/1/2

bod kyi ser mo ba/da dung yis phu bo/ wang a ne+e sogs dang / da dung ’ bla ma thub bstan rdo rje dpon g.yog gnyis yis mi h+phos tshang gi khyim du gdan zhags nas thog ma'i skad ngag gang yang ma thon pa'i skabs nyid na bla mas lis si h+phos kyi ngo mdangs brtags tshe lis si h+phos kyis ‘‘sang nyin snga mo nas yod/ yod nges’’ zhes tshig thag chod pos mdun bsus pa na bla ma'i sems yang bde drod lam mer song / phyi nyin zhogs ja 'thung ba'i sngon 'gro ru bla ma thub bstan rdo rjes ja mchod kyi tshig mgor gre ba bsangs nas yid tshim pa'i ngang de ring gdul bya'i nyin dang por yong sgo sgor ga tshod yod dam snyam/ yun cig nas khong gis ser mdangs can gyi stod 'bog dang snum mdangs 'od zhags 'khyug pa'i bla chas rnams spras te ja mdog gi mig shel zhig kyang gdong mgor brten/mgo bo dgye zhing sgal tshigs bsrings te cung tsam bzhugs pa na/ da dung ci yang slobs rgyu ma byung / lis si h+phos kyis yang yang kha par bskor/‘‘ mgyogs myur ngang shag dang / da thengs bla ma 'di mjal du ma yong na rjes mar su zhig mjal yang dgos pa chung / khong ni dgon pa'i dngos gnas pa'i dgon bdag ang dang po de red/ khong la rin po che zhes pa'i go ming yang yod/ de ci 'dra yin pa brnyan phab nas ston chogamyur du shag dang / 'bul ba mtshon tsam gyis chog ’’bla ma dpon g.yog gis khyim du mdun cog gral 'grig po zhig 1/3

lo ma dmar po/ bzhag ste de'i steng bla ma'i ming 'dzin (oṃṣ+ka)dang rnam thar brnyan phab 'khor lo rnams yang 'jog nas yang 'jog byas te 'dug lis si h+phos kyis yang yang kha par bskor/ ‘tsā — khyod kyi sa nas mi bcu grangs lhag khrid yong dgos/ de ni khyod kyi las 'gan yin thabs brgya jus stong / ’gan+da/ma/ri / rgya'i yul gyi chos dad yod pa'i skyes pho mo rgan gzhon du ma zhig lus gus gus dang / yid zhum zhum gyis lag thal mo+o sbyar/ mgo bo thur bskur nas bla ma'i mdun du slobs pa na/ bla ma thub bstan rdo rjes ja mdog gi mig shel de yar 'ded tsam byas nas spyan gnyis mtho sar bgrad 'dug khong gi grwa ba ni skad bsgyur ba dang zhabs zhu ba yin pas mdun cog dma' mo zhig gi 'gram du 'dug pa yar langs te/ ‘‘rnam pa tsho/ yar phebs/ rin po che'i mdun drung du pus btsug thar sbyar gyis zhu ba gang yod phul’’ zhes dang / lis si h+phos kyis kyang ngo gdong 'dzum ne+eg ne+eg ngang / ‘‘gus 'dud zhus/gus 'dud zhus/’’ zhes zer/ de ma thag bla mas phyag dbang de re re bzhin mgo la bskur te gsung skad ldir ldir gyis smon lam ci rigs bton/ dus de tsa na/ rgya rigs pho mo de dag gi la las ma shes shes khul gyis bla ma la gus 'dud 'di ltar dgos 114

bod kyi ser mo ba/lugs dang / de ltar byed lugs kyi rnam 'gyur gang yag yag byas/ na gzhon de dag gis lung ma bstan du ci byed 'di byed mi shes pa'i skabs nyid na lis yi h+phos khong gis rkub stegs gru bzhi ma zhig gi steng zur 'dug cig byas te 'di ltar/ ‘‘bla ma ni nga tsho'i mi yul gyi byang sems yin pas byang sems kyi rnam sprul mjal na sgyid sdug gi rnam grangs ci zhig zhu rgyu yod pa tshang ma 'dri dgos/ nga tsho tshang ma mi rang 'ga' ba dag dag yin pa smos ci dgos/ rjes su mi yul gyi byang sems 'di lta bu la brten nas rang nyido byang sems 'di ltar 'gyu+or bar byed dgos/ de ltaro yin na skyabs sdam dang dbang bskur zhu dgas/ skyabs yan dang dbang yan la ma lta zhig 'di ni go skabs nang gi go skabs red/’’ces bshad/ thams cad kyis de ltar lags zhes ‘‘sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la // //’’ zhes rjes zlos kyi sgras khengs/ de ltar tshig 'ga' grub rjes thams cad 'jam jag ger ngag mi smra bar gnas pa'i tshe/ dzibla ma la skyabs su song bas bla ma gzhan mi bsten pa/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas phyi rol ba'i lha gzhan la skyabs mi bcol ba chos la skyabs su song bas ’’ rgya skad kyi steng nas grwa ba des ngo sprod mdor bsdus re gnang tshar rjes ‘‘nga tsho tshang ma slob grogs dang bla ma gcig gi slob ma dang dkyil 'khor gcig gi lha tshogs la gyur tshar bas/ rjes mar nga tsho su yin yang bla ma 'di ba tshang la zhabs phyi ci 'grub re byed rgyu dang 115

lo mu dmar po/ mi’ sogs gsung zhor du thams cad la skyabs 'gro'i dpang yig (khri/ ṣ+ṭhasnyetre)re dang bla ma'i ming 'dzin re re gnang / de nas phyi dro bla ma'i rnam thar brnyan phab la lta ru 3snag zer ba dang chabs cig grol ba red/bzhi/ brnyan phab las bstan pa'i bla ma'i rnam thar ni/ thog mar bla ma'i rten bzhengs kyi gtso bo ar 'dam gyis blug pa'i mchod rten cha brgyad mi tshad tsam re mod pa de rim bzhin shar nas yong la/ de bzhengs ba'i rgyud rim mdor bsdus shig kyang yod/ de nas sprul sku khri la mnga' gsol ba'i lo rgyus te/ skya mi dang sbag sbag 'khor lo/ rlangs 'khor chung ba mang pos chibs bsu'i tshul du gral bsgrigs nas 'gro ba dang / khri ston gyi mdzad sgo khyab bsgrags byed pa'i rgyal khab las byed —bkra bzang zer ba zhig gis rgya skad kyi steng nas gtam bshad pa sogs yod/zikhyad par sprul sku khri 'don gyi mdzad sgo'i khri thog gi bla ma de ni dngos gnas khong gi ming 'dzin steng gi 'dra par de dang gcig 'dra yin pas/ ltad mo ba tsho dad pa dang gus pa mi byed rang dbang ci/ de'i rkyen gyis de'i nyin gyi yong sgo ni sgor brgya tsho 'ga' yin yang nyin rjes ma dang rjes mar de las ldab brgya 'gyur gyis yong sgo je cher song yod/ lis si h+phos kyis bla ma 6

mtshams sbyor dang ngo sprod byas pa de de tsam nus pa mi che bar snang yang brnyan phab nas ngo sprod byas pa dang de gnyis phan tshun gzhogs 'degs byas na de yang de bas nus ldan go chod du gyur bas/ lis si h+phos ni dngos gnas mi 'jon thang ldan pa zhig red/de ltar nyin 'ga' song rjes bla ma khong gi 'bul sdud kyi dkor mdzod nor gyis bkang ste lis si h+phos yang de'i 'od kyis 'od lam lam du gyur la/ kho'i bu dang mna' ma'i 'tsho ba yang de bas drod skyid ldan par byas/ de nas bla ma de rgya yul nas phyir rang yul du phebs dus pha yul mi dmangs kyi snying la dad pa sngar bas ldab brgya 'gyur gyis bskyed/ de ni khong la rgyu nor mang po'i 'od snang ches cher 'bar ba des las yin/bla ma thub bstan rdo rje dgon pa zhig gi dgon bdag tu ngos 'dzin byung ba dang / de la brten nas rgya yul nas rgyu nor mang bo'i gdul bya dar ba de kho'i pha sher rgyam dang khu bo bkra bzang gnyis kyi nus pa yin pa su zhig gis shes/ khong gnyis kyis bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang rdzong dpon rin bstan bcas la sgor khri gsum gyi rdzongs ba byas pa'i yon tu bu dang tsha bor 'di lta bu'i gzi brdzid cig bsnan nas mi yul gyi byang sems ngo ma zhig byas pa ni khong gnyis kyi gzi brdzid dang nus pa red ang / khong gnyis kyis la ngo lnga drug tsam la rdzong dang khul rim pa/ da dung dgon pa dang 'brel yod kyi bla sprul mang por ngo dga' zhu 'bul gyi 117

bya ba bar ma chadapar bsgrubs pa ni khong gnyis kyi hur brtson rang bzhin hūṃn pa'i bya ba bla med cig red la/ rgyal khab kyi las byed mi sna zhig gis bsgrub 'os pa'i las 'gan zhig kyang yin par grags/ 2003 1 1

bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs/bod mi zhigal ci zhig la sangs rgyas chos lugs zer zhes dris tshe/sangs rgyas chos lugs ni dgon pas dus mchod 'tshogs pa dang shi bo la bsngo smon skyabasga 'jug 'don pa/ dar chog dang ma ṇi'i rdo 'bum 'dzugs pa/ kha ton 'don pa dang 'khor la skor ba phyag 'tshal ba/ skor ba byed pa sogs kyi goms srol la zer zhes brjod nges/ de lta na sangs rgyas chos lugs zhes brjod tshe shākya thub pas gsar gtod byas pa'i chos lugs de la go dgos par 'dod mod/ 'on kyang / 'dzam gling na chos lugs ji snyed cig yod pa tshang mar rang rang gi lta ba dang spyod pa nges can re rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu yod pa nang bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug dang de la dga' ba'i spyi tshogs nges can zhig gis kyang de ltar rang rang la dar ba'i lugs srol khyad par ba re rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu yod pa la mdor na sangasargyas chos lugs zer zhes brjod chog ma zad de'i gsar gtod byed mkhan go ta ma gzhon nu don grub yin zhes brjod kyang don ngo mar de ni la ngo stong phrag kha shas yar sngon zhig tu thog mar sangs rgyas kyis bsgyur bcos byas pa dang khyab bsgrags byas pa'i lta spyod gang rung zhig gi rmang 9

lo ma dmar r+pā/ gzhi'i steng phyi rol yul gyi dngos po'i cha rkyen dang mi rang rang gi bsam spyod sogs dang bstun nas yul dus kyis bskrun pa'i mi riṭa rig gnas kyi rang bzhin can zhig red/de'i khyab khongs kyi steng nas bshad na/ sgar dang dgon pa/ ri khrod dang grong ba/ khyim tshang dang / da dung rtsa 'dzugs dang mi sger bcas yod pa red/ rnam grangs kyi steng nas bshad na/ che sa nas chos grwa 'dzugs pa dang / dgon pa 'debs pa/ rten bzhengs byed pa/ chos tshogs bsdu ba/ dbang skur ba dang smon lam 'tshogs pa/ gzhung rtsom pa/ dpe cha khrid pa/ gzhung lugs slob sbyong byed pa sogs dang / chung sa nas kha ton 'don pa dang 'khor la skor ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang phyag 'tshal ba/ srog bslu dang tshe thar/ sbyin pa gtong ba sogs dang / tha na lha bkur ba dang 'dre bkar ba/ mo 'debs pa dang / rtsis dang bra phab pa sogs kyang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bya ba'i rnam grangs su gtogs/ zikhyad par bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs sam bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs zhes brjod tshe nges par du bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong min pa'i rig gnas kyi rang bzhin zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis yod pa dang / de'i steng nas bltas na da lta'i chos lugs de yang lo ngo mo stong gnyis lhag gi yar sngon gyi ston pa shākya thub pa'i lta spyod ngo ma de red zer na su zhig gis khas len thub/ mi la las bod kyi sangs rgyas chos 120

bod kyi ser mo ba/ skelugs ni rgya gar nas bod la dar ba'i chos lugs shig yin pas/ de bod kyi thun mong min pa'i rig gnas su mi brtsi zer/ de la yang rgyu mtshan ci yang med de/ sangs rgyas chos lugs rgya gar nas dar ba de bod kyi rig gnas min pa'i sgrub byed du mi 'gro ste/ sangs rgyas chos lugs bod la dar nas lo ngo stong lhag 'gor bas de dus rgya gar nas dar ba'i chos lugs de dang da lta nga tsho'i bod du dar ba'i chos lugs 'di gnyis ni ngo bo'i steng nas 'gyur tshar na/ rnam pa ni de bas kyang gang na 'dra/bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs de bod rang gi thun min rig gnas shig tu grub yod na yang / de la sangs rgyas chos lugs zer dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni chos lugs 'di'i bsam spyod gang thad nas mgo khungs sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i gzhung la gtugs dgos par snang la/ chos lugs 'di'i nang na sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang 'gal ba'am sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun pa zhig med snyam pa des 'thus so/ yin na yang chos lugs gang zhig yin yang tshang ma mang tshogs khrod du rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel byas pa zhig las ma 'das pas/ de la nor 'khrul dang dgos med kyi cha mi nyung ba zhig 'dres yod nges na de dag tshang ma shākya thub pa'i dgongs pa yin snyam na nor ba chen po zhig go/ de yang dper na/ dmar chog byed pa dang grub mtha'i bar 'khon 'dzing byed pa/ yang na/ yon la dmigs te gto 'don pa dang / rnyed bde grags 'dod kyi phyir gzhan la 121

lo ma dmar po/chos bshad pa dang / rten bzhengs byed pa/ sgyin pa gtong ba la sogs pas mtshon/ mdor na sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bya 'gul yod tshad sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang mi 'gal ba zhig yong mi thub na yang / 'di dag tshang ma bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs ma red sus zer/ de'i phyir da lta bod khul du sgrig lam dang kun spyod kyis ma 'dul la/ mgo 'dzin dang rmebadag skyong byed mkhan yang med par cicha lugs ya ma zung dang bsam spyod gang thad nas cha 'jog med pa'i ban de dang jo mo ches shin tu mang po zhig ga sa gang na khyab yod pa de yang da lta'i bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi snang tshul nyam nga ba zhig tu kho bos 'dod/ 4sangs rgyas chos lugs ni nam yang bsgyur bcos mi chog pa'i yang dag dang tshad ldon zhig tu 'dod na nga tsho'i bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs de yang / de bzhin bsgyur bcos mi byed par rang sor 'jog dgos byung bas mthar sus kyang khas mi len pa'i chos lugs shig tu rang shugs kyis 'gyur mi 'gro ba'i nges pa ci yod/ de bzhin gral rim yod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi nang du bshu gzhog gral rim gyi dbang sgyur byed thabs su gyur ba'i chos lugs gang mang zhig yod na/ da lta'i char dpal 'byor 'phrog rtsod kyi spyi tshogs 'di la yang de bzhin dpal 'byor 'phrog rtsod kyi lag cha kho nar gyur ba'i chos lugs rab dang rim pa zhig yod pas/ de dag tshang ma sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang mthun thabs med na yang sangs rgyas /22—

chos lugs kyi snang tshul zhig tu sus kyang ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ chos lugs ni lo rgyus kyi snang tshul zhig yin te/ de la byung ba dang 'phel ba/ 'jig pa bcas kyi bya rim ldan/ yang na chos lugs ni mi rigs rig gnas kyi snang tshul zhig yin pas/ mi rigs dar rgud dang thad sor 'brel ba yod la/ mi rigs dar rgud kyi 'gros dang bstun chos lugs la la 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba ma zad chos lugs 'ga' re rang shugs su med par gyur ba'ang yod/ yang gcig bshad na/ chos lugs ni mi rigs goms galhas dang mnyam bsre byas te rgyun 'dzin byed nges yin pas/ chos lugs bsgyur bcos ma byas na goms gshis la 'gyur ba mi 'gro zhing goms gshis rim bzhin 'gyur ba des chos lugs rang shugs kyis 'gyur kyi yod pa red/gang ltar ‘‘chos lugs’’ zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di thog mar la ting skad las byung ba dang don ni lha la bkur bsti byed pa dang zung du sbrel ba/yang bskyar zung du sbrel ba'i don du 'jug ste mi dang lha gnyis zung du sbrel ba lta bu'o/’’ zhes pa ltar lha 'dre'i 'du shes gtso bor 'dzin pa'i lam lugs shig yin pa ni 'dzam gling gi chos lugs gang yin yang tshang ma gcig 'dra red/ de'i byung ba ni ‘‘la rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i chos lugs ni ston pa shākya thub pas sangs rgyas chos lugs srol btod pa dang ye shus ye shu'i chos lugs dar spel byas pa nas byung ’’ bar 123

lo ma dmar po/bshad kyang ston pa ma byon gong nas mu stegs pa'i chos lugs mang po zhig yod nges pas de dag tshang ma rang rang la bsnyen bkur byed sa'i lha gang rung re yod pa yang gcig mtshungs red snyam/ khyad par bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs ni/ sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bod kyi chos lugs ma zad bo+on po'i chos lugs gsum gyi grub char brten nas byung ba zhig red snyam ma/ chos lugs thun mong gi snang tshul/bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs bshad pa'i skabs 'dir chos lugs thun mong gi shes bya'i skor cung zad bshad dgos 'dug pas/gong du lha 'dre'i 'du shes gtso bor 'dzin pa'i lam lugs zer ba de yang /mothar gtugs na/ de yang gsham gyi phyogs 'di dag nas nges par byas na ba/ 'o//1 lha zhes pa ni/ mi'i bsam blo ltar gyi chags sdang gi gzhan dbang du ma gyur la/ de la rang dbang ba dang / rtag brtan ther zug tu gnas pa sogs kyi khyad chos mi las ngo mtshar ba yod/ lha ni sdug bsngal gtan med dang yon tan tshad rdzogs shig yin pa dang / de'i stobs shugs ni mthil phyin pa dang rtser son pa mi yi stobs shugs las ring du brgal /24

ba yin pas de mi rnams kyis skyabs su 'dzin pa red/ la las bshad na lha zhes pa ni ‘‘rang byung gi 'gog rgya las grol ba'i mi yi bsam blo dang mi sems tsam yin’’ zhes bshad/ de ltar yin na/ ‘‘mi la re ba med tshe lha yang yod par mi 'gyur ro’’ zhes pa ltar mi rnams kyi 'dod blor mthun pa'i rtog ngo na gnas pa'i rdzas grub cig tu 'khums/ ‘‘lha yi rang bzhin ni 'dod blo zhig yin’’ zhes pa de yang / don ngo mar mi rnams kyis lha yi bde skyid la re snyeg byed pa las ma 'das/ lha'i 'byung khungs ni mi yin la mi'i dad pa las byung ba zhig yin pas/ lha la dad pa dang lha gnyis phan tshun rten byung 'brel yin snyam/ 'on kyang rtog ngo na gnas pa'i lha deskabs 'gar sha khrag gdos ba/ cas kyi phung bor gnas pa zhig tu gyur ba yod la/ lha'i yul du gyur ba'i mi zhig lha ngo mar 'gyur ba yang yod nges/ de ltar bshad na lha zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di chos lugs kyi tha snyad cig yin pa las rang byung tshan rig ste/ dngos lugs dang rdzas 'gyur cisogs kyi tha snyad cig dang yang na 'jig rten pa'i tha snyad cig gtan nas min/ der brten lha ni phra mthong che shel sogs kyis blta byar rung ba zhig ga la yin/ ‘‘gshag gri dang che shel la brten nas srog chags dang mi yi don lnga snod drug las lha rnyed par re ba ni chos lugs la cha rgyus med pa'i skyon yin’’zer ba ltar lha ni dad pa dang rtog btags mi sems khrod du ma gtogs rnyed rgyu med pa zhig tu phal cher gyis 'dod do//25

lo ma dmar po/2 mi dang lha gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ lha ni mi'i to+og ngoru gnas la mi'i bde skyid ni lha la rag las pa/ yang na lha ni mi'i dad pa'i stobase shugs las bskrun par bshad kyang de gnyis mi mtshungs pa'i cha gang yin zer na/ rang dbang can dang gzhan dbang ba'i khyad par/ yun gtan dang gnas skabs tsam gyi khyad par/ skye 'chi ོ༷da pa dang skye 'chi med pa'i khyad par/ ma zad mi'i bde skyed ni lha'i bde skyid lta bu'i rgyun gtan zhig min pa dang / mi'i bsam blo ni lha'i bsam blo lta bu'i 'gyur med cig min pa sogs mi dang lha gnyis ngo bo gcig tu bshad mkhan yod kyang rnam pa'i khyad par gyi cha du ma mchis/ mi ni lha'i bdag po yin par bshad na mi ni rang la gal che na thams cad la gal che bar 'dzin pa dang / rang la mi mkho na thams cad mkho med du smra mkhan zhig yin pas yod tshad rang gis thag gcod bzhin pa 'dis lha yang de'i dbang du 'gyur srid/ de ltar chos lugs mi gcig pa re la lha mi gcig pa re dang / snang —tshul mi gcig pa so so'i dbang gis lha gcig dang sna tshogs su snang bzhin yod pa 'di bzhin lags/ 3 chos lugs dang chos lugs min pa'i lta tshul gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ rgyal bo dang bla drag dzini sa na gnas pa'i lha yi 'thus tshabs yin pa dang / rgyal bo'i khrod kyi rgyal bo dang bla drag nang gi bla drag ni lha yin par smra na de ni chos lugs kyi lha tshul dang / rgyal bo dang bla drag yang 126

bod kyi ser mo ba/'jig rten gyi bdag nyid can dang mi yi rang bzhin du 'dod na de ni chos lugs min pa'i lta tshul red/ ye shu'i chos lugs pa rnams4kyis rā+o ma'i rgyal por gnam gyi rgyal po dang khri lo zhes pa'i cho lo sbyar nas gong ma dang gong ma dam par 'bod pa dang / rgya nag gi rgyal por bod kyi chos pas gong ma gnam gyi rgyal po zhes 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam sprul yin par sgrogs pa sogs ni chos lugs kyi lta tshul red/ de'i rkyen kyis/ nub gling bas ‘‘shar phyogs ba rnams rgyal po dang chab srid gnyis kyi stobs shugs kyi mdun du sa rdul bzhin nyam chung / ’’ zhes bshad pa red/ yang gcig bshad na/ phag sha mthong na chos lugs pa 'ga' re sngangs skrag 'chor ba dang / chos lugs ma yin pas de ji mi snyam par za bar byed/ yang / mi ni gang ltar shi 'gro ba yin pas de'i tshe thag cung zad re bsring thub na ma gtogs 'jig rten pa la thabs gzhan med na yang chos lugs pas 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang la re ba byed/ sad ser dang than pa'i rang byung gnod 'tshe byung skabs 'jig rten pas de ni bsgyur med kyi ltas dbang zhig tu —'dod la/ chos lugs pas de dus lha yis dngos grub stsol bar re ba byed/ chos lugs dang 'jig rten gnyis kyi dmigs yul gcig sa mang yang ‘‘rang byung gi khrod nas blangs pa'i thabs shes la brten nas dmigs yul 'grub thabs byed pa’’ dang ‘‘thabs shes la mi brten pa'am yang na bsngo smon dang / dad pa/ bsnyen bkur/ rdzu 'phrul 127

lo ma dmar po/sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thabs tsam la brten nas dmigs yul 'grub thabs byed pa’’ gnyis kyi—khyad par yod/ de ltar/ nad drag par phan pa'i lag rtsal 'jig rten pa la yod kyang / nam yang nad mi 'byung ba'i lag rtsal de la yod mi srid/ de bzhin tshe thag je ring du gtong ba'i lag rtsal yod pa'i tshad du 'jig rten pa glebs thub kyang / nam yang mi 'chi bar byed pa'i lag rtsal ngo ma zhig dgos na/ chos lugs pa las gzhan su la'ang med/ der brten/ ‘‘rig gnas ni nam yang chos lugs kyi mdun na rjes lus yin ’’ zer don yang de las byung ngo / de ltar chos lugs thun mong gi khyad chos mang tsam rtogs rjes nga tsho'i bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs la yang de'i thun mong gi khyad chos de nyid rang chas su yod par gzhi nas go ba len thub pas/ da gzod bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi thun min khyad chos gang yod la zhib 'ju ga byed sla/2003 6 5/28 rmo

dam pa'i chos zhes pa'i go don mdor bsdus/〈dbu ma bzhi brgya ba〉 las/ ‘‘chos ni mdor na mi 'tshe bar// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs// ’’ zhes dang / rje btsun byams pa mgon pos/ ‘‘sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang // sgrib pa kun sel da'i / pa'i chos// ’’ zhes dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ ‘‘bas mu / mi da gnyis re/da rtogs me/nga/ nga/// dban gsal gnyen po'i phyogs/ nyid kyi// gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba// bden gnyis mu /chan nyid can de chos// zhes don sna tshogs la 'jug pa dang / 〈rnane / bshad rigs pa〉〉las ‘‘chos ni shes bya lam/ dang ni// mya ngan 'das dang yi da/ kyi yul// bso/da nams tshe dang gsung rab dang // 'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o// ’’zhes don bcu la 'jug par gsungs pa dang / de dag bsdus tshe gsung rab dang shes bya lugs gsum du 'du bar 'dod kyang de dag tshang ma gzhung gzhan du gsal bas// 'dir mi 'god/'dir gtso bo dam pa'i chos zhes pa de dzes 'dzin byed pa'i zhor du chos dang chos min gyi dbye ba yang cung bshad par bya'o/1 chos zhes pa ni/ dge ba'i chos dang mi dge chos/ chos thams cad stong zhing bad/ga re/da pa zhes pa'i skabs kyi chos dang / yang na/ chos dang chos can gyi 'brer+ṣa/ ba dang / chos de chos bzhin du ma byas na mthar /29

lo ma dmar po/chos kyis slar ngan song du 'gro ba'i rgyu byed/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum/ chos kyi khri steng mthon po nas/ bla mas chos gsungs par chos dad mang tshogs ser skya yongs chos zhu ru 'gro lta bu sogasakyi skabs so sor ‘‘chos’’ zhes pa'i brda chad 'di don sna tshogs su 'gro ba yod kyang / la las de tsam yang mi shes nga 'am mnyam 'jog mi byed pa/ de dag gi phan tshun 'brel ba ci yin sogs mi lta bar gang byung du bshad mang bas/ thog mar nges dgos pa zhig ni ‘‘chos ’’ zhes pa bod skad du bkol spyod byed don legs sbyar gyi dhamo zhes pa'i skad dod du bzhag pa yin la/ dharma zhes pa'i don ni 'dzin pa zhes par go dgos pa dang / 'dzin pa ni rang gi ngo bor 'dzin pa ste gzhi grub na de yin pas khyab pa de'o/ 'o na gzhi grub na chos yin pas khyab na chos min gyi spyod pa gzhi med red dam zer na/ de'i skabs su yang 'dzin pa la'o zhes pa rang gi ngo bo tsam la mi byed par lhung ba las 'dzin pa ste/ 'khor ba la lhung ba dang / nang 'gror lhung ba/ yang na srid zhi la lhung ba sogs las 'dzin par byed pa zhes 'greladagos pa de red zer/ de ltar byas na da gzod dharma 'dzin pa la'o zhes pa'i legs sbyar gyi bying bsgrub de'i go don 'dzin pa zhes pa la khyab che chung gnyis yod de rang gi ngo bor 'dzin pa ni khyab byed spyi dang lhung ba las 'dzin par byed pa ni khyab bya de'i bye brag yin pa gzhi nas go ba len thub/ de nas chos thams rang gi ngo bor 'dzin pa /30

bad kya sar ma ba/yin pa shes rjes da ni lhung ba las 'dzin par byed pa'i chos bye brag ba zhig yod pa de gang yin zer na/ de ni 'dir dmigs su 'dzin pa'i brjod bya dngos te dam pa'i chos zhes pa de red/2 ci zhig la dam pa'i chos zhes brjod zer na/ de yang /〈mdo 〉〉 las/ ‘‘dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/tha rme/ra dge ba/ don bzang bo/ tshig 'bru bzang bo/ ma 'dres/ ba/ yongs su rdzogs pa / yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ ’’ zhes dang / de'i don ni ma/dor bsdu sa na/ ‘‘thog ma dang bar dang tha mu / gsurme ni tshul khrims dang ting nge 'ji'e/ dang / shes rab kyi phung bo yo ngas su nyams nga/ med pas dge ba dang / den bzang bo ni phyin ci ma/ lag pa'i brjod bya phun sum tshogs pa dang / ma 'dres pa ni/ gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa ni nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir dang / yongs su dag pa ni rang gi sa'i nyon mongs pa las rnam par grol ba'i ngo bo nyid rnam par grol ba dang / yongs su byang ba ni sa gzhan gyi nyon mongs kyi bag la nyal spangs pas shrī/da rnam par grol ba ste/ de dag dang ldan na dam pa'i chos su rtogs par bya'o’’zhes pa lta bu dang / yang na 〈mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa〉〉 las/ ‘‘ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid de/ de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / sgrub par byed/ pa kho na yin/ ’’ zhes gsungs pa ltar de la yang lung gi chos rjod 131
