0po ma dmar po/byed sde snod gsum dang rtogs pa'i chos brjod bya bslab pa gsum ste gnyis su dbye bar bshad/ nyams su blang bar bya ba ni bslab pa gsum dang nyams len gyi tshul ston pa'i gzhung ngam gsung rab ni sde snod gsum yin pas de gnyis la lung rtogs kyi bstan pa zhes bya ste/ 〈lam rim chen mo〉 las/ ‘‘lung gi bstan pa ni chos lag tu len pa'i tshul sgrub par byed lu gas gtan la 'beb nga/ yin la/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa ni gtan la phab nga/ na ji lta ra gtan la phab pa ltar bsgrub nga yi na pas/ de gnyis rgyu 'bras su 'gro ba yi na te/ dper na/ rta rgyug pa na spo na 'a rta la dkyus sa ste na pa dang bsta na zin nas der rgyugs pa lta bu'o’ zhes/ gsu ngas/ des na/ brjod bya dang rdzod byed kyi khyad par zhig las de dag tshang ne / darma/ nga 'i chos zer ba de red la/ dme pa'i chos kyi sgra bshad yang / bu ston rin chen grub kyis/ ‘dam pa rjogs/ pa'i sangs rgyas yi na la/ des bstan nga/'i chos yirin pas dam pa'i chos zhes sam/ dam pa ni mchog tu gyur ba yin la/chos kyang yin pas dam pa'i chos de gzhi mthun pa'o/ yang na/ skyes bu dam pas spyad par bya bas dam pa'i chos de dge slong gi chos bzhi bzhin no/ ’’ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdor na mi rnams kyis tshe 'di'i bde skyid sgrub thabs cam dang / ya nga na tshe phyi mar phan pa'i thabs la yang lam ma yin pa dang / lam log par gol ba sogs du ma ma/chis pa las ring du brgal ba dang / khyad du 'phags shong sa dang lam/ gyi rim pa yongs su chang /32

ba'i thar ba thams cad mkhyen pa ji/ba pa'i thabs ma smad pa zhig sangs rgyas kho nas bstan pa de la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'am dam pa'i chos zer zhes brjod chog de'i ngo bo ni gzhan la mi 'tshe ba dang snying rje'i rang bzhin can zhig tu sus kyang 'dod do/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i go don yang gzhan du/ ‘‘'khor ba sdu ga bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las gardote'e sdo go'/ byed kyi thabs dang de brjod byar byed/ nga/'i lu nga rtogs spyi nga6ri dru sa sanyis ci rigs kyi/sa bsduru/ pa chi/ga snyewa/ sa ngas/ rgyas hūṃ bsta na rngaci/ (bye/si byakho/ ’ nyes dang / ‘8nang ba'i bsta na pa di sde las ldog ste sdu ga bstsa smyosrari/ t+pā/su 4/ rgyu dang bcas pa las lo ga pa'i thabs su dngos shugs brgyud gsume gyi sgo myo/sa 'gyur ba sha stag yin ’ zhes dang /dam/ pa'i chos kyi nyamu /sa len bsla ba pa gsum du 'du tshul yang / ‘chos 'di ba'i rtogs nga 'i bstan pa ni lhag pa'i bslab pa gsu ma/ du 'du zhing / de gsum ka rnam grol 'theb pa'i rgyur 'gyur tshul ni/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pas bsdus pa'i bdag med nga/'i lta bas sdug bsnga95 gyi la 'bras mtha' dag gang nas byung ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzinagyi ljon shing gce da pa'i ra' gri lta bu yin te ’’ zhes dang / ‘‘de ltar shes rab kyis 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod par rtogs na tshu' khrims dang ting nge 'dzin gnyis kyang de'i rgyu dang grogs su song ba'i sgos sdug bsnga' spong byed du 'gyur ba smos ma/ dgos/ ’ zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / 〈spye da rijug〉 las/ ‘‘ ya/na /3 3

lo ma dmar po/lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pa'i shes rab don du gsungs// de yi phyir na sdug bsngal dag / zhi bar 'dod pa'i shes rab skyed// ’’ zhes gsungs pa sogs la bltas na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang dam pa'i chos zhes pa'i go don mdor bsdus re yid la 'bab thub pas de ni chos lugs dang cha lugs byed lugs goms srol zhig gi ngang tshul las ring du 'da' ba dngos su mthong thub nges/de/'i phyir dam pa'i chos ni 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i ma 'dres pa'i ma ja' bshes chen kro/ ston pa mnyam/ rme/da thub pa'i dbang po de nyid 'jig rten gyi kharme sa 'di nyid du byon pa'i dgos pa'ang yin la/ de la ma/de sngags kyi bstan nga/ chang la ma nor ba yongs su rdzogs pa 'dis/ khong la bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong las kyang pad dkar ltar bsngags shing rtsod ldan gyi snyigs ma'i dus 'dir byon pa'i dgos pa khyad par ba de yang de yin pas/ nga tsho'i sa sgang hril bo'i 'dzam gling gi rin bral nor bu lta bu'i dam pa'i chos kyi dgongs don la slob sbyong dang lag len ci thub re byed rgyu ni ris med mi yi 'gro ba 'di'i ma bgos rang skal zhig tu rngasprorngasprothag 3 chos dang chos min gyi khyad par ni/ dam pa'i chos kyi go don rags tsam zhig shes rjes da ni chos dang chos min gyi dbye ba ji ltar byed dgos zer na/ de yang mdor sgril na dam pa'i chos kyi dgongs don dang /34

mthun pa'i bya spyod la chos dang de dang rgyab 'gal gyi bya spyod yod tshad la chos min gyi spyod pa zhes bya ste/ de dag dge mi dge gnyis kyi go don dang phal cher 'dra ste/‘‘'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ste// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags ma sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba'o// ’’zhes pa ltar chags sogs nyon mo/ngas pas bskyed ma bskyed kyi khyad nga/ra las dge mi dge'i bsam spyod 'jog dgos pa ltar/ gzhan la 'tshe ba'i bsam spyod gang yod chos mi/na dang gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i bsam spyod yi na na chos su 'gro bar bshad/ de yang / slob dpon pad+mas/ ‘‘snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul/ zhes dang / 〈mdo〉〉 las/ ‘ gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ ’’ zhes dang / ‘‘chos gcig lag mthil du mchis na chos thams cad lag mthil du mchis par 'gyur te/ gang zhe na/ snying rje chen po'o/’’ zhes dang / 〈gso sbyong gi tshigs su bcad pa〉 las/ ‘‘sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing // dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin//’/ zhes dang /'brom ston pas/ ‘‘nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro na chos dang mi 'gro na chos min/ ’’zhes dang / gung thang bas/ ‘‘chos su song tshad 'di snang zhen lag yin/ chos kyi snying bo thabs shes zung 'jug yin/’’ zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin//35

lo ma dmar po/mdor na/ chos ni bya spyod kyi steng nas gzhan la phan pa bsgrub pa dang /bsam pa'i steng nas snying rje'i kun slong gtso che ba/ dmigs yul gyi steng nas tshe phyi ma'i mngon mtho nges legs kyi don du dmigs pa zhig yin dgos 'dug de min/ ‘‘bsam pa dge dang mi dge'i khyad par las// dge sdig gzugs brnyan che chung rjes mi 'gro// ’’ zhes pa ltar/ 'jig rten gyi rnyed bde grags 'dod kyi ched gzugs brnyan ci 'dra zhig bskrun kyang de mi chos min gyi bsamu / pa zhig dang de'i rjes 'bras kyang chos su 'gro ba shaṃn tu dka'/ khyad par gzhan la 'tshe ba'i bya spyod gang yod la kun slong bzang po zhig med shas che yang / gal te yod zer na yang / chos min gyi bya ba zhig las chos su 'gro thabs dka'/de ltar chos dang chos min gyi rnam bzhag mdor bsdus shig mdzub mo'i ri ston gyi tshul du bkod pa 'di ni gal che bar bsams nas sa bon tsam zhig yin pa las/ gtso bo mi rang rang gis 'di la zhib mo'i blo yis yun/ ring dpyad de sbyangs ba byed rgyur rag las/ de lta min par 'di tsam la yang rgyus mnga' cung zad kyang med par chos kyi kha pho mthon por bsgrengs ba ni mi rigs yar rgyas kyi rgyud pa'i zhags thag rmong dad kyi mun pa'i zhwa mo nag po zhig gis rang mgo rang gis g.yog pa las gzhan ci// //2()03 1 0 1136
bod kyi ser mo ba ni — sto 'i ra sto 'a — ༷ bad kya sar ma ba' khrung 'a gyu ra / 137

don dam bsam blo'i sne khrid mdzad mkhan bod kyi ser mo ba yun nas yun du gnas dgos/don dam shes rig gi khyab khongs gang la yang mkhyen rgya yangs pa'i bod kyi ser mo ba 'di yun nas yun du gnas dgos te/ 'di ni nga tsho'i mi'i rigs kyi deng rabs rigs pa smra ba'i mtshon dpe ngo ma zhig yin/ gal te de med par 'gyur ba'i dus shog yod na dus de ni blun rmong gi dus shig dang / mgo 'thom gyi dus dze+eg spyi tshogs de ni mun nag dang kla klo'i spyi chogs shig dngos gnas yin rgyu red/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bod kyi ser mo ba'i las rigs kyi tshab byed thub mkhan zhig nam yang 'byung mi thub pas so/ de yang sngar kyi byung ba ni sngar gyi chos 'byung lo rgyus khungs thub dag las shes dgos te/ dper na/ bka' gdams bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang / lam rim bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar sogs la mjal na ha cang gsal bo red/ deng dus kyi ser mo ba ni sngon chad dang bsdur na phyogs gang ci'i thad nas lhag 'phro tsam zhig las med na yang / mi mngon pa'i tshul du de'i rig gnas yon tan ni sus kyang do zla bral ba zhig red/ de yang gsham gyi phyogs 'di dag nas gsal bar 138

byed dgos te/gcig ban ser mo ba'i deng dus bod kyi spyi tshogs la 'dzin pa'i lta chul/1 spyi tshogs rgyus lon gyi steng nas grwa rkyang gi sems khams gleng ba/'dir grwa rkyang dkyus ma zhig dpe mtshon byas te brjod par byed pa la/ 'urdzong yon tan rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i snyan rtsom 〈dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i snying gtam〉 las/ ‘6snying gtam 'di gas na rjes nga cho phan tshun yid ches byed chog pa'i grogs por 'gyur yang srid la/ sems kyi sdug bsngal dang gas nga ba yod tshad kyang 'dzem med du brjod chog ste/nga'i yod tshad deb chung 'di ru gsal ’ zhes brjod pa ltar/ deb chung der kho'i dri med kyi lhag bsam dang gshis rgyud/ spyi tshogs 'dir 'jin pa'i bsam blo yod tshad lham mer gsal yod/ de'i nang du/ ‘‘bod kyi rtsom rig zer ba ni rtsom pa po bod rigs dang rtsom byed bod kyi skad yig yin cam gyi cha nas mi 'jog par gtso bo rtsom pa po'i bsam pa'i langs phyogs dang lta ba'i 'khyer so'i steng nas 'jog dgos pa yin/’’ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khong gi rtsom yig 'di la bod kyi rtsom yig gi deb chung ngo ma zhig gi cha rkyen tshang 'dug pas/ ngas lhag tu gdeng 'jog byas pa yin/ ngas kyang rgya bod yig rigs gnyis kyi steng nas rtsom yig dang deb chung gang mang zhig bklags myong yang bod kyi rtsom yig gi gzhi rtsa'i re 'dun 'jog /39

lo ma dmar po/byed kyi sdom tshig cig da thengs ma gtogs rnyed ma byung / ldong yon tan rgya mtsho ni rnga ba sgo mang dgon gyi grwa rgyang dkyus ma zhig red zer/ khong gi bod rigs gyi mdun lam la dmigs pa'i mig rgyang ni ha cang ring la/ khong gis da lta'i nga tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi rnam/ par 'dzin pa'i lta tshul ni dngos gnas lhad med cig red/ ma zad/ khong grwa pa zhig yi na pa'i ngos nas sa ngas rgyas kyi bstan par zhugs pa'i dmigs yul dang re 'dun yod chad chud zos su song med nga 'i mngon rtags kyang gsal bo red/ khong gis/ ‘‘mi / rigs shig gi dar rgud la bsam/ gzhig tsam gtogs shes pa nan+da/ bzung nga'i sems khams gtan nas bde ma myong la/ bde thabs kyang gang na lod/ ’’ zhes dang / ‘‘dus rabs 'khor skyod kyi bar mtsham sa las rjes lus dang nyams rgud ṣ+pebs pa'i rang mi rigs kyi khe phan la bsam gzhig tsam yang ma btang na ga la 'grig’’ zhes thad kar bshad pa nang bzhin khong gi rtsom yig hril bo'i nang don la bltas na dngos gnas khong la de'i sems shugs rang chas su ldan/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ yang khong gis bkod pa ltar/ ‘‘slob grwa nas mthar phyin pa'i slob ma phal mo ches bod kyi yul srol goms gshes dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs lta zhog tha na bod skad kyang bshad mi shes par mi rigs yar rgyas la bya ba bsgrub rgyu phar zad khyim bza' tshang gi nang la'ang lkug pa ltar lag pas brda sprod pa dang / gzhan ska/da da ma dig gis gleng rmal byed dgos 1/()

pa'i gnas su lhung ’’zhes dang /‘‘yul srol goms ga3|sa dang chos 'u/gas/skad yig sogs gnas skabs kyi khe dbang dang lto gos tsam gyi ched du 'phong phyes kyi rdo bzhin dor na glen lkug ngo ma yang snying su red’’sogs kyi gnas chu' rirab dang rim pa zhig mthong yod pas/ khong gi blo sems bde la ma babs pa yin ro/sa che/ yang khong gis bkod don/ ‘‘da ska bas bod rigs ni rang skyo nga snyekhro+o ngas gcib/ dang / rang skyong khul brgya/da/ mu /nyañca ri 'brel rang sgu+o nga khul gnyis/ rang skyong rjo nga gnyis bcas 'a sa grub cing mi grangs khri bzhi brgya las brga' ba'i mi/ rigarngashrī chen ngo/ zhig yin kyang / rang nyid kyi skad yi ga gco rbar sbyo nga sa 'i slob grwa shin tu nyung ’’ (ne+es/ dang / yang ‘‘dper na da skabs rgya'i dus deb kyi grangs tshad stong phrag brgyad las brga' zhing /bod la go brgyad lor bsdom/sa rtsis byas pa ltar na dus deb bzhi bcu lhag byung yod skad/ dus deb de dag kyang phal cher rtsom rig gi ra ba las brgal med pas spyi cesags kyi dgos mkho dang cher mi 'tsham zhing brda 'phrin gyi nus pa'ang shin tu zhan’’zhes spyi chogs 'dir sems khur yod pa tsam ma yin par zhib mo/'i nyams rgyus len bzhin yod pa red/ ma zad khos de dag la byed thabs kyang gnas sdo/gas yod pa'i sgo nas brjod yong/ de/ dper na/ ‘‘tang gi 'tshogs chen bco lnga ba'i don tshan bdun pa 'a sa rtsom rig sgyu rtsa' dang gsar 'gyur dpar skrun/ rgyang sgrog brnyan 'phrin 4/

lo ma dmar po/sogs kyi las don dar spel gtong rgyu ni 'dzugs skrun gyi gtso snying yin/zhes pa'i bslab ston gzhir 'dzin dgos/’’zhes dang /‘‘brnyan 'phrin slob gso la slob ma'i lo tshod dang dbang bo bde thang gi tshad bkag med par skye bo rgan gzhon su yin kyang blta ba dang / nyan chog pas/ brgya cha'i bdun cu yig rmong pa yin pa'i mi rigs shig la mtshon na ches mchog gyur gyi slob gso gtong thabs lhag yin ’’ zhes dang / ‘‘bod yig slob grwa'i mthar phyin 'dzin yig yod tsam gyis dge rgan du 'jog rkyang mi byed par dge rgan zhes pa gna' deng rig gzhung gi yon tshad nges can zhig yod dgos shing slob khrid kyang gna' deng thabs shes bzang bo zung 'brel byas na yid ches chog pa'i gsar skyes dpung khag bzang bo zhig bskyed bsrings byed thub’’ zhes pa sogs kyi bsam blo dang 'di lta bu'i spyi tshogs rgyus lon gyi byang tshad yod pa ni grwa ba 'di'i ma bgos rang 'gul gyis dka' spyad gang mang zhig byas pa'i grub 'bras yin la nga tsho tshang ma dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras shig kyang red de/ ched du slob gso'i sde khag sogs su yod pa'i rgyal khab kyi las byed dag la mtshon na 'di dag ni shes dgos pa dang nges dgos pa'i don dag gal chen rkyang rkyang yin na yang da lta phal cher gyis ci zhig zer ba tsam yang mi shes/2 rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas grwa rkyang gi sems khams gleng ba/ldong yon tan rgya mtsho ni 1974lor mdo rmad rnga yul du skyes shing 142

bod kyi ser mo ba/dgung la bcu gsum steng rab tu byung nas snga rjes su dmu dge bsam gtan rin po che dang / bkra shis 'khyile du rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang /rje blo bzang rgya maḥdzha sogs zha sa mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung mang por thos bsam byas te 1994la dang 1999lor sgo mang dgon du gzhung chen blo rgyugs 'gran sdur stong khong gis 〈byang chub lam rim chen mo)〉 dang 〈sngags rim/ chen mo〉〉 sogs blo rgyugs su phul bas gser dngul gyi rtags me thob nga/ dang / 'jigs med rgyal mtshan sger bcugs slob grwa ru lo ngo du ma/ra dge rgan du bzhugs nas slob ma'i tshogs kyang ma nga du ba3/ngas/khong gis 〈me tog cig gi rang gtam〉〉 las / rang nyid me tog cig yin pa'i dbang du byas te rang nyid kyi lta ba brjod skabs ‘‘las dbang la 'khreng zhen che ba'i nga rang / las dbang gis gnas 'dir sprum ’’zhes ‘‘las las 'jig rten sna tshogs skye’’ zhes pa'i lta ba de gzhir bzung nas yod tshad las dbang gis thag gcod bzhin yod pa de khong gi 'jig rten lta tshul yin pa bstan/spyi chosags 'di'i gnas bab brngod skabs/‘‘khu sim pa'i gangs 'dab 'dir/ lhags rlung dang kha ba'i 'tshub ma 'khor’’ zhes dka' sdug dang mnar gcod kyi las dbang zhig mchon par byarnga5/ 143

lo ma dmar po/la dga' zhing gangs ri la dung / nga gangs lha me tog gi rigs rgyud yin phyir/ yod tshad gangs ri la dbang zhing gangs ljongs kyi ched du 'bul/’’zhes rtsom pa po blo sems gcig sgril gyis rang mi rigs la dga' zhen dang dung ba che la de'i don du yod tshad phul thub pa'i chod sems bstan/rang nyid kyi phugs bsam dang brtson sems brjod skabs/ ‘‘nga'i 'dab lo re rer phugs bsam dang gsar gtod kyi gsang ba sbrum/ gangs ri'i ma/dzes sdug gi ched du ge sasgo gyi dngos grub rdzogs mi/ srid ’’ zhes nam yang mi rigs 'a 'dzin pa'i lhag bsam 'dor mi srid pa dang / de'i hur brtson la nam yang lhod yeng mi gtong ba'i yi dam brtan po yod pa bstan/re smon dang yid ches brjod skabs/‘‘nga'i mdun na dpyid dpal gyi bsu ma yod la/ nga'i steng na nyi gzhon gyi drod khol 'khyil bas/ nga rtag brtan gyi gangs lha me tog cig yin/’’ zhes ma 'ongs gangs ljongs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i mdun lam la re smon dang 'bad brtson lhod med kyi grub 'bras bzang por yid ches tshad mtho byas pa'o/de lha bu'i bsam blo dang gshis rgyud ldan pa ni khong tsam ma yin par khong dang khong 'dra ba'i deng dus kyi grwa rkyang tsho yin la/ bsam blo des las dbang la yid ches na brtson sems dang 'dun par gnod snyam pa'i 144

bod kyi ser mo ba/lag rtog de med par gtong thub pa dang / rtsom yig 'di bklag pas deng rabs kyi rigs pa smra ba'i sde khag de gar yod shes thub la/ deng dus spyi chogs la sman pa'i mi sna gar yod yang shes thub/ yang/ ‘‘mdun ljongs ring mor gzigs pa'i 'dren byed med// rjes phyoṭa thob shar gang byung bsam gzhig sped// rtswa chu rang la dbang min zhib dpyod med// ma brtags byung rgyal ku cos gnam sa g.yo//’’zhes 'brog pa bsam me da ཿṭā'i nang dme/ la bsdig pa dang / yang khong gis rang nyid kyi yon tan la yid tshim pa'i spro snang zhig gis 〈btsun pa'i khengs gluno〉zhig blangs ba las kyang /‘‘zing zing 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag/ 'grub mi na thugs khral ni med pas//zla zhal dkyil 'khor gyi ngos yangs// 'jum dkar me tog/ gis brgyan 'dug/’’ zhes dang / ‘‘bshang gci'i bdam rdzab tu ma lhung // lanachags bu lan gyis ma bskor// sku lus rin chen gyi sgrom bur// lhan skyes dri bsung gis khyab 'dug/ btsan phyug dbang thang la ma smon// mjes ma'i g.yo 'phrul la ma chags// gsar skyes rtswa ljang gi gdan du// bde chen 'od phung dang 'dres 'dug/’’ zhes/ gzhan mthon po'i go sa dang phyug po'i rgyu nor gang la yang cung zad tsam yang mi chags par blo sems rnal du phab thub pa de ni grwa btsun tsho'i ches khyad par can gyi yon tan zhig red/gnyis pa/ grwa pa'i mi gzhi de gang nas byung ba'i skor gleng ba/grwa ba dang ban de la thun mong ma yin pa'i mi gzhi zhig dang bsam 145

lo ma dmar po/rī ga yod pa ni/ sger sems chung zhing spyi sems che ba/ blo dkar zhing gyu da drang ba/ las 'bras la yid ches shing mdun lam la brtson pa bskyed/g.yo sgyu dang phrag dog brnab sems dang gnod sems gdug rtsub sogs kyi bsam spyod yongs su dor ba zhig dang dus rgyun spro snang gis khengs shing dus rgyun spyi tshogs la thugs khur byed/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas gang yod la spro snang gis 'jug pa zhig go/ 'o na de'i rgyu rkyen gang la thug zer na/ gnyis te/ slob gso gtong stangs dang phyi rol yu' gyi rgyu rkyen gnyis so/ 1 grwa ba la slob gso gtong stangs kyi khyad par zhig ste/‘‘'dod chung chog shes’’ gyi slob gso des/ dpal yon gnyis po gang yang mi mkho ba zhig tu ma gyur bar/ gtso bo bsam pa'i dpal yon gyis phyug pa zhig tu gyur nas ‘‘rang la dgos 'dod chung zhing gzhan la gnang sgyin mang ba’’ ni mi tshe gzhan don du phul ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar las byung ba bzhin no/ slob gso de med pas/ zas gos gnas mal ci zhig gis kyang mgu ba med pa'i pha ma dang khyim tshang spyi tshogs bcas kyi khur bor gyur zhing nam yang nar son mi thub pa'i da lta'i grong nang gi pho gsar mo gsar 'di dag byung / ‘‘'dod chung chog shes’’gyi slob gso des/ phyi yi spyod pa mdzes shing nang gi bsam pa dwangs gtsang gi sngon dang da lta'i ser mo ba'i rigs te/ dge rgan la nam yang gus /46

bod kyi ser mo ba/shingu / pha ma la dus rgyun byams/ phyi thag ring zhing ngang rgyud 'jam pa'i mi sna 'di dag byung la/ de med pas/ khyim tshang kha bral dang / bu phrug dwa bor g.yug pa/ pha ma dgos med du sgo khar phud pa'i me+ong rtul skye bo khong khro ba dang ra bzi ba 'di dag byung nas spyi chogs la gtor 'dre byed/‘‘las 'bras bslu med’’gyi slob gso des/ bya ba kun la zhib tshags ldan zhing / bsam blo kun la mig rgyang ring / srog chags kun la 'tshe ba spangs shing skye bo kun la phan pa bsgru ba/ 'khor yug kun la gces spras byed cing /mi dang rang byung mthun sbyor byas te rang skyid gzhan bde'i 'tsho ba nyams su myong / khyad par gzhan gyi khe phan bsrung zhing rang gi khe phan rang gis rtsod pa'i sngon dang da lta'i mkhas pa dag byung la/ de med pas/ gzhan mgo g.yog cing rang mgo gcog bya ba kun la gtad so med/ las ka kun la mgo mjug med/ rgyal khab kyi rgyu nor skog za dang / mang tshogs la bshu gzhog byed/ mthon por ngo dga' dang dma' mor gnyom sdang byed pa'i khrel med kyi bla ngan dpon ngan dang spyi tshogs kyi khram pa 'di dag byung /yang / phar phyin drug ste/ spyin pa'i slob gsos/ ser sna'i mdun pa grol te spyi tshogs la 'dra mnyam bsam pas zhabs zhu ba sgrub/ tshul khrims kyi slob gsos/ spyod lam ngan pa 'dul zhing ya rabs gus lugs sogs la byang te mi dang mi yi bar la mthun sgyil zam pa 'dzugs/147

lo ma dmar po/bzod pa'i slob gsos/ snying stobs dang sems shugs bskyed cing bya ba kun la dka' sbyad khur du 'khyer/ brtson 'grus kyi slob gsos/ le la sgyid lug 'dor zhing tshul ldan ya rabs kyi las la spro bas 'jug ste dmiṭa yul kun la tshegs med slebs/ bsam gtan gyi slob gsos/blo sems brtan cha thob cing rnam g.yeng ngan spyod dor te bsam pa lhod du 'bab/ shes rab kyi slob gsos/ blo gros gsal zhing rig pa skyen/ shes rgya che zhing blo khog ya ngas bas blang dor kun 'chug med yong ba bcas dang /yang bsdu ba bzhi ste / sbyin nga sa/ 'dra spe /nyam dang mthun sgri'/ roṭa res byed/ snya na smras/ mi sems la spro sna nga ster bas brnyas bcos dang don med snyad 'dogs sogs sngon 'gog byed/ don byed kyis/ kha tsam/ yin par gzhan don lag tu le/na zhing bya ba kun la 'gan nus len/ don mthun gyis/ rang dpe gzhan ston byed cing nyams myong brje res yong ba sogs yin la/ de dag med pas/ blun rmongs dang brnyas bcos/ ser sna dang khong khro/ g.yo sgyu dang phrag dog sogs kyi kla klo'i spyi tshogs shig ched du mdun bsu byed pa nang bzhin red/ gzhan yang / snying rje byams sems kyi slob gso/ stong bdag med kyi slob gso sogs nyams len gyi tshul dang sbyar nas thog mar thos/ thos don bsam par bya ba/de'i don yang nas yang du yid la goms su bcug pas mthar skyes bu chen po/ skyes bu rab/ phul byung dang mchog dang gya nom pa'i lam bzang ma/ngon /4ni

gyur yong ba sogs ni grwa ba dang ban de kho nas spyod yul te/ de dag gi slob gso'i ming tsam yang mi skya phal ba ཿmor med na mi skya pho mo sogs kyis bla mar bkur rung ba zhig ni nam yang ban se ra mo ba las gzhan zhig gang na yod/ yon tan de dag ni mi skya phal ba tsho dang pha na tshun bsdur tshe go ba len thabs tsam du bkod pa zhig las/ ban ser mo ba'i thos bsam sgom/ gsu ma gyi nyam sa len dang sa dang la0 ga/ byi yo na tan so gas ni cher+sā khyad par du 'phags pa zhig dang ches dmi /sa/sa bas kru nga zhig yi ma pas 'dir brjod kyang go ba lo na thabs pre da/ 2 phyi rol yul gyi cha rkyen 'don sprod skode gleng nga/grwa ba'i phyi rosnyel gyi rgyu rkyen ches bzang shas de ni chi ga gcig gis —bshad na khyim pre/da pa de'o/ khyim me da pa des/ mi gzhi 'jon thang dang rig gnas yon tan gyi ches dwangs ma'i bzang cha dag thad sor mi la ma kho sprod byed de / khyim re da pas/ rang 'dod sger sems che ba'i bsam pa yongs jisu 'dor thub ste/ khyim tshang gi 'aces ba'i gnon shugs gang yang me da pa'i phyir/ khyim med pas/ g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi bya ngan spyod ngan yongs sdo/ 'dor thub ste/ thob dang go sa shākya 'byor 'khor g.yog so gas la ci yang sred pa mi byed pa'i phyir/ khyim med pas/ nang dme 'khon 'dzing dang rku 'phrog bco4 / gsum sogs kyi bya spyod mi/ bsgrub par rang dbang rang gis kha 'a/ spyur thung te/ bza' zla bu dru ga gang gi gzhan da/bang du shor /49

lo ma dmar po/ba med pa'i phyir/yang gcig bshad na/ khyim yod pas/ bya ba kun la rang dbang bral/ rig gnas kun la mos pa chung / mi gzhi kun la lhad skyon phog ste/bu pho'i 'dod blo sgrub ched me— mda' zhig dang bu mo'i 'dod blo skong ched ske rgyan zhig nyos na bu phrug re rer 'dod phyogs kha kha re/ re rer gang dgos bsgrub kyang ngom pa med/ bsgrub pa dka' tsheg gang la'ang mi 'dzem rung / 'grub pa'i dus shig yod ma yin/ chung bshang lci'i 'dam nas gnyor skyong byas nas lo na nyi shu sum cur son dus da dung pha mar kha lag bzed/ slob grwar zhugs na slob yon las da dung gzhan pa'i don med 'phro brlag gtong ba'i rgyu nor rdzogs mtha' med/ da dung bu phrug so sor mdun lam re dang khyimo gzhi re/ na tsha byung na nad g.yo+og dang / go+od kha byung na gyang gsab dgas/ dgra byung na dgra ya dang / gyad byung na gyad ya byed mi/ kha zas rgyab gos yod tshad bu dang tsha bo'i ched du 'bul thub mkhan ni 'jig rten gyi pha ma red/ steng nas me zhig 'bud pa dang / 'og nas chu zhig bskol rung bzod thub mkhan ni pha ma red/ pha ma de tsho'i tshe gcig gi 'bad yul bu phrug dang bu phrug gi ched yin na khyod kyi 'degs med kyi khur bo de 'dra phrag tu len pa ni ngo ma las dbang zhig yin shas che/khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba ni phan tshun khyim tshang bar 'phrog rtsod kyi las /50

ka zhig red/ khyim tshang gi bde skyid ni phan tshun khyim tshang bar ngom sor 'khyer ba zhig red/ ngom sor 'khyer ba dang 'phrog rtsod byed yul ni/rgyu 'byor dang thob thang chung chung zhig gi ched phan tshun phrag dog gi 'khor lo skor ba zhig las ma 'das na/ de'i phyir mi gzhi dang gshīs ka ni khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba'i gnon shugs 'og nam yang thar dka' ba'i gzhan dbang gi bran lta bu zhig red/ dka'u sdu ga gi 'tsho ba ro' ba'i khyim tshang zhig la ma tshon na skyid la re ba'i 'jig rten pa de chang gis zas gos gnas na /la gyi thob pa zhig gi ched du rang srog phangs me da du gtong thub na 'dzem bya gzhan zhig ga—me na yod/ khyim tshang ni gnas skabs kyi mgran po ba /ba bsgrigs pa zhig yin na yang / don ngo mar de ni mi tshe thung thung 'dir rang nyid khyim kyi khol bo zhig tu gyur ched blo mi bde ba'i bkod pa zhig dang sems mi skyid pa'i 'khor yug cig bsam bzhin rang gi khur du bskrun pa zhig red/ des ni tshe gcig gi bya ba yod tshad 'ching sdom gyi rgyar bcud thub la/ mi gzhi dang bsam blo'i bzang cha yongs rdzogs khyur mid gtong thub/ khyur mid gtong sla ba'i bsam blo ni gtso bo bshad na/ gzhan phan lhag bsam dang / bden pa bden thub/ phyi ma don gnyer/ rigs kyi khe phan bcas red la/ khyur mid gtong shul na lus 'dug pa ni/ kha bshad don la mi gnas pa dang / mgo bde glag 'tshong / rang 'dod snyer sems che ba'i bsam blo gang ngan dag ngos rkyang du sgrib g.yog bral te bud pa 'di 151

khyim gyi nyes dmigs 'di dag ngas da ṣ+pengs rgyus lan gyi khrod nas rnyed pa kho na zhig min par/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang / ‘‘khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs// ’’ zhes so thar gyi sdom pa de yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin par gsungs ba dang / 〈sor mdo〉〉 las kyang / ‘‘sna me da sna rdum la sogs gang yin kyang // de la me long dag ni dgos mi 'gyur// de bzhin chul khrims ral bas chos kun 'jig /’’ ces tshul khrims de rme/da na dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba zhig par gsungs pa sogs so/ 'o na skyes chen dam pa sngags bla med kyi rnal 'byor ba dag dmigs bsal ba zhig tu ngos 'dzin nam zer na/ dmigs bsal las kyang dmigs bsal ba bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srog shing mar ba lo tsās kyang sras kyi ched du thugs sdug bsags pa dang / sras mkhar gyi ched du snying rus can gyi a bo mthu chen la yang bzod thabs bral ba'i dka' sdug gtad pa 'di dag kyang khyim gyis lan pa las gzhan gang yang min/ dka' sdug gi khur bo dang gzhan dbang gi 'tsho ba 'di dag las thar na rang dbang gi byed nus gal chen zhig thon thub la/ rang gi dmiṭa yul dang phugs bsam gyi lam du bya gzhag gang la gang 'dod kha lo bsgyur thub/ gzhan don khur 'khyer gyi lam bzang ded nas don gnyis /52

'dza/ba pa'i sa tshiṭa su slebs thub na da gzod mkhas pa zhes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mig 'byed lam ston mkhan du bkur bzos byed rigs/de'i cha rkyen la khyim mi dang nye 'brel/ nye 'brel gyi nye 'brel sogs kyi khe phan gyi dbang du ma shor bar lan chags bu phrug gi pha ma'i sgo bkag rang bzhin las bkrol dgos/ de lta mi /na na nam yang khyod kyi bsam blo 'u thug gi gnas las thar thabs med/ 'di'i phyir ngas grwa bcun tsho'i ches rtsa ba'i cha rkyen gzhan pas khyad 'phags su bstod ra byas pa yin/bya ba'i khyab khongs kyi steng nas bshad na grong khyirme pa tsho'i bya gzhag gang yod kha ngo ji ltar mtho rung don ngo ma/sa khyim gyi bya bzhag gi ra ba las gom gang yang brgal thub med la/ de'i nang nas kyang bu phrug gnyor skyong gi las ka las gar yang 'da' thub med na/ 'gro ba dang mi'i rigs kyi ched du sgrub pa'i bya gzhag ngo ma zhig btsal dgos na de ni rab byung yon tan pa'i rigs kyi thun min las ka zhig tu kho bos 'dod/ dus tshod 'dang tshad kyi steng nas bltas na/ grong ba tshos dus tshod tshang ma khyim gyi bya ba'i steng bkol rjes lhag 'phro re yod na gnyid dang 'du 'dzi'i bya bar bed spyod byed/ rnam g.yeng dang 'du 'dzi spang ba'i grwa ba tshos chang rkyal byas nas ra bzi mi byed la/ dud bdug gis glo gsang dang rtsa lam mi 'gog sha dang mig mang gis nyin mtshan mi gzad par bya ba'i bar gseng yod na de yang kham/sa sang gi steng du bed spyod byed/ 'di ltar la /53

zla'i 'khor 'gros ji snyed cig tu bsags pa'i shes bya rig pa'i gnas ni ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam srid/ de yang / rje dmu dge bsam gtan gyi rang rnam la bltas na nyin gcig kyang 'phro brlag tu ma song bar thams cad gzhan don dang lam gyi yon tan gyi ched du bed spyod byas pa zhig red la/ bod kyi mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan yod pa'i skyes chen cho'i brtsams chos la mjal na ches ring ba'i mi tshe zhig go snyam pa'i nang don sogs phyogs yongs nas rmad du byung ba zhig red/ gzhan pa'i mi/ rigs dang rgyal khab gzhan gyi nang don thad kar bkod pa'i gzhung lugs de dag ni nang don sogs phyogs re ba zhig las phal cher med pas 'di dag tshang ma gong gi rgyu rkyen de dag gi mthu yin pa gor ma chagagasum pa/ bod kyi ban de la dmigs bsal khe dbang gang 'tsham dgos/bod kyi ban de'i yod tan dang rtsa ba'i cha rkyen sogs gong du 'os 'tsham zhig bkod par brten don dngos gang 'dra yin pa phal cher gyis shes thub na yang / de yun gtan du gnas pa'i phan pa gang yin so so'i ngos 'dzin stangs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis thag gcod nges na 'dir de'i skor gyi dbye ba cung zad 'god par bya/ 1 bod kyi ser mo bar 'dzin pa'i lta tshul 'ga'/la las bsams na bod kyi ser mo ba'i rigs 'di ni gna' nas /54

da bar gzhan rten bshu gzhog gi 'tsho ba kho nar rol ba zhig yin pas/de ni ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khur bo zhig red/ de la mchod 'bul dus rgyun byed mkhan dang 'tsho ba dus rgyun skrun mkhan ni mi ser tsho yin pa las gzhan zhig min na yang / des ‘‘mi skya pho mo’’zhes chung lta byed pa dang bud med la lhag tu btsog dang skyon du lta ba ma zad sngon nas des bod kyi dmangs yongs la dbang bsgyur byed thabs su dgon pa dang mchod gzhis sogs kyi rten gnas bcas te bod kyi rig gnas tshang ma khong tshos sger 'dzin byas te dam/ngas khrod du dar du ma bcug pas/ de ni nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di nas marge+o bzung ste med par gyur na 'grig snyam/la las bsams na da lta mi'i bsam blo ni sngon ltar min par gu dog gi 'chang rgya las grol nas rang dbang ba dang bde skyid la rol 'dod kyi spro snang gsar ba zhig gis khengs 'dug 'tsho ba ni sngon ltar min par dbul phongs kyi gnas las grol te rgyas spros longs spyod kyi gang 'dod rgyan gos dang zas rigs sna mang la rol bar sems pa gu yangs su gtong thub na yang / bod kyi ban de'i bsam spyod gang thad nas nam yang bkag rgya zhig gi 'ching sdom las bkrol med la/ lo ngo stong lhag gi yar sngon gyi gdod ma'i rnam pa zhig las sgyur bcos ma thub pa'i rnying zhen bag 'khum gyi mkhreg 'dzin tsam zhig yin na/ de ni tshan rtsal rig gnas kyi dus rabs gsar ba 'dir spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyis dbad med 'dor /55

lo ma dmar po/byar g.yugs rgyu las 'os med zer/la las bsams na/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs ni bsam pa dge ba'i lam du dkyog byed cig dang / bla ma dang grwa ba bzang shas 'ga' zhig ya rabs tshul ldan gyi bsam spyod ldan pa zhig yin pa bzang mod kyang / deng dus ban ser mo ba'i rigs 'di grong dang yul dgon/ rgya dang so ga yul/ phyi gling gi sa cha so sor dmar tha ra ra skabs 'gar sdom ngo/ zhig gi tshul du 'gro la/ skabs 'gar lha klu mi ma yin gyi rnam/ sprul du brdzu sa nas 'gro ba/ yang lan rer ci yang mi/ ma/kho ba'i bya btang ba dang /lan rer chong ba dang / ma/go skor ba zhig gi tshul du 'gro ba sogs bya spyod dang cha lugs la yid 'jog gang yang med pas/ 'di mi rigs dang bstan pa'i bla bcong mkhan zhig las ma 'das na/ da nas bzung de bas je ngan du 'gro rgyu las yar rgyas su 'gro ba dpe mi srid pa lta bu yin pas/ de bas de'i chab tu slob grwa ba chad ldan du bsgyur thub par 'bad dgos zer/la las bsams par/ de la gzhan don khur 'khyer gyi khyad 'phaṭa bsam blo zhig mnga' yang / lag len de dang kha gyes su yod pa ma zad/'di'i gnyom chung ya lan mi slog pa'i bran 'bangs kyi bsam blo dang /chog shes rtsol sgrub mi byed pa'i dbul phongs kyi 'du shes des/ bod kyi spyi chogs la shan zhugs nas mi rigs 'phel rgyas dang spyi tshogs yar thon la bkag 'gog byed pas/ 'di nyid gso skyong byed rnga/ snga mo zhig nas /56

nor song snyam pa sogs 'dor na mi 'ga' zhig gi gnas skabs kyi 'dod blor ma bstun thabs med du gyur bas 'di nyid re zhig rang sor bzhag pa zhig las/ bsam blo'i 'khyer so'i steng nas 'di dag med par song na dga' mkhan shin tu mang / ma zad 'di la dga' gus byed mkhan tshos kyang rgyu mtshan la dpyad pa mi byed na don la ma gus pa dang khyad ci/2 bod kyi ser mo ba yun du gnas dgos/ zer don/de'i phyir ngas 'di yun nas yu na gnas dgos zhes brjod don yang / rgyu ru chan 'ga' zhig la brten nas bshad nga/ yi na te/(1) spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yo na gnyis po ni gnaspe / 'phangs gcod pa'i 'dab chags kyi rgyal po 'ig la dpe blangs na gshag zung dang 'dra bar gcig shas med na ya bral du song ba yin pas/ 'phel rgyas kyi rme/kha' lam snyegs mi thub la/ de'i nang nas kyang bsam pa'i dpal yonani gtso bor ba8da yod/ (2) bsam blo'i kun spyod kyi gzhi rtsa ni ya rabs drang bden dang spyi sems dang zhi bde'i lam bzang 'tshol ba de red/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni gzhi rtsa'i steng nas bsam blo kun spyod kyi kha phyogs drang bo'i lam du dkyog byed kyi kha lo ba lta bu red la kha la ba de ni dus rabs dang lo rgyus gang gis kyang phog thug gtong yul min par nam yang nor 'dzol mi / gtong bar kha la ba gzhan dang gzhan tsho'i bla ma/ra 'phags 'dug1ze 7

lo ma dmar po/(3) sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum ci zhig dgos kyang ser mo ba'i rigs las gzhan zhig med la/ bod kyi nang bstan la bya ba byed pa'i 'gan khur ni bod kyi ser mo ba'i rigs kho nar yod pa las gzhan zhig gis de'i 'gan khur mi nus na/ 'gan khur ma nus par gal te rin thang bral ba'i shes rig de nyid da lta'i nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di'i lag nas brlag rgyu yin zer na de ni nam/ yang gud gsab mi thub pa'i gyong chen po zhig red/(4) bod kyi nang bstan shes rig ni bsam blo drang bor 'jog byed cam dang / yang na/ 'tshe med byams brtse'i bdag nyid can zhi/ga kho nas mchon mi/ thub par de'i khyab khongs na sa lam gyi yon tan khyad par can mang po 'thob byed kyi lag len dang gzhung lugs mtha' yas pa zhig mnga' na de dag tshang ma grong khyim pa zhig gis lta bsgom spyod gsum gyi sgo nas 'dzin par byed zer na/ phal ba'i mi 'du 'dzi mang zhing /snying rus chung ba/ rig pa rtul ba zhig gi spyod yul du ma gyur/ de'i phyir de ni phyi nang gi cha rkyen kun 'dzoms kyi ban ser mo zhig kho nas spyod yul du ma bgos rang skal du thob pa red/(5) lo rgyus la phyir lta bgyis na gna' nas da bar nang bstan ni ched las shig tu gyur nas de la mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis thun mong du longs spyod ma thub par de la bya ba byed mkhan gyi ched las mkhas can 158

rnam pa ni (cha byad ya ma zung re 'ga' ma gtogs) ban ser mo ba'i rigs rkyang rkyang red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni nang bstan shes rig la bya ba byed mkhan gyi ser mo ba'i rigs shig zur du phyes te ma bzhag par rig gnas de dmangs khrod du rgyun 'dzin byed thabs med pa gsal bo yin pas red/(6) dmangs khrod kyi mi skya pho mo tshos sangs rgyas la dad pa dang dam chos sgrub pa de ni gus lugs tsam zhig dang goms gshis tsam zhig yang na u tshugs tsam zhig red la/ ser mo ba'i rigs kyis bstan pa la bya ba byed pa de ni go rim ldan zhing lag len zhib tshags can rang gzhan gyi don sgrub par byed pa'i don snying ma/nga' ba bcas gyi khyad chos yod pa yin pas de gnyis so sor ma bkar bar gcig gcig gi khongs su bsdu snyam na nor ba chen po zhig red/(7) 'khor lo skor ba dang jo dar 'dzugs pa/ rdo 'bum dang rten bzhengs byed pa sogs ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bya ba'i rnam grangs yin yang de ni mi skya phal ba tsho'i bya ba zhig las ban ser mo ba'i rigs kyi don du gnyer ba zhig min pa dang / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa ni ban ser mo ba'i rigs kho nas spyod yul zhiṭā// las mi skya phal ba tsho'i don du gnyer bya min par ma brjod kyang phyi nang gi mthun rkyen gyis dbul ba'i phyir/de ltar rgyu mtshan bdun po 'di dag nas bsam blo btang na bod /59

lo ma dmar po/kyi ser mo ba'i tshab byed thub mkhan zhig mi srid pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan par zhugs pa la rigs rus thob thang sogs kyis dbye ba mi 'byed na yang rgyu rkyen tshang min gyi khyad par mngon gsal du yod pas/don ngo ma phyogs gcig nas chos rnam dag sgrub mkhan la dmigs na yang ser mo ba'i rigs shig lags su dgos la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas mi'i rigs kyi drang bden dang gnas lugs kyi khungs tshad ldan zhig la dmigs na yang bod kyi ser mo/ ba'i rigs shaṃg lags su dgos pa red/gal te chos rnam dag bsgrub pa de ban de kho nas spyod yul yin na mi dam/ngas mang chogs la chos bsgrub pa'i go skabs med pa e yin zer na/ mi dmangs mang tshogs la chos kyi shugs rkyen tsam dang de'i bag chags tsam/ de la smon lam rgyag pa tsam byed pa'i go skabs yod kyang chos rnal ma bsgrub pa'i dus tshod dang khom pa go skabs sogs med pa red/ de'i phyir chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen du thog mar rab tu byung nas khyim spang dgos pa de red/3 bod kyi ban ser mo bar dmigs bsal gyi khe dbang gang 'dra dgos/bod kyi ser mo ba de yun nas yun du gnas par byed pa la/ der spyi tshogs yongs kyis rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen zhabs phyi bcas byed dgos te/ de lta min par khyed yon tan gyi che ba zhig yin dgos snyam pa'i re ba chen po zhig 'dzin pa las mthun rkyen sbyar bas ma 'dang tshe de 160 sku

bod kyi ser mo ba/'dra ni rgyu med pa las 'bras bu zhig 'byung yong snyam pa nang bzhin red de/khyod la re ba ji ltar nan tan byed na rgyu rkyen de bzhin 'don sprod dgos ngerme red/ khyad par rig gnas yon tan gnyer ba'i slob ma zhig slob grwar zhugs yun la 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i dus tshod med pa bzhin chos dang rig gnas kho na don du gnyer mkhan gyi dge 'dun pa zhig yin na kho'i 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen de gzhan gyi rogs skyor la brten dgos pa las thabs gzhan med/ rgyal khab kyis slob grwa ba dang de'i dge rgan yang na ched sbyong ba sogs dang / dmag mi dang rgyal khab kyi las byed gang yin la zla phogs brgyab nas 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen tshang ma sgrub bzhin yod na ser mo ba'i rigs 'di la yang rgyab skyor dang rogs dngul cung zad re'i lta skyong gnang dgos pa smos med red/ ma zad mang tshogs yongs kyis 'di la 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen cung zad re 'bul thub pa byed rgyu ni ches gal che ste 'di dag yun nas yun du gnas thub ched yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par mang tshogs dang rgyal khab kyis 'di la dmigs bsal lta skyong byas na 'di'i spus tshad rje bzang du 'gro rgyu red/ spus tshad je bzang du song bas grangs ka je nyung du 'gro rgyu red/ grangs ka je nyung dang spus tshad je yag tu song bas mi dmangs kyi khur bo je yang du 'gro nges red/ de ltar byas bas g.yo sgyu'i rkyal ba rdzun gyi phung po mi dmangs la mgo skor gtong mkhan gyi bla rdzun dang grwa rdzun/ mkha' 'gro rdzun ma sogs kyi chos log gi 16/

lo ma dmar po/ bya spyod mtshams 'jog thub cing chos 'tshong gi bya ba bar chad thub kyi redakyi de ltar thub na da gzod rgyal bstan nyin byed kyi zhal ras dkyil 'khor de dus kyi rgud pa'i sprin nag gi yol ba'i sgrib g.yog dang bral te bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu'i snying dbus su gsal ler 'char thub song ba red pas de ni mi spro'am/ da lta ban ser mo ba'i rigs zer na 'dra min du ma zhig yin te bla ma dang dpon po'i go sa 'dzin mkhan dang lha dang klu yi mtshan snyan 'dzin mkhan yang na sprang bo dang 'khyams po/ rkun ma dang jag tshogs/g.yo sgyu ba dang rdzun gyi skyal ba 'degs mkhan sogs kyi nang du'ang yongs khyab du gnas nas rang rang so so'i gang bsam gar 'dod byed bzhin yod pa des rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi mtshan snyan la gnod pa ma zad bstan pa la zhabs 'dren dang mi dmangs kyi khur bo byed/ 'di dag tshang ma ser mo ba'i skyon yin kyang gtso bo 'di la rgyab skyor dang 'go 'dzin/ bdag gnyer do dam med pas lan par ma zade las rigs gzhan gyi mi dang khyad ma phyes par dmigs bsal can zhig la dmigs bsal gyi khe dbang gang yang ma thob bas lan pa red/de ltar gong du bkod pa ltar 'di yun nas yun du gnas pa'i phan 'bras la cung zad bsams te mi ring bar bod kyi ser bo ba'i rigs rtsa brlag tu gtong rgyu min par/ tang gi chos lugs srid jus don thog tu /62

'khyol ba byed na/ nges par du dgon pa do dam dang / ser mo ba do dam chos lugs do dam bcas kyi bya 'gul rab dang rim pa zhig spel nas sa khul de dang de'i srid gzhung dang srid gzhung dang mang tshogs zung 'brel/mang tshogs dang dgon pa zung 'brel/ bla sprul dang mang tshogs zung 'brel/bla sprul dang las khungs zung 'brel byas te yang dag pa'i bcos sgyur gsar ba zhig byed dgos/ser mo ba'am dge 'dun ba zhig yin na de'i rtsa ba'i re 'dun ni ‘‘'dod chung chog shes’’ byed rgyu de red/ de lta na 'dod chung chog shes kyi dge 'dun pa tshor zas gos dang gnas mal stabs bde zhig las dgos pa med pas / rgyal khab kyi las byed mi sna ltar gang 'dod ham zos rgyag mkhan tsho dang mi 'dra bar de la dpal 'byor gyi 'gro sgo mang po gtong dgos mi 'dugadzede la 'khor yug dwangs gtsang dang gyon gos stabs bde/ zas rigs gong bde bcas kyi 'tsho ba yid du 'ong ba zhig las/ da lta'i byed stangs ltar/ 'du khang chen mo dang nang chen dang bla brang mdzod khang soṭa kyi rgyas spros dngos po ci yang mi dgos pa ma zad 'cham dang bro gar gos sku sogs dus mchod byed sgo zab rgyas kyang med na chog grwa ba dang jo mo sogase ser mo ba'i rigs tshad ldan gso skyong byas te sangs rgyas chos gzhung nang ltar re 'dun dang cha rkyen kun 'dzoms la grong nang du yong rung zas dang sdod gnas 'grim 'grul sogs gang 'tsham rer gla 163
lo ma dmar po/cha dang rin pa mi len pa sogs kyi khe dbang dngos su don thog tu 'khyol ḍi byed dgos/ 2004 2 5— /64

dgon pa'i slob gso'i gnas yul dka' khagamig sngar/ bod khul du dgon pa'i slob gso dang slob grwa'i slob gso ste slob gso'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba gnyis yod/ bod khul gyi dgon pa'i slob gso ni chos lugs slob gso kho na dang kun nas mtshungs pa min pasgo / de la la ngo stong lhag gi la rgyus kyi slob gso'i rnam pa mnga' la/ des bod khul du khyad par ba'i spyod sgo'i go gnas kyang bzung yod/de ni zhing bran spyi tshogs kyi slob gso'i rnam pa zhig min par/ dgon pas sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i lam lugs cha tshang ba'i slob gso'i ma lag cig red pas/ bod mis 'di nas rig gnas nges can zhig slob thub8) yod/dgon pa'i slob gsor rim gras mtho dman yod kyang / mthar gtugs na de ni dmangs yongs la kha phyogs pa zhig red/ la rgyus ring mo'i brgyud rim khrod des bod kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la gal che'i nus pa thon yod pa ma zad dgon pa dang mi ser bar gyi 'brel bar phan pa chen po thon yod pas nga chos de'i bod khul gyi go gnas khas mi len thabs med red/ yang na/ dgon pa'i slob gso rang /65

lo ma dmar po/nyid gnas thub pa'i gnas lugs shig yod mod 'on kyang don ngo mas chos lugs kyi slob gso'i khyab khongs zhig las ma 'das pas/ des slob gso brgyud sprod dang mi'i rigs kyi slob gso'i nang don tshang ma gzhan la myong bar byed pa'i 'gan khur mi thub/ dgon pa'i slob gso'i dmigs yul dang / slob tshan nang don/ slob tshan grub cha/ slob gso slob khrid kyi rnam pa/ slob rim 'phar tshad/ do dam byed thabs/ dge rgan gyi go gnas dang re 'dun sogs kyi phyogs nas bltas na lugs mthun gyi rang bzhin nges can zhig lda na na yang / 'phel rgyas kyi mgyogs tshad ches myur ba'i deng rabs spyo tshogs dang mthun thabs ye nas med la/ bod rigs chos deng rabs spyi tshogs su 'tsho ba skyid po zhig rol bsam na/ dgon pa'i slob gsos de'i cha rkyen mkho 'don byed mi nus pa dang khyad par de'i dmigs yul yang nga tsho'i deng rabs can gyi mi sna'i rtsa ba'i re 'dun dang mi mthun pa sogs kyis/ deng dus kyi bod khul slob gso de la brten gyi med rtses bshad pa yin/ deng dus kyi bod khul slob gso de dgon pa'i slob gso la brten mi thub pa ma zad dgon pa kho rang steng nas deng dus spyi tshogs kyis bskyal yong ba'i lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i 'jigs nyen zhig datrī kha gtad du yod/ mi tsho'i bsam blor 'gyur ldog 'gro bzhin pa ste/ sngan tshad ltar ‘‘khyim re na ban de re yod’’ pa'i rnam pa dor tshar la sa cha mang che 166

ba'i ban de'i thon yul de grong khyer dang gzhung lam nye 'gram sogs min par phal cher slob grwa'i slob gso khyab chung ba'i mtha' khul sa cha dag red tshar ba bod khul tshang ma gcig 'dra yin pas/ 'di ltar byas na la ngo bcu lhag dang / yang na brgya lhag nas dgon pa'i slob gso de mu mthud gnas thub rgyu red dam/ 'di ni dgon pa'i slob gso rang steng nas mdun du lhags pa'i drag po'i 'gran rtsod byed yul zhig red/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyis bya dngocis yod tshad la 'gran rtsod kyi nus pa ci yod tshod bgam/ byed bzhin yod na/ dgon pa'i slob gsos de 'dra'i 'gran rtsod kyi khrod tshod bgam de dang len nus min sus kyang shes gsal ltar red/dgon pas bod kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin khrod byed nus ga' chen thon pa dang / de ring dang 'byung 'gyur gang yin yang khyad par ba'i spyod sgo thon yod pa nga tshos shes dgos pa smos med red/ bod khul gyi dgon pa dang slob gso'i bar gyi 'brel ba ni 'dzam gling gi sa cha gzhan pa dang gcig 'dra red/ yo rob gling gi dus rabs dkyil ma'i chos lugs slob gso dang lhag tu 'dra sa mang / nub phyogs deng rabs slob grwa'i slob gso'i 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus la bltas na dus rabs dkyil ma'i chos tshogs slob gso dang 'brel ba nges can zhig yod pa ma zad nub phyogs deng rabs slob grwa'i slob gso'i khrod da dung chos tshogs slob grwa yod la chos tshogs glob grwa 'di dag ni gna' bo'i chos lugs slob gso'i ldog 167

lo ma dmar po/med kyi thon dngos shig yin pa dang / rithon dngos 'di dag ni nga tsho'i mi la las bshad pa'i chos lugs slob gso lta bu'i sla mo zhig min par/sgyur bcos dang gsar gtod rig gnas gzhan pa nang 'dren phal ba'i mi'i 'tsho gnas dang bde skyid 'tshol snyeg gi dgos mkho'i ches rtsa ba'i shes bya kha snon byed pa sogs kyi bya ba bar ma chad pas da gzod de ring gi chos tshogs slob gso 'di mngon gyur byung skre zhig red/ gal te nga tshos brtags dpyad zhib mo byas nas/ de ring gi chos tshogs slob grwa de mi skya dang 'brel ba byed mi/ nus pa zhig dang / 'dzam gling gi mi dang spyi tshogs la zhabs zhu byed pa'i nang don mi ldat+t+waṃ pa zhig yin pa gsal bo mthong thub na/ chos tshogs slob grwa de rtsa ba nas gnas mi thub pa zhig dang rgyun 'dzin byed mi thub pa zhig yin rgyu red/ chos tshogs slob grwar+sā nub phyogs kyi 'phel rgyas khrod bsub mi btub pa'i byas rjes gal chen bzhag myong te/ deng dus kyi skad grags che ba'i slob grwa chon mo dper na 'dzam gling gi ang dang po'i slob grwa chen mo h+pha ran si'i pā li'i slob grwa chen mo dang / ang gnyis pa dang / ang gsum pa'i slob grwa richen mo dbyin ji'i /nyis cin dang jan che'o slob grwa chen mo/ ma zad 'jar man gyi pa'o in slob grwa chen mo sogs tshang ma dgon pa nas 'gyur thon byung ba zhig yin la/ de dag tshang ma chos tshogs dang chos lugs ba dang rgyu spun lta bu'i 'brel ba yod de/ de ltar da lta nga tshos spyod bzhin pa'i yon gnas gyon 168

bod kyi ser mo ba/ gos ste/ po hri dang hra'o hri/ zhu'o hri yi gyon gos tshang ma yang dgon pa nas byung ba red/ sdis rabs dkyil ma'i rjes kyi chos tshogs slob grwa dang slob grwa ngo ma gnyis bar gyi 'gran rtsod des nub phyogs deng rabs slob grwa'i slob gso'i 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded byas yod/ tshan rig gzhung dang /mar khe si'i rtsod sgrub dngos gtso ring lugs kyi dgongs pa/ gung khran tang gi dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi rtsa don sogs gzhir bzung na nga tshos chos lugs kyis mi'i riṭa kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas khrod de lta bu'i rang nyid byung ba'i rgyu rkyen dang spyod sgo dang rge+o gnas ni khas mi len thabs med red/ da lta 'dzam gling na chos lugs kyi 'du shes cung zad re med pa'i mi rigs shig btsal du med la/ mi rigs la la'i chos lugs kyi gzhung lhag tu tshad ldan yin la/ mi rigs la la'i chos gzhung de 'dra'i tshad la slebs med/ ma zad rgyu rkyen 'ga' zhig gis/ mi rigs la la'i chos lugs kyis spyi tshogs khrod bzung ba'i go gnas mngon gsal yin yang /mi rigs la la'i chos lugs ni de 'dra min la mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar shan zhugs de tsam med/ 'on kyang / nga tshos chos lugs kyis spyi tshogs go gnas bzung tshad kyis spyi tshogs de'i sngon thon dang rjes lus kyi khyad par phye mi chog ngas rgyun du thos rgyu zhig la/ bod mis rgya'i chos lugs kyi spyi tshogs go gnas chung zhes mthong chung byed pa dang / rgya mis bod kyi chos lugs kyis spyo tshogs go gnas gal chen bzung zhes blun me+ongs dang ca 169

ma/ ma dmar po/rjes lus red zer na/ de gnyis ka mi 'grig te/ tshang ma mar khe si rigs lugs kyi rtsa ba'i dgongs don dang mi mthun la/ de ni phyi rol yul gyi don dngos ltar dngos thog bden 'tshol gyis bya dngos dbye zhib byas pa zhig ma red/ lhag tu dmigs bsal gyi sa galhas 'khor yug dang khyad par ba'i spyi tshogs grub cha sogs gzhir bzung nas rgyus lan byas pa zhig ye nas ma red/ galu te mi tshang ma de 'dra yin na phan tshun rgyus lan dang ma/thun sgril gyi sgo nas phugs bsam gyi yul du slebs thabs med/chos lugs kyi spyi tshogs go gnas ni rang byung 'khor yug bzang ngan dang rig gnas rim 'gyur gyi cha rkyen sogs kyi thog bcad pa zhig las/ chos lugs kyi bsam blo shugs che chung gis mi rigs de'i sngon thon dang rjes lus kyi khyad par phye ba zhig ga la yin/ de'i phyir ngas 'di ltar bshad de/ chos lugs kyi spyi tshogs spyod sgo khyab bsgrags dang bstod ra byed pa de min par mi rnams la dri ba 'di 'dra zhig bton te bsam blo gtong du 'jug rgyu ste/ dgon pa'i slob gso de mu mthud 'tsho gnas byed 'os sam/ zhes dang / dus mtshungs su mtho rim bla grwa tshor bsam blo gtong rgyur/ dgon pa'i slob gso'i dmigs yul ni nam yang sngar ltar ‘‘mi dmangs ban der 'gyur ba ’’ de yin nam/ yang na ‘‘sems can bde bar 'god pa’’ dang mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs/ spyo chogs la zhabs 'degs rang byung la zhabs 'degs bcas kyi 'du shes gsar ba'i kha snon 170

bod kyi ser mo ba/re byed rgyu yin/ zhes dri ba 'di ltar 'don rgyu yin/ lo rgyus kyi rlabs rgyun dang ldog nas 'gul skyod byed pa'i spyi tshogs rnam pa dang / spyi tshogs bya 'gul gang yin yang nam zhig de ni lo rgyus dang dus tshod kyis dgos med dor byar g.yugs rgyu ni sus kyang bsgyur mi btub pa'i gnas lugs ngo ma zhig yin na dgon pa'i slob gso de yang de las ma 'das/ gal te dgon pa'i slob gso'i bsam blo dang rnam pa rang steng nas sgyur bcos ma byas na nam zhig khyod la rgyus kyi dor byar 'gyur rgyu red/ bod mi rigs la lo stong phrag kha shas ring gi chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen des/ rig gnas so so'i khyab khongs sbags pa dang mi rnams kyi rus pa'i gting du'ang sims 'dug pas/ gal te bod kyi rig gnas khrod kyi bsam blo'i cha de dgon pa'i slob gso'i nyams dang bstun je zhan tu 'gro rgyu yin na ches 'gyod pa skye 'os pa zhig red/ de'i nyes dmigs khur mkhan ni bod kyi rig gnas 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i spyir btang gi mi rnams tsam ma yin par/ so phag dmar po dang gser gyi gyo mog can gyi nang du srung skyob byed pa'i mtho rim bla grwa rnams kyang yin te rgyu mtshan ni theg pa chen po'i chos kyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun par mi dmangs ‘‘nyams nyes’’ las skye+ob ma thub dang / ‘‘sems can bde bar 'god ’ ma thub pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir deng dus kyi dgon pa'i slo gso sgyur bcos byas te de lo rgyus kyi dor du mi 'jug pa ni da lta'i ser mo ba'i bsam blo mi gtong thabs med yin 17/

lo ma dmar po/pa'i ches rtsa ba'i gel che'i gnad tredon zhig rede/ nga tsho sgyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rig gnas 'dzugs skrun mkhan dang slob gso'i las don pa zhig gi ngos nas bshad na/ dgon pa'i slob gso dang bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas gnyis kyi 'brel bar phyogs ris mi byed pa'i lta stangs bzung te bod kyi rig gnas nang gi phul byung gi cha dag chos lugs las zhun brdaru byas te thon pa yin pa de dag da nas bzung chos lugs kyi sger phan dang ban de kho nas longs spyod du mi byed par mi dmangs la longs spyod du 'jug pa dang / byis pa tshor longs spyod du 'jug pa byed dgos/ gong du nga tshos bod kyi rig gnas kyi rtsa ba'i bsam blo dang / bod khul spyi tshogs kyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas bab/ byis pa'i ma gzhi'i gnas tshul bcas bshad tshar ba'i steng nas bltas na/ da lta'i bod khul gyi slob grwa'i slob gso la yang don dngos gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa'i cha du ma yod pa mthong / slob grwa'i slob gso bcos bsgyur ma byas na 'gan bab slob gso la dka' khag mang bo bzo bas/ des slob grwa'i slob gso spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang rig gnas rim 'gyur mi rigs mthun sgril bcas su skul 'ded mi thub/ de'i phyir bod khul slob grwa'i slob gso sgyur bcos mi byed thu med red/ sgyur bcos de yang mi sna dang rgyu nor dngos po sorgas kyi phyi'i rnam pa'i steng du mi 'jog par/ yang na/ slob tshan 'ga' re'i nang /72

bod kyi ser mo ba/ don deng slob khrid byed thabs sogs tsam le mi byed par/ sgyur bcas de — ni nges par slob grwa'i slob gso'i nang don 'dzugs skrun dam 'dzin byed par phyogs yongs nas zhib 'jug dang bsam blo gtong ba/ rtsod sgrub dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i dgongs pa dang / bod khul spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i rtsa ba'i kha phyogs/ bod khul gyi thon las grub cha'i lugs mthun bcos sgrig sogs gzhir bzung nas bod khul gyi mi ser yod tshad kyi 'tsho gnas dgos mkho dang 'byung 'gyur mi'i dgos mkho rig gnas 'phel 'gyur gyi rtsa ba'i chos nyid dang byis pa'i lus sems 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa ba'i chos nyid sogs dang bstun nas bsgrub dgos/ ( 〈spranyo ༈3 slatshulha〉 las bdams te bskyur/)2004 1 18173

bod kyi ser mo ba/ don deng slob khrid byed thabs sogs tsam le mi byed par/ sgyur bcas de — ni nges par slob grwa'i slob gso'i nang don 'dzugs skrun dam 'dzin byed par phyogs yongs nas zhib 'jug dang bsam blo gtong ba/ rtsod sgrub dngos gtso ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i dgongs pa dang / bod khul spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i rtsa ba'i kha phyogs/ bod khul gyi thon las grub cha'i lugs mthun bcos sgrig sogs gzhir bzung nas bod khul gyi mi ser yod tshad kyi 'tsho gnas dgos mkho dang 'byung 'gyur mi'i dgos mkho rig gnas 'phel 'gyur gyi rtsa ba'i chos nyid dang byis pa'i lus sems 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa ba'i chos nyid sogs dang bstun nas bsgrub dgos/ ( 〈spranyo ༈3 slatshulha〉 las bdams te bskyur/)2004 1 18173

yul gang ma la zhwa phud dag sa dan/ zhwa phud pa ni yul gong ma la lus kyi gus pa mtshon byed kyi kun spyod cig red/ bod la mtshon na ched bkur yul gong ma la zhwa phud dgos pa'i lam lugs kyang btsugs myong zer/ khyad par bla ma dge snaba'i bshes gnyen dang / sku gsung thugs rten sogs la mjal tshe nges par du thog mar zhwa phud pa dang mgo sgur ba sogs lus kyi rnam 'gyur gang mang zhig gis gus pa mtshon tshul gyi kun spyod slob gso mang po zhig rgyag myong yod pa red/ da lta bshad na bod mi la las yul gang zhig la zhwa phud dgos pa dad zhwa phud pa de ci zhig —gi ched du yin pa tsam yang mi shes par la las gzhan zhig gis zhwa phud yul zhig yin tshe rang nyid kyis kyang de ltar zhwa phud dgos la gal te de'i tshe zhwa ma phud na rang nyid kyi mgo la rwa zhig skye yong snyam pa'i dogs snang 'char rgyu las don ngo mar gang zhig la zhwa phud dgos pa mi shes pas 'dir gsal bshad byed rgyur/ca nga cho bod mi rigs kyi zhwa phud pa'i goms srol de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs la dad gus las byung ba zhig yin pas phal cher ban ser mo ba dang sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rten sogs la zhwa phud pa las 174

bod kyi ser mo ba/gzhan phal ba zhig la zhwa phud pa ma red/ de yang ban ser mo ba la zhwa phud dgos don ni sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug dge 'dun pa ni skyabs gsum gyi ya gyal cig yin pas sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad gus byed mkhan zhig yin tshe skyabs yul mchog gsum la dad gus dgos la/ de'i na nga nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mkhan grogs dge 'dun pa la nges par du gus pa byed dgos pa de red/ ban ser mo zhig yin phyin thams cad cha mnyam gyis chos lugs kyi re 'dun ltar tshad ldan dang yang dag sha stag yin pa'i nges pa med na ya nga / sangs rgyas dang de'i bstan pa'i chos de la 'jug pa'i dge 'dun pa'i gral dang rigs su gtogs pa tshun tshad la ma gus pa spangs shing gus pa mtshon pa ni sangs rgyas chos lugs la gus pa mtshon pa'i rtsa ba'i re 'dun ang dang po de red/ de ltar mchog gsum la skyabs su —'gro na decho'i bslab bya ltar sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rten chos yig 'bru gcig yan chad dge 'dun pa'i rigs su gtogs pa dang tha na de'i cha lugs sogs la'ang gus pa byed dgos la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs na skyabs 'gro rgyud ldan zhig yin dgos pas de ltar gus pa byed pa red/ yin na yang bla ma chen po'i go ming dang rgyu nor gyis phyug pa 'khor g.yog 'joms po yin pa'i ngo so ru lha phyag 'tshal ba dang zhwa phud pa sogs kyi gus pa byed pa ni gus pa byed tshul mi shes pa /75

lo ma dwamar po/ zhig red/ ci 'dra zhe na/ 'dir phu nu gnyis kyi kha brda byas pa zhig 'god rgyur/ dang po grwa ba gos ngan can zhig lam du 'gro ba dang 'phrad par nu bos zhwa phud kyang phu bos zhwa ma phud/ de nas bla ma sku sha rgyag la nabs bza' serabo gyon pa zhig dang mdzol bar nu bos zhwa ma phud kyang phu bos zhwa phud de nu bo la yang zhwa phud du bcug de dus/nu bo na re/ grwa ba la zhwa mi phud pa dang bla ma la zhwa phud dgos do na ci yin/ phu bo/ bla ma de 'dra mjal na zhwa phud dgos kyang grwa ba ban+de yod tshad la zhwa phud dgos pa ma red/nu bo/ zhwa phud dgos pa'i bla ma de gang 'dra zhig red/ ban+de yod tshad la zhwa phud mi dgos don gang yin/phu bo/ bla ma dang sprul sku ni skye ba mtho ba ma zad/ ‘‘bla ma med pa'i gong rol na// sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med// ’ ces gsungs pa ltar bla ma ni sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pas zhwa ma phud na khyod ni dam nyams red/ grwa ba dang ban+de bzang bo yod kyang phal cher gyon gos mi 'dra ba ma gtogs nga tsho dang gcig 'dra red/nu bo/ bla ma dang sprul sku skye ba mtho ba shes kyang grwa ba yod tshad skye ba dman pa khyod kyis ci yis shes/‘‘bla ma med pa'i gong rol na’’zhes /76

bod kyi ser mo ba pa'i lung don ni sangs rgyas thams cad thog mar slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs na bla ma'i gdam ngag la ma brten par 'tshang rgya tshul zhig med pas/chos sgrub par byed pa la thog mar bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig bsten dgos zhes pa'i don yin pa las/ rgyu nor gyis blus shing g.yo sgyu dang thabs kyis bsgrubs pa'i ‘‘bla ma’’zhes pa'i go sa dang ming de ni sangs rgyas las kyang lhag par bshad pa ga la yin/ grwa ba phal cher nga tsho dang gcig 'dra yin don ci yin/ phu bo/ de gcig 'dra las yin/ rig gnas gcig 'dra/ dpal 'byor gcig 'dra/ rgyud na nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum yod pa gcig 'dra red/nu bo/ rig gnas dang dpal 'byor sogs la phyag 'tshal ba dang /go sa dang thob thang sogs la gus pa byed don zhwa phud pa de khyod kyi lugs yin na ma gtogs/ nga tsho'i rtsa ba'i bsam blo de 'dra gang na yin/ nga tsho nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i rtsa ba'i bsam blo ni skyabs gsum nam yang gtsug tu bkur ba ste/ de la nyon mongs rgyud na yod med dang lta spyod gzhan gang la yang mi lta bar/ tha na gos lhan pa dmar ser yan chad zer na dka' mod/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug gi tshul 'dzin pa dge 'dun pa'i rigs su gtogs pa thams cad la khyad sped gus pa byed pa yin pas nga tsho dang khyad par med pa ga la yin/177

ma/ ma dmar po/phu bo/ 'o na/ khyod kyis bla ma rnam par zhwa mi phud pa dang / grwa ba dang ban+de yod tshad la khyad med zhwa phud dgos zer ba e yin/ 4 nu bo/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rten dang dam pa'i chos yi ge 'bru gcig yan chad/ dge 'dun pa'i cha byad 'dzin pa zhig yin na bla ma dang grwa ba khyad med byas te ma gus pa spangs shing gus pa byed pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos la dad pa byed mkhan tsho'i kun spyod red ces zer ba yin/‘‘gang zag gi tshod gang zag gis mi zin/3’’ zhes pa ltar yin pas/rgyud tshod la gzhigs nas zhwa phud pa de ma shes shes khul zhig yin zer ba red/phu ོ༷/ rgyud tshod la gzhigs nas zhwa phud pa de ma shes shes khul ga la yin/ ‘‘gang zag la dag snang dang chos la rtogs dpyod dgos’’ zhes pa ltar dag snang gi sgo nas bla ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dngos kyi 'du shes dgos pa khyod kyis ma shes sam/ nu bo/ dbang dang gdams ngag lung dang sdom pa sogs thob pa'i rang nyid kyi bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes yod kyang los dgos/ 'on kyang / khyod kyis gang zag la dag snang byed na dud 'gro dang bya byi'u 'ba' 'bu srog chags yod tshad kyi nang du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul yod nges pas khyod kyis de dag la dag snang mi byed par ‘‘bla ma’’zhes pa'i ming dang go gnas la phyag 'tshal na de /78

bod kyi ser mo ba/ ni ngo dga' phyogs zhen zhig ma yin nam/ yang gcig bshad na/ khyod kyis bla ma la dag snang byed pa bzang mod/ grwa ba ban+de yod tshad la mthong chung byed na khyod kyis ‘‘gang zag la dag snang’’ ma byas pa ma yin nam/phu bo/ 'o na sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul du ngos 'dzin byas pa'i bla sprul dang grwa rkyang dkyus ma —rang ga ba zhig gnyis la khyad med kyi lta tshul 'dzin pa e yin/ deyin khyod kyis 'ol tshod r+sha rit+na sde / sus kyang khas len thabs med/nu bo/ de gnyis khyad med zer ba min te/ thob thang dang go gnas mang tshogs gyis brtsi bkur thob min dang tha na gral gyi mtho dman dang 'bul ba'i che chung sogs la khyad par chen po yod/ 'on kyang de ni yul srol goms gshis tsam ste phyi tshul bcos ma tsam zhig red/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la snying nas dad na phyi tshul bcos mas ga la phan/ nam yang sems gting gi dga' gus mtshon phyir skyabs gsum la phyag 'tshal bar mtho dman dang khyad par phye dgos don med —zer ba yin/ phu bo/ sems gting nas dad pa skye yul zhig yin na de la phyag 'tshal ba rang shugs su 'byung la/ dad pa ma skyes na phyag 'tshal ba dgos med du khyod kyis bshad na bla ma dang sprul sku ni rang shugs nas dad pa skye yul zhig yin la/ grwa ba rang ga ba zhig ni de ltar gtan nas min pas khyod kyis ji ltar bshad//79

nu bo/ de ni khyod dang khyod 'dra ba 'ga' zhig gis/ grwa ba dkyus ma tsho'i yon tan mthong mi thub pa dang / bla sprul tsho'i phyi'i dngos po dpal 'byor go ming sogs mthong tshe de dag cigi gzi brdzid mi bzod par ngo dga' byas pa rkyang rkyang yin pas de la dad pa skye ba mi zer/ yang na de ni brtags dpyad ma byas pa'i hor rgyug tsam mo/ 2002 12 sgru)

nga tshos dpyad brjod la yang dag pa'i lta tshul 'dzin dgos/ge dam pa'i chos la dpyad brjod byed na nga tshos nges par de la yang dag pa'i lta tshul 'dzin dgos/ dam pa'i chos la dpyad brjod byed mkhan chos bsam blo'i cha nas nang khul du rang skyon rang brjod kyi bya 'gul spel ba mthong chen po byed dgos/ de ltar byed rgyu ni dam pa'i chos rang steng nas brtags dpyad kyis gtan la 'beb rgyu zhig las mun 'thom gyis blun dad byed rgyu zhig min pa'i cha nas yid ches byed chog pa zhig tu grub yod pas so/ de yang dam pa'i chos dang de mthun gyi yang dag pa'i lta ba ste las rgyu 'bras dang tshe snga phyi sogs kyi rig par sus kyang nan tan gyis brtags dpyad ji ltar byas kyang chog pa ma zad/ brtags dpyad ji 'dra zab pa dang ci 'dra mang ba de bzhin nga tshos dga' bsu byed rigs/de ni 'di la dpyad brjod byed par yang dag pa'i lta tshul bzung ba de red/yang dag pa'i lta tshul de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos kho nas spyod yul zhig las gzhan pa'i chos lugs tshos dpyad brdzod mang bo mi theg pa red snyam//181

lo ma dmar po/sangs rgyas chos kyi gzhung lugs kyi lta ba'i steng nas bltas na/so so'i skye bo ma rig pas mnar bzhin pa thams cad gcig 'dra yin la so skyes kyi skrertsams chos gang zhig yin yang de bzhin nor 'khrul gyi cha mchis pa yang tshang ma gcig 'dra yin pa khas len dgos/ nga tshos sangs rgyas kyi dgongs par dpyad brjod byed dus/ nor 'khrul 'byung gi yod la/sangs rgyas kyi chos la ngos 'dzin byed stangs kyi steng nas kyang nor 'khrul 'byung gi yod pa khas len dgos/ 'on kyang de ltar khas len rgyur skrag snang zhig 'char gyi yod pa ni dga' zhen byed stangs kyi cha nas 'dun pa bzang bo zhig yin te de ltar nor 'khrul mi yong bar re ba ha cang che ba'i rtags yin yang / mthar ga tugs na de ni rang gis rang la yid chas byed drags pa'i phyogs lhung gi bsam blo zhig red/ dam pa'i chos kyi dgongs don ni rgya mtsho ltar gting zab pa dang / nam mkha' ltar kun la ma khyab pa med pa zhig yin pas/ dam pa'i chos kyi dgongs don phyogs bcur bsgrags ba'i las 'gan gnyer mkhan tshos zhen phyogs kyi skad cha kho na bshad na mi legs par blo khog yangs pos phan tshun gros bsdur gyi 'khor yug bzang po zhig bskrun dgos/ de dag gis rang gi mi legs pa'i cha gang yod khas len thub pa dang / gzhan gyi mi legs pa'i cha de khas len thub pa'i gzhung drang gi lta tshul zhig 'dzin dgos/ de yang / dper na/〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉 ni nye ba'i lo shas ring mi mang pos don snang /82

45 ri sa sko 45 mi 45 ribya yul zhag tu gyur yad/ rtsam pa pa sags rag gnas pa' khrad na kha grags che ba ma zad/ dmangs khrod zhing 'brog mi dmangs yig me+ongs ba tshos kyang de la zer zlos sna tshogs gleng bzhin yod/ 'di la bstod tshig ri gi me tog 'thor ba mang la/ dman 'beb dang dgag bzhag byed mkhan yang mang / de dag tshang mas rang rang gi lta tshul gleng gi yod pa las 'di yin dang de min gyi dbye 'byed dka'/ ma zad rgyal pham gyi dbye 'byed mkhan zhig yod srid kyang de la dgos pa'i don snying ci yang med de de dag tshang mas nga tshos mi rigs kyi mdun lam skor la gros mo/la byas pa zhig red/ 'on kyang mi 'ga' zhig gis phyogs res kyis 'ga' zhig bzang ba dang 'ga' zhig ngan par brtsis te rang gi sems khung du zug rngu gsog gi yod pa ni bya ba ma rabs shig red/ de'i phyir 'di'i skor cung zad 'god na/ 〈dpyod shes rgyang 'bod〉la dgag bzhag byed pa'i rtsom yig mi nyung ba zhig la phran gyis lta klog byas myong ba dag las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po tshul khrims blo gros kyis dam pa'i chos la dma' 'beb lta bu'i tshig don gnyis char la dgag pa brgyab yod rgyu red de/ khong ni chos pa zhig yin pa'i mi tshad chos lugs kyi dge mtshan kho na sgrogs rkyang byed pa'i shākya'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa zhig yin pa'i ngos nas khong gis nam yang dam pa'i chos dang sangs rgyas chos lugs cha shas yan lag dang bcas pa srung skyob ched dus /83ji

ma ma dmar po/rgyun 'bad pa byed bzhin yod la/ de ltar 'bad pa' grub 'bras kyang rgya chen po thob dang 'thob bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir te dper na dz+nyoskye ba snga phyi'i rnam bzhag〉 gis phyogs so sor shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa bzhin no/rme sprul bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos ni thog mar bkra rgyal grangs can pa'i khri thog tu mnga' gsol ba ni ‘‘bdag bden pa ’mi dang ‘‘bdag gzhi sdo/ba’’ sogs kyi tshig 'gros 'di dag ma bkag na la las go ba ltag lag tu 'khyer shes che snyam nas bshad pa los yin snyam/ de min na zhogs dung gis ‘‘bdag bden pa’’dang ‘‘bdag gzhi grub’’ces bkod pa dang phyi rol ba'i bdag shes rig gi skyes bu gnyis go ba len phyogs kha kha yin pa sus kyang los shes/ rje dkar a rgyan btson 'grus kyis mgo gleng dus nas ‘‘dpon tshang bkra rgyal zhes bod yig 'bri 'don dang rgya yi skad yig rags tsam shes pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal can ’zhes brnyas smod de 'dra zhig byed pa ni don dngos la bsnyon 'dzugs tshabs chen byas pa zhig red/ ma zad bsam gzhigs dang zab rgya/ gnas bab/ 'aḥrto gnas sogs kyi tha snyad 'di dag la don ston pa'i nus pa med par bshad pa sogs ni rgyu mtshan gtan med pa'i skad cha rkyang rkyang red/ 〈ngas bsam par bgro gleng gi 'khor yug cig tu spro sems 'khor ba'i ngang zhugs 'dod yod na rgyu ri mtshan dang khungs lung gnas lugs sogs kyis rang gi lta ba sgrub par byed pa las sgro 'dogs dang skul 'debs kyi lkas de 'dra gnyer bas ci /84

zhig phan/ 'on kyang rtsom yig 'di dag gis kyang nus pa mi dman pa re thon yod pa smos ci dgos de/ de ni mang tshogs la shugs rkyen sna tshogs tshothebs pa dang / gnas lugs mang po gsal bshad byas pa/ da dung ther+shags dung gi lta ba la dpyad pa rgyag mkhan je mang du song yod pa bcas red/'dir 'god rgyu zhig la/ shes rig gi thad la dgag sgrub kyi lta tshul bzung ste mkhas pa so so'i gzhung lugs kyi steng nas phan tshun dpyad brjod dang phan tshun dgag bzhag byed pa ni/ phan tshun bsam blo brje res dang phan tshun skyon cha yo bsrings phan tshun legs cha bsdu res bcas kyi phan pa yod pa zhig yin pa ma zad de ni rigs lam la brdar na gcod pa'i don snying ldan pa zhig kyang red/ shes rig gang zhig la dpyad pa rgyag mkhan yod na da dung shes rig de nyams rgud du song ma tshar ba'i rtags mtshan yin pas de ni don bzang las kyang dpe bzang zhig red/ 'on kyang shes rig pa dang gzhung lugs rtsom mkhan gyi khrod na yod pa'i 'gal zla ni mang tshogs yig rmongs ba tsho'i spyod yul min yang rna thos yod pa zhig rgyu mtshan du byas te skyes chen tshor skul 'debs dang 'phya smod ngo rgol bcas byed pa cini ches mi legs pa zhig red/ de ni dper drangs na/ sngon chad kyi mi la las/ bod snga rarbes pa dang rje tsong kha ba'i lta ba cung mi 'dra cib yod pa de tsam rgyu mtshan du byas te slob dpon pad 'byung gi sku 'dra khong khro'i ngang gtor brdung byas pa red / da lta yang de dang 'dra bar mi rigs 185

lo ma dmar po/kyi mdun lam skor la gleng pa'i bsam blo'i mdzub ston gyi kha phyogs mi gcig sa nas phyogs lhung gi las 'gul bslangs te dmangs khrod du kha rdung dang 'phya smod byed bzhin yod/ mgo lag zla ba thar la mtshon na kho ni dmangs khrod kyi sgyu rtsal pa zhig red/ sgyu rtsal ba rang ga ba zhig yin pa'i mi tshad kho ni kha lce bde zhing smra brjod dag pa blo rig skyen cing ngag sgo yangs pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod pa zhig kyang red/ da dung mi rigs la brtse sems dang sha zhen yod pa zhig kyang yin nges/ 'on kyang kho'i las 'gan ni da sngon bshad na dmangs khrod kyi skyon cha dang nor 'khrul gang yod la mdzub mo 'dzugs rgyu dang / mdzub mo btsugs pa tsam ma yin par ya rabs kyi bzang bo'i yone tan dpe ston byas te skyon cha yobasring byed pa'i kha phyogs su skul ma gtong rgyu de yin pa las/ bod kyi gzhung lugs smra ba tsho'i khrod na rigs pa'i dgag bzhag gi rol rtsed byed ma myong ba red/ yin na yang kho'i 'khrab ston gyi las ka'i 'char gzhi la thengs dang po'i nor 'khrul zhig byung ba ni ‘‘lha'i dkyil 'khor nasnang du bskyugs’ ’zhes pa de red/ de ni rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi khrod du dngos su 'khrab ston byas pa zhig yin pa'i mi tshad rgyu mtshan ci yang mi shes pa'imu rgya che'i mang tshogs yig me+ongs ba du ma'i khrod du bod rang gi rtsom pa po zhig la kha mtshang ngo mtshang brus pa zhig red/ dmangs khrod du song nas nga tsho'i ri /86

bod kyi rtsom pa po dang gzhung lugs smra ba tsho la kha mtshang ngo mtshang brus te 'phya smod byed pa de ni/ nga tshos rang gi yon tan pa'i dpung sde spyi la brnyas bcos dang nga tshos rang gi yon tan pa'i rigs de don med rtsed chas su spyad pa zhig yin pas/ de ni nga tsho tshang ma ngo tsha dgos pa'i bya nyes byed nyes kyi las lugs ngan pa zhig red/ gal te kho la rig lam gsar ba zhig yod na gzhung lugs kyi steng nas bris kyang chog pa la/ khos de ltar mi byed par gzhan gyi rtsom yig las tshig 'ga' thus te ku re rtsed ma/tshar gyi lag cha byed pa de ni don ngo mas ‘‘za 'dod sprang bo'i ca co’’zer ba de ma yin nam/nga tsho'i lo rgyus gang la bltas kyang gna' nas da bar nang khul du phyogs lhung dang u tshugs mthar skyel byed pa'i goms gshis shrīg yod/goms gshos des ni thengs mang por nang khul du mthun sgril med pa yang bzos myong / goms gshis de'i ngo bo ni/ rang nyid kyi lta ba de ci 'dra yin yang / de gzhan sras yin yang khas len dgos la/ gal te kha sa mi len tshe de'i phyogs la sems gting nas ngo rgol byed pa'i gdug rtsub can gyi bsam blo cig red/ nga tsho'i chos lugs kyi kha phyogs yin na'ang 'dra/ mi rigs kyi mdun lam skor gyi kha riphyogs yin na'ang 'dra/ grub mtha' so so'i khas len mi gcig pa'i kha phyogs yin na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar kha phyogs mi gcig sa nas rang rang gi lta ba sgrub par rgyu ma/tshan ci 187

yod 'dren dgos pa skabs su babs kyang / so so'i khas len min ni rang rang gis brtags dpyad byas te bdams gses byed rgyur su la'ang dbang cha yod pa yin pas/ u tshugs kyi bsam blo des gdug rtsub ngom na ga la rung / 'dzam gling na dngos gtso dang sems gtso/ rgyu gnyis smra ba bcas 'jig rten lta tshul rigs mi 'dra ba du ma yod la/ da dung chos lugs mi 'dra ba dang grub mtha' mi 'dra gang ji snyed cig yod pa tshang ma la 'dod phyogs mi gcig pa re yod la 'dod phyogs de tsho'i rjes 'brang mkhan yang du ma zhig yod na yang gna' nas da bar de dag tshang ma 'dod pa gcig mthun cig yong ma thub/ de'i phyir da lta bshad na ‘‘shes rig ni mi'i rigs kyi thun mong du longs su spyod pa'i gces nor yin la/ lta ba ni mi rang rang gi sger la dbang ba'i bsam blo'i yo byad yin’’ par 'dod/de bzhin mkhas dbang dge chos kyis kyang / ‘‘mi re'i sems na mi mthun —tshad ma re// de yi rgyab rten rdo rje'i bka' lung re//’’ zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i mkhas pa tshos phan tshun bgro gleng byas na/ gung thang bas/‘‘'bras ldan lhang gnyis sbyar ba na// 'bras bu phung gsum 'byung ba ltar// blo dang ldan pa gnyis 'grogs na/ sngon med legs pa'i blo gros 'byung //’ri zhes gsungs pa ltar grub 'bras rgya chen po yod pa dang / khyad par don dngos kyi sgrub byed khungs btsan po su la yod na de la sus kyang /88

bsnyon 'dzugs mi thub ste/ dper na/ skye ba snga phyi khas mi len pa'i mi la dz+nyoskye ba snga phyi'i rnam bzhag srid pa gsal ba'i me long 〉 bstan pas dbang med yid kyi bstan pa 'phrog thub pa lta bu'o/ ma zad nga dang nga 'dra bas kyang rang nyid kyi bsam tshul de gzhan la dpyad gzhi'i tshul du 'bul ci thub byas na phan pa nges can re yod rgyu red snyam//de'i phyir ngas 'di ltar smra don yang don de nyid la dmigs pa yin pas klag mkhan ces dgongs 'gal med par zhu/ / //2004 5 1— /89

nga tsho'i mdzes dpyod la yang dag pa'i lta tshul 'dzin dgos/sngan chad ni ‘‘zas slong mo dang gos phyag dar khrod’’ la brten ces bshad myong yang don la gnas te de'i skabs kyi spyi tshogs ni da lta dang bsdur thabs med/ de nas 'dod pa bsod snyoms kyi mtha' dang ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' ste/ ‘‘mtha' gnyis’’ su mi lhung ba'i re 'dun bzung myong ba ni yul dus gang zhig yin yang ha cang tshad dang ran pa zhig red de da lta yang nga tsho'i ser mo ba'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba ste/ zas gos gnyis thad nas de 'dra'i re 'dun zhig gi tshad du 'jog pa ni phyogs gang thad nas bsams rung 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig red/ de'i phyir rgyas spros longs spyod cig gzhan la ngom sor 'khyer ba dang / rgyas spros longs spyod cig gis gzhan la mthong chung byed pa ni chos pa'i bsamathublo dang phan tshun ldog zlar gyur yod la gzhan gyis mthong na yid du mi 'ong zhing ches dbul snyeng phongs pa zhig gi 'tsho ba ni bstan pa'i che ba la dma' 'beb du 'gro bas nga tshos de gnyis ka spang byar brtsi rigs/ /90

bod kyi ser mo ba/ sngan chad spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba yang phal cher stabs bde zhig gi tshad las brgal mi thub par zas gos dang 'khor yug spyod chas tshang ma tshad nges can zhig gi steng du gnas thub pas mi dmangs kyi chas spyod la yang 'gyur ba 'gro rgyur dal 'gor bzos/ de bzhin de'i skabs kyi mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i 'gyur ldog de yang de 'dra'i skyen po zhig ma red/ de bzhin ser mo ba'i rigs kyi spyod lam dang chas gos la 'gyur ba 'gro rgyu de yang dal ba'i rang bzhin can zhig tu gnas yod/ ma zad dus skabs so sor 'gyur ldog gi chos nyid la bsam bzhin tshad bkag dbyis phyin pa re yang byed myong bas da lta yang de'i 'gyur ldog bshad skabs khas len mi phod pa'i sngangs skrag gi sha 'dar rgyug pa ni bod kyi skya ser gang zhig yin yang phal cher 'dra/ 'on kyang 'gyur ldog la tshad bkag byas pa des 'gyur ldog gi myur tshad la dal 'gor bzos pa zhig las 'gyur ldog gi chos nyid la tshod 'dzin ma thub par gna' bo'i cha lugs zhig nas da lta'i cha byad 'di ru rim gyis 'gyur thub pa byung song / de ltar gna' nas da bar ser mo ba'i cha byad rim bzhin 'gyur ba'i gnas tshul la bltas na —thog mar rgya gar gyi dbu reg dang zhabs rjen chos gos can zhig nas bod kyi lung bar gzhigs nas 'gyur ba cung tsam btang / de bzhin rgya nag gi hwa shang dang bod kyi ban de gnyis kyi cha byad mi 'dra bar gyur/ bod rang nang khul du yang grub mtha' so so'i zhwa stabs mi 'dra ba dang / gyon gos 191

lo ma dmar po/mi 'dra ba/ yang rong 'brog gi ban de so so'i cha byad mi 'dra ba nas/ sa gshis kyi dbang gis yul lung so so'i cha lugs mi 'dra bar gyur/ de'i dbang gis la las 'gag ring gon srol zhig dang / la las smad g.yog gon srol zhig la las stod 'bog gon srol zhig nas lo las phu rung bcad nas gon srol zhig la las wa zhwa dang tshar zhwa/ 'ju rta sogs gang bsam gon srol zhig nas la las go lham dang zhwa sogs mi gon pa'i srol sogs rab dang rim pa zhig byung / ma zad nang lwa dang dor ma sogs gon mi chog pa nas gon srol yod pa'i lugs shig kyang 'phral du dar/ yang /phrug gzan dang ther sham/ tshar 'gag phrag brgyang sogs dang / zhwa mo rtse rno dang u rgyan pad zhi/ khri ber/ dge bskos kyi mdun la 'dogs rgyu dang rkyab la dpyang rgyu sogs gzab 'chor spras byed kyi gyon gos du ma zhig kyang dar/ dar gdugs 'phan gsum dang bla bre sogs kyi mchod rdzas dngos po du ma zhig kyang yod pa ni/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ ‘‘zhwa mo chos gos ba dan bla bre dang // za rgyu 'thung rgyu'i mchod pa tshogs 'khor sogs//'a cag rnams kyis ci dang ci byed pa// ya mtshan ltad mo tsam las gzhan ma mthong //’’ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / 'di dag tshang ma gna' bo'i thon skyed rgyu chas kyis lhan tu dbul ba'i bod kyi yul lung 'di lu mtshon na ches ha las pa zhig red la/ dgon pa'i 'bud rdung dkrol gsum gyi rol chas thams cad kyang de'i skabs ches ya mtshan pa zhig tu gyur/ ya /92

bod kyi ser mo ba/mtshan pa 'di dag gis chos lugs byed sgo sna tshogs spel bas dgon pa so so yang chos ma zad srid kyi steng nas kyang dbang cha dang go gnas tshad ldan re'i steng du slobs thub song /'di dag ni sngon song gi lo rgyus red/ nga tsho'i dmigs yul ni lo rgyus ma yin par 'byung 'gyur la kha phyogs nas da lta'i gnas tshul la lta rgyu de red/da lta ni/ mthong rgyu dang thos rgyu mang ba/ thon skyed kyi dngos po'i yo byad gsar ba du ma zhig glo bur du dar bas/ mi'i sems khams la 'gyur ldog sna tshogs bzos/ ma zad/ 'gyur ldog gi phyogs su brtson len byed cing 'gyur ldog gi steng du 'gran rtsod byed bzhin pa'i deng gi dus rabs 'di la la re re nas ma tshad zla re re nas gyon gos dang cha byad spyod chas la sogs rnying ba nas gsar bar brje bzhin yod la/ rnying ba nas gsar bar bsgyur ba'i myur tshad ni dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang tshan rtsal yar rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun je mgyogs nas je mgyogs su 'gro bzhin yod/ de lta bu'i gnas bab cig gi 'og nga tsho'i ser mo ba'i gna' bo'i cha byad dang gzab 'chor/ dgon pa'i chos lugs kyi byed sgo sna tshogs gang yin yang des mi rnams kyi yid la dang ba 'dren mi thub pa'i snang tshul zhig lo re nas lo re'i bar 'byung bzhin yod pa red/de'i phyir nga tsho'i sngan chad dgon pa so so'i byed sgo sna tshogs ches 193

lo ma dmar po/dar ba'i skabs su bcos bsgyur sna tshogs kyi yo lang 'khrug cha dod po byas te bla ma so so'i phyag bzhes mi 'dra ba du ma zhig gsar gtod byas yod pa nang bzhin da lta yang bcos bsgyur gyi byed thabs shig spyad nas nga tsho'i grwa ba'i gyon gos dang dgon pa'i chos lugs byed sgo gang thad nas dus rabs gsar ba'i mi rnams kyi yid sems bslu thub pa zhig byed rgyu ni gal chen las kyang 'gangs chen red/ ma zad/ sngan chad dgon pa'i lha sku dang mchod cha 'du khang dang lha khang sogs kyi 'dzugs skrun gyis bkod pas kyang mi rnams bslu thub na yang / da skabs de dag gi bzo rtsal yang ha las pa zhig gi tshad du thon mi thub pas/ nga tsho'i nges par du sangs rgyas chos gzhung gi rtsa ba'i re 'dun gzhir bzung ste/ zhi ba dang bde ba/ khod snyoms dang bag phebs/ bden pa bden thub dang drang mo drang bzhag gi 'khor yug rma med pa zhig 'dzugs skrun byed rgyur dmi gas te gong gi lam lugs 'di dag kyang gsar ba gsar rkyang zhig tu bsgyur bar 'bad dgos snyom/ de ltar byas na da gzod mi thams cad kyi yi gar 'ong ba zhig gi phyags su skyad thub snyam/mdzes dpyod lta tshul gyi steng nas bshad na mi rnams ni nam yang mdzes pa la dga' ste/ 'khor yug gi shugs rkyen mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis mdzes mi mjes kyi khyad par la ngos 'dzin stangs mi 'dra ba yod na yang /don ngo mas mdzes pa don du gnyer ba ni mi rnams kyi lhan skyes kyi rang — 194

bod kyi ser mo ba/bzhin zhig yin te/— dper na/ lag shes pa zhig la mtshon na rang rang gis dngos po yo byad ci zhig bzo skun byed kyang de la mdzes nyams shig thon rgyur 'bad pa byed pa ni smos ci dgos/ mdzad spyod pa tshos kyang dngos po yo byad ci zhig nyo sgrub byed kyang spyod sgo la bsam blo btang rjes kha dog dang tshugs ka mdzes mi mjes 'dem rgyu ni mi rnams kyi rang gshis red/ de'i steng nas bltas na nga tsho mi su yin yang ri dang ra ba/khang khyim// gyon gos/ rgyan cha sogs phyogs gang thad nas mdzes mi mdzes kyi dbye ba gsal bo zhig rang shugs kyis 'byed bzhin yod/ de ni nga tsho'i lhan skyes kyi mi'i rang gshis shog ma yin nam/ da dung deng dus ni mdzes dpyod slob gso ched du gnyer nas/ mi rnams la rgyan gos sogs 'char 'god sna tshogs byed du 'jug bzhin yod la/ dke' ngal che ba'i dbul bo'i sa cha 'ga' re ma gtogs mdzes dpyod lta tshul 'di ches gtso bo zhig tu brtsi bzhin yod pa ma zad/ bzo rtsal sna tshogs kyi nyams thon pa'i dngos po yo byad du ma zhig gis kyang gang sar khyab 'dug pas/ mi rnams kyis mdzes pa don du gnyer ba de yang tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas/ shugs rje drag tu 'gro bzhin yod/ de ltar byas na mdzes dpyod lta tshul gyis mi 'dang ba de blun po ru brtsi nges/nga tsho'i ser mo ba 'di ‘‘dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan dang 'byor ldan bsod nams gsog pa'i zhig sa’’ zhig tu byed dgos na 195
