lo ma dmar po/mdzes dpyod 'di la yang dag pa'i lta tshul gsar ba zhig bzung ste ban ser mo ba'i steng gi mi mdzes pa'i cha gang yod bcos bsgyur byed par dogs snang skye mi nyan/ de yang phyogs mtshungs shig 'god na/ gos rgyan steng gi sham ra skyed byed 'ga' ste/ sram lpags kyis mtha' brgyan can dang rgya gser gyi stod 'bog gser dngul gyi lag gdub dang 'dzub dkris 'ju rta yu ring dang gzi byur gyi ske rgyan sogs ni gzhan gyi mig lam la mdzes pa ma red/ da dung grong nang du dus rgyun 'dur ba dang srang lam na dus rgyun slong mo byed pa/ bu smad tsho'i gsag tu rgyug pa sogs kyang bya ba'i steng gi mi mdzes pa red/ gzhan grong nang na lcags rta zhon pa dang sbag sbag zhon pa rlangs 'khor dang 'drud 'then 'khor lo'i kha po byed pa sogs kyang gyon gos 'di stabs mi bde bas mdzes pa'i nyams kyis byugs thabs bral/ yang / rgyun du rkang lag mi bkru ba dang /gyon gos mi bkru ba/ chu 'dam dang sa rdul gyi nang du 'dug rgyur mi 'jem pa/ lha khang dang chos khang nang du lham gyon pa la sogs pa'i mtshon/ gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten mi legs pa de yang mdzes pa'i nyams kyis byugs par mi 'gyur/ da dung ‘‘grong rdar gyi srang lam la bltas’’ na cha byad sna tshoṭa dang las rigs 'dra min gyis khengs pa sogs ni mi mdzes pa'i cha de mthun rkyen 'dang tshod dang bstun nas bcos bsgyur ma byas thabs med red/sdidor na gyon gos gtso bo byas pa'i ban ser mo+o ba'i phyi'i mjes /96

nyams kyi rig pa 'di la dpyad brjod byas te nga tsho'i mkhas pa so so dang yon tan pa so sos dus dang mthun pa dang yul dang mthun pa'i cha byad yid du 'ong ba zhig 'dzugs rgyur blo 'don dang gros bsdur byed dgos/ de lta min par cha lugs bsgyur bcos mi chog ces pa tsam gyi bsam blo mtha' gcig tu mkhregs 'dzin byas na mjug 'bras ci yod gsal bo red de/‘‘'dul ba yul dus dadi bstun/’’ chog par gsungs ma yin nam/2004 5 6

lomadamarapo/ nga tshos bstan pa'i la rgya bzung ste mang tshogs rang bzhin las rnam par rgyal dgas/ mang tshogs khrod chos spel dgos la/chos kyis mang tshogs la zhabs 'degs dgos/mang tshogs khrod ser mo ba 'dzugs dgos la/ser mo bas mang tshogs kyi khe phan srung dgos/de ni rtsa don red/ 'on kyang de ni de 'dra'i stabs bde zhig min par gnad don mang bo zhig la 'brel ba yod pa'i rnyog 'dzing can zhig red/de thog mar mdor bsdus de cung zad 'god na/gcig ser mo bas bstan pa'i —la rgya sger 'dzin byed dgos/bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas bce+om ldan 'das yin zer/ de'i nang don ni chos 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams phra mo zhig tshun chad ston pa kho nar dbang bas 198

gzhan su zhig gis bcos bsgyur mi byed ces pa de red/ yin na yang da bar bshad na bla ma dang grwa ba jo mo dang ban de/ sngags pa/ bya btang gang zhig yin yang de tshang ma'i che ma chung gsum gyi bya bzhag dang kun spyod dang bsam blo'i dbye ba gang yod la bzang ngan gyi khyad 'byed mkhan ni mang tshogs yin pas/ mang tshogs kyis bzang bar brtsis na bzang ba dang ngan par brtsis na ngan par 'gro/—de'i phyir bla ma dang grwa ba sogs ser mo ba mang che bas ma/nga tshogs kyi 'dod blor mthun pa'i bsam blo dang spyod lam zhig gis mang tshogs kyi sems khams dang bstun ci thub byed bzhin yod pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis ser mo ba'i bsam spyod gang yod kyis chos gzhung gi rtsa ba'i re 'dun dang bstun ci thub byed rgyu de lhod g.yeng du gtong gi yod pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis chos gzhung gi dgongs don gyis mang tshogs kyi bsam blor phar kha lo bsgyur dgos kyang de 'dra'i nus stobs zhan de mang tshogs kyi bsam pas tshur ser mo ba la kha lo sgyur bzhin yod/ de ltar bsam na bstan pa'i bdag po de yang mang tshogs yin 'dug ces bshad kyang mi chog ba ci yod snyam/ de ni nga tsho da lta'i bod khul sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi ches zhan cha de red ces bshad chog zhan cha de 'dra bcos bsgyur ma byas par rgyun 'byams su song na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa /99

nyamasargud du 'gro ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur nges/ nga tsho'i sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel byed na de'i chos gzhung gi rtsa ba'i re 'dun la khungs bcol ba'i bsam blo'i 'du shesi khyab spel byed dgos/ bsam blo'i 'du shes yang dag dang tshad ldan can de nyin gzhan la khyab spel byed dgos/ de gang yin zer na/ de ni nga tsho'i chos gzhung la nang byan chud cing chos gzhung gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba nges can zhig rgyud la mnga' ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo dang / dam pa'i chosda nyams su bstar ba'i 'bras rtags mngon gsal can rgyud la mnga' ba'i chos phyogs kyi skyes chen tshos rig pa brgya phrag gis gtan la phab pa'i lta ba khyad par can/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ gzhung lugs dang ldan pa/ go rim dang sgrig gzhi cha tshang ba zhig la bya dgos/ gal te mang tshogs3) bsam blo khyab chung ba khungs lungs med pa rig lam mi ldan pa/ sgrig gzhi dang mgo mjug ci yang med pa'i 'ud shob dang stong lab tsam zhig gi rjes 'brang te sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lta ba khyab spel byed na phan las gnod pa brgya phrag gis che/ban ser mo ba zhig yin phyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba byed pa'i 'gan khur su la'ang yod pa red/ de'i ngos nas bshad na bod kyi ser mo ba 'di tshor las 'gan 200

bodekyiseramob/ ljid tig tig cig phrag tu babs yod pa ni/ rang nyid bod kyi sangasargyasachos lugs kyi rkang 'dzin pa zhig dang / de'i rjesa'adzin pa/ de dar spel gtong mkhan zhig e yong lta rgyu de red/ de'i ched du de la hur brtson bla lhag cig bsnan te shugasayod tshangasnye kyis bod kyi ser mo ba de rang nyid rang tshugs thub pa'i sde khag brtan tshugs pa zhig yong rgyur dus rgyun 'bad pa byed dgos/ de ltar byed pa'i sems shugs mi skyed parobasam pa lhod g.yeng du btang na/ nga tsho ni gzhan gyis bed spyod byed pa'i lag cha lta bu zhig dang / gzhan kho na la brten cing gzhan kho na la bstun pa'i gzhan gyis gang bsam kha lo sgyur chog pa'i 'phrul chas lta bu zhig tu gyur ba 'di bzhin lags/ de'i phyir ser bo ba'i bsam spyod gang thad nas rang rkya pher ba dang sger tshugs thub pa zhigal dmigs te mang tshogs kyi bsam spyod dang bsre bslad chesache ba de lasarnam par rgyal ba byed dgos/ de cung rgyas tsam 'god na/gnyis pa/ mang tshogs rang bzhin can gyi chos lugs/mang tshogs chos lugs zer ba de la ngo bo'i sgo nas khyad par ba'i rnam pa du ma zhig rang bzhin shugs kyis phyir mngon 'dug ste/ 201

lomadamarapo/ 1 brag dog gi zug chu kun nas ba'i 'gran rtsod kyi rnayogazhig phyir mngon yod ba/dper na/ chung sanasi bshad na khyi.oṃmatshesakyi mi khyim de tsho'i gcig tshang gis da lo yong 'bab bzang bas khyim mi gang lbe+o lha sar mjal skor du 'gro zer bar phyin pa'am/ yang na bka' 'gyur dag tshar zhig klog pa'am/ yang na khyim tshang de'i shi bo zhig la skye rtags zhus te dge rtsa sgrub pa'am rten bzhengs cung zad re byas pa sogs kyis mtshon/ bya ba che musachung gsumaci zhig byed kyang de tshang la 'gran ya slong ched sgor g.yar skyin dang bshasajinyo sdig tshong g.yo sgyu mna' za/ jag rkun ci zhig dgos kyang mi 'dzem par 'bad pa'i khyim tshang gi chos lugs byed stangasashig nas/ che sa nas sde ba dang yul tsho'i b.rajidang / bla drag dang mi dpon bar gyi grub mtha' dang bstan pa/ 'gro don dang dgos dbang rten bzhengs dang dge bskul gang rung zhig gi ched phan tshun 'gran slong dang khong khro'i rnam pa zhig gisaphrag dog dang 'thab mo 'brug rtsod sogs 'byung gi yod pa'i rigs 'di dag ni mang tshogs rang bzhin can gyi chos lugs byed stangasashig red/ 202 ri

2 rang 'dod g.yor(sbyor gyithasakun nathangabaglangabangaba'i gzhan phan blodangagatong gi rnamab zhig phyir mngon yod pa/ dkon mchog la mchod pa byed na de'i yon tan rtogs nas dad pa ma yin pa dang /dbul phongs la sbyin pa byin na snying rje'i sgo nas gnang sbyin ma yin par yar mchod mar sbyin ci zhig byed kyang / rang la longs spyod thob 'dod cig dang / snyan grags rgyas 'dod cig gi ham sems ngan pas kun nas bslangs te mdor na rang bde kho nas rang 'dod du dmigs na de'i rjes 'bras kyang gser dbyig gi le'u lta bur mi 'gyur bar/ dbul mos ras sbyin pa lta bur 'gyur bas/ phan nga/ shin tu chung na yang / kho'i bya spyod gang yod la khyod pham nga rgyal gyi sgo nas gzhan don dang /snying rje/ spyi phan sogs kyi bsam blo cung zad kyang mi ldan pa de yang mang tshogs rang bzhin can gyi chos lugs byed stangs shig red/3 tshe 'di don gnyer gyis kun nasabaslangasaba'i phyi ma blosagatong gi rnam pa zhig phyir mngon yod pa/mi dga' ba'i dgra bo chung chung zhig la dmigs nas ngan sngags mthu gtad dang drag po'i thun zor sdeb pa/ tshe mthud zer nas tshe bsgrub 'don pa/ phywa g.yang 'gugs 203

lo ma dmar po/ ched la g.yang 'bod 'donapa/ bgeg dang bar chad rkyen ngan byur 'dre sogs sel ched dang bsgrur ched la gto 'don pa/ da dung lha bsangs gtong ba dang klu bsangs gtong ba yul lha gzhi bdag mchod de kha 'dzin sdong grogs zhu ba/ rta pho grug zheng can la sprad dgorme zer ba/ rgod ma ther zheng can la sprad dgos zer ba/ than lha mdun du mchod pa 'bul ba dang / dgon pa la zhal 'debs 'bul ba/ phyag skor byas pa tshun chad tshe 'di'i rkyen dang bar chad sel phyir dmigs pa 'di yang mang tshogs rang bzhin can gyi chos lugs byed stangs shig red/ 4 ma rig mun 'thom gyis kun nalobaslangasaba'i semasapa gti mug gi rnamapazhig phyir mngon yod pa/ — dper na/ lto gos gtam gsum la gyong skul ba'i tshe 'di blos gtong gi bya bral ba zhig la dad pa mi byed par/ 'di snang mngon rgyug gi rol rtsed la g.yeng ba'i dad zas dkor nag la dus rgyun spyod pa'i grong khyim pa zhig la dad pa byed pa dang / yang na/mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par nang byan chud pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po zhig la brtsi mthong mi byed par/ thos bsam gyi las la 'jug ma myong zhing shes rig gi gnas la slob ma myong ba'i rmongs ba'i skye bo gang rung zhig la bkur sti byed pa sogs bzang 204

ngan gyi dbye ba mi shes shing rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag 'chug pa sogs blang dor gyi gnas la shin tu rmongs pa 'di dag kyang mang tshogs chos lugs kyi bzo lta zhig red/phyir rang shugs kyis mngon pa'i rnam pa 'di dag ni mang tshogs kyi chos lugs grub cha'i khyad rtags gtso bo red/ khyad rtags de dag dang ldan na sangs rgyas chos gzhung gi rtsa ba'i re 'dun dang 'gal ba ltag sprod du gyur yod pa sa/ ser mo bas nam/ yang 'di la slob mi rung /sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab la sbyangs ba byed ma myong ba dang gcig chos phyogs kyi nyams len gcig kyang rang rgyud la len ma myong ba dang gnyis/ rig pa'i gnas spyi la lta rgya ches chung ba dang gsum bcas kyi rgyu rkyen 'di dag gis/ sangs rgyas chos lugs zer ba ci zhig yin pa tsam yang mi shes shing / brgya cha bdun cu yan yig rmongs ba yin pa'i bod kyi rgya che'i mang tshogs la mkhregs 'dzin dang / u tshugs/ phyogs res bcas byed pa'i chos lugs shig yod/ chos lugs de ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dpang du 'jog nus zer ba'i kha pho ches mtho ba'i chos lugs shig yin pa ma zad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'gran ya 'dzin pa'i chos lugs shig kyang red la/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug ban ser mo ba'i ring la kha lo sgyur ba dang /205ri

lo ma dmar po/ do bsdo phod btsugs byed pa'i chos lugs shig kyang red/ chos lugs des dbang shed bzung nas da lta la thug gi bar skabs rer sangs rgyas kyi bstan par zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i tshul bzung ba dang / skabs rer sangs rgyas kyi bstan par dma' 'beb byed pa'i tshul bzung ba red/ gang ltar de ni mang tshogs kyi rig gnas yin pas/mi rigs kyi sems khams dang rang gshis srung 'dzin byed rgyur phan pa'ang yod/gsum pa/ nang bstan shes rig dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu/1 nang bstan shesariganang bstan shes rig la gzhung lugs mtha' yas pa yod la/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung lugs grangs kyis mi long / bka' bstan gyi gleg bam tshar du dngar ba de dag brtsigs na ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam/ gtsug lag gi phung bo de dag snyan 'jebs ldan la brjod bya zab/ ma zad rig gzhung de dag dpe sgrom du bzhugs rkyang min par/ de la sbyangs ba byed mkhan grangs kyis mi long la sbyangs bas byang tshad lon pa ha cang mang / de ni nga tsātsho'i nang bstan shes rig gi rjod byed tshig gi cha nas bshad pa red/sems rgyud bcos pajidang / sems pa 'dulda ba/ rtogs pa skye ba dang yon tan 'byor ba/ nyams shar ba dang / stong nyid rtogs pa/ byang sems 'khrungs ba/ nges 2pu6 —

bod kyi ser mo ba/'byung skye ba/ sa thob pa/ lam rgyud la skye ba la sogs pa'i thabs su spyod lam 'chos pa dang / dpyad pa rgyag pa/ yang yang bsgom pa sogs kyi go rim la brten nas bshad yod la/ bshad pa tsam ma yin par don ji bzhin nyams su bstar ba'i 'bras rtags mngon gsal byung ba grangs kyis mi long / de ni nga tsho'i nang bstan shes rig gi ban+dod bya don gyi cha nas bshad pa red/ 2 bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu/ nang bstan shes rig ni shes rig yin pas/ de'i dar rgud ni de rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i mi sna yod med la thug yod pa las/ phyi'i rgyu dza sa dngos po'i spus tshad lta bu zhig la ngos 'dzin mi rung / de yang / dper na/ da lta 'khor lo dang jo dar mang po 'phrul 'khor gyis par brgyab ste phyogs phyogs su 'grem spel byed bzhin pa 'di la mtshon na/gal te de dpar sa'i ras dang shog bu'i spus tshad dang / yang na de btsong ba'i grangs mang nyung zhig gis nang bstan dar min bshad na/ de ni dpal 'byor gyi tshad gzhi dang tshong las 'khor rgyug gi tshad cig las gang yang min/ de'i phyir 'dir de'i mi sna'i skor cung zad 'god na/ gzhung lugs la sbyangs ba song na de ni nang bstan shes rig gi gzhung lugs rgyun 'dzin pa red/ gzhung lugs dang nyams len zung 'brel gyi 207

lo ma dmar po/mngon rtang gsal botshuthon tshe de 'dra'i skyes bu de ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu red la/ nang bstan shes rig gi cha yongs nas rkang 'dzin pa red/ chos pa dang skyes bu dam pa yang red/de'i steng nas bltas na rig gzhung gi byang tshad dang nyams len rgyud la 'byor min gyi tshad gzhi ni rab dang rim pa zhig yod srid la/ rab dang rim pa zhig yod pa'i tshad gzhi re re ni chos pa'i go gnas kyi rim pa so so'i tshad gzhi ru rang shugs kyis gyur yod/ chos pa'i tshad gzhi mtho dman gyi tshad 'byed byed kyi rtsa ba'i cha rkyen yang de red/ de bzhin cha rkyen de gnyis kyi tshad gzhi ci 'dra ldan na chos pa'i rim pa dang go gnas kyi tshad gzhi de 'dra ldan la/ cha rkyen de gnyis kyi tshad gzhi ci 'dra mi ldan tshe chos pa'i go gnas kyi tshad gzhi de 'dra mi ldan pa reg de gzhan pa'i rgyu 'byor dang go gnas thob thang gang la yang ltos pa ci yang med do// zhor du bshad rgyu zhig la/ mngon mkhyen yod zer ba de yang mi 'ga' zhig gi lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin dmigs bsal can zhig yin la de sbyong brdar gyi nus pa las skyed thub pa zhig kyang yin zer/ dper na rang nyid la chag sgo zhig yong ba'i sngon brda ru rang gi thad tshor (tsho'i7 sum̐ )gyis tshod dpag byed thub la/ gzhan zhig la chag sgo 208

bod kyi ser mo ba/sogs don rkyen re byung tshe de yang phal cher thad tshor gyis brda rgyag thub pa zhig red/'on kyang de ni thad tshor yin pa las/ nyams rtogs kyi yon tan tshad rdzogs pa'i mngon shes dang mkhyen pa ma red/ de'i phyir des brgya cha brgya bo tshod mi thig par skabs rer tshod dpag thub la/ skabs rer tshod dpag mi thub pa red/thad tshor zer ba de mi su la yang yod chog chog zhig red/ 'on kyang thad tshor rnon po zhig dgos na lhan skyes dang sbyongs brdar gnyis la rag las pas/ thad tshor cung rno ba'i mi zhig yin phyin des sbyong brdar rgyun 'khyongs byas na rang gi bya ba'i nus par phan pa che zer/ de ni 'jig rten pa dang chab srid lta bas bshad stangs shig las/chos pa'i tshad gzhi dang chos gzhung gi re 'dun gang dang yang 'brel ba med/ ribazhi ba/ mang cesags chos sdo/gas kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa'i skrurtos mdog sgyur bzhin yod pa/ ‘‘rtogs ldan rogs la mi mthun/ kabla bzhag sa'i mi 'dug’’ zer ba dang /‘‘mi las bltas na 'khor ba 'khrul/ 'khor bas bltas na mi la 'khrul/’’ zer ba sogs chos pa dang 'jig rten pa gnyis la 'dra mnyam gyi lta tshul 'dzin pa'i gtam dpe du ma zhig dmangs khrod du yod ma zad/ 'jig rten pas chos pa ngo ma tshor ru 209

lo ma dmar po/dma' 'beb byed pa'i lta tshul du ma zhig kyang gang sar mngon 'dug de'i rkyen kyis nga tsho bod khams 'dir chos pa rnal ma'i khe dbang de gna' snga mo zhig nas rdog rol du btang ste/ 'jig rten pa mang pos chos pa'i bsam blo dang chos gzhung gi lta ba mang po mang tshogs kyi 'dod blo dang mnyam bsre byas te mang tshogs mgo skor gtong ba'i g.yo sgyu'i bya spyod cig spel mgo brtsams/ dus de nas bzung de 'dra'i lta tshul zhig mang tshogs khrod dar khyab byung bas mang tshogs chos lugs shig rang shugs su grub/ de grub nas lo ngo mang po 'gor ba dang nus pa mi dman re thon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu tshor phyir 'khon sems bzung /de'i rkyen gyis sa 'dir chos pa'i gzugs brnyan chos par brdzus pa zhig dang chos pa rnal ma de rigs gnyis byung zhing / snga mas ni spyi tshogs 'brel ba dang dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i meng gzhi rgya bskyed dang sra brtan byed rgyu gtso bo'i dmigs yul du bzung ste/ de la dmigs nas rgyun du bed spyod byed pa'i bsam blo'i lag cha ni mang tshogs rang bzhin can gyi chos lugs 'du shes de red/ mgo rmong gi mang tshogs ni dbang bsgyur ba de tsho'i dbang shugs su 'du sla yang / chos kyi shugs rkyen zab mo thebs pa'i dge 'dun pa ngo ma zhig yin na nam yang de lta bu'i dbang shugs kyis 210

bod kyi sger mo ba 'dul thub pa min/ phyi mas ni dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis chos bsgrub ste grol ba don du gnyer ba las/ 'jig rten gyi 'tsho pacung zad re bsgrub dgos byung yang skabaspu re tsam ma gtogs mthar thug gi dmigs yul grol ba yin pas mang tshogs mgo skor sogs kyi goskre gi bya bzhag de tsho mi ldan pa red/ de'i bsam blo ni rang gzhan gnyis phan dang de'i nang nas kyang gzhan don gtso bo byed pa'i rlabs chen gyi bsam blo de rede/ de lta yin pas/ chos pa rnal ma zhig yin na de la spyi tshogs 'brel ba dang dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i khyab khungs ha cang chung bas de'i snyan grags dang thob thang de tsam las mi 'dug pas mang tshogs khrod mtshan snyan yang de 'dra'i rgya chen po ma red/gong gi rgyu mtshan de dag gis ci zhig bshad zer na/ chos pa'i mtshan snyan de nga tsho bod kyi ser mo ba'i khrod dang shes ldan pa'i khrod rgyas su 'jug dgos pa dang / ser mo ba'i khrod dang shes ldan pa'i khrod rlabs chen dang gzi brdzid cig tu brtsis te kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi ru dpe ston byed dgos/ de lta min par nga tsho mer mo ba'i re snyeg byed yul gyi mig dpe de mang tshogs kyi 'dod blo ltar/ thob thang che ba/ rgyu nor bdo ba/skye mthon red zer ba/ mkhyen pa ldan zhes pa/ gdung rgyud dang rigs rus mtho zer 2/1

317zungathamazungazang21/ ri ba sogs —yin tshe nga tsho'i chos lugs de yang mang tshogs chos lugasakyi ngo bo las ma 'das par phyi rdzig nyams can gyi shing gi seng ge ltar gyur ba red/ — cigazhan yang / nang bstan shes rig gi rjod byed tshig dang brjod bya don gyi cha gang thad nas nang byan chud pa'i bod kyi ser mo ba'i rigasashig yin na de'i chos phyogs kyi bshad pa gang yod nga tshos khas len byed 'os/ gal te de la mgo me+ong gi skye bo zhig yin phyin khos smras pa'i chosi phyogs kyi bshad pa tshang ma blo bzo red/ des ni las rigs gzhan la sbyangs ba song yang nang bstan shes rig la ci yang sbyangs ba med pa'i mang tshogs kyis bshad pa'i chos phyogs kyi skad cha tshang ma khas len byed thabs med pa'i gnas lugs de bstan yod/ yin na yang da lta mang tshogs kyi chos lugs 'du shes la rgyab rtsa brtan po zhig yod de/ kho tshos bshad pa la cha 'jog dang gdeng 'jog tshad mthon byed bzhin yod pa ni ha cang thal drags pa zhig red/ rgyu mtshan ni kho tsho la khungs lung bzang bo med paspu red la/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni kho tsho la chosaphyogs nas skad cha bshad pa'i tshad gzhi dang cha rkyen bzang bo med pas red/ khong tsho la bshad rgyun tsam dang srol rgyun tsam goms gshis tsam zhig gleng rgyu yod pa ni don ngo ma'i chos lugs pa dang ser mo ba'i skad cha rna thos tsam yod pa'i rkyen red/ da lta bshad na khong 2/2

bod kyi ser mo ba/tsho'i ser mo ba'i ngag nas phar thos myong ba'i skad cha 'ga' re sgrub byed du tshur drangs te ser mo ba laskyon 'dzugs byed pa ni ‘6'bag mgo phar g.yar na 'jigs dgra tshur ngom ’ zer ba de ma red dam/2005 1
